title: "Why Going to Church Doesn’t Automatically Make You a Christian" 🔥
paragraphs:
"Why Going to Church Doesn’t Automatically Make You a Christian" 🔥
✝️ A Message from Brother John Domino "PiX" S. Asis
🌍 Today, God has a powerful truth for you—one that needs to be heard.
👉 Being in a church building doesn’t make you a Christian, just like standing in a garage doesn’t make you a car.
It’s a bold statement, but it’s the truth.
📖 “Not everyone who says to Me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter the kingdom of heaven, but only the one who does the will of My Father who is in heaven.” (Matthew 7:21)
Too many people are attending church services without ever truly surrendering their hearts to Jesus.
Let me ask you something:

Do you know Jesus personally?
Or are you just attending out of habit?
Today’s message is your wake-up call—let’s uncover the truth about what it really means to be a follower of Christ.

🌟 Why Going to Church Isn’t Enough 🌟
Church attendance is important—but it doesn’t define salvation.
The Bible makes it clear:

➡️ Salvation is through Jesus, not through a location.
➡️ Faith is about your heart, not your habits.
➡️ Transformation is personal, not just public.
3 Common Misunderstandings Christians Have:

1️⃣ "I Go to Church, So I Must Be Saved"
Truth: Going to church is a step—but salvation is through faith in Christ alone.
📖 “For it is by grace you have been saved, through faith—and this is not from yourselves, it is the gift of God.” (Ephesians 2:8-9)

💡 The Reality:
You can sit in a church pew every week and still be spiritually lost.
Salvation is not about proximity to a building—it’s about proximity to Jesus.
✅ Reflection: Do you know Jesus personally, or are you just near religious activity?

2️⃣ "I Was Raised in Church, So I’m a Christian"
Truth: Faith isn’t inherited—it’s personal.
📖 “No one can enter the kingdom of God unless they are born again.” (John 3:3)

💡 The Reality:
You aren’t a Christian just because you grew up in a Christian home.
Faith isn’t about your upbringing—it’s about your surrender.
✅ Reflection: Have you personally made the decision to follow Jesus?

3️⃣ "I Serve in Ministry, So I’m Close to God"
Truth: Service without personal surrender is just performance.
📖 “Many will say to Me on that day, ‘Lord, Lord, did we not prophesy in Your name…?’ Then I will tell them plainly, ‘I never knew you.’” (Matthew 7:22-23)

💡 The Reality:
Ministry isn’t a substitute for intimacy with God.
✅ Reflection: Are you working for God or walking with Him?

🔥 What Makes Someone a True Christian? 🔥
Being a Christian isn’t about:

❌ Church attendance.
❌ Religious traditions.
❌ Titles or roles in ministry.
It’s about:
✅ A personal relationship with Jesus.
✅ A heart transformed by the Holy Spirit.
✅ A life of obedience and faith.

🌍 How to Move from “Attending Church” to Truly Following Christ 🌍
✅ Step 1: Admit You Need Jesus Personally
📖 “For all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God.” (Romans 3:23)
💡 Reflection: Have you acknowledged your need for a Savior?

✅ Step 2: Repent and Surrender Completely
📖 “Repent, then, and turn to God, so that your sins may be wiped out.” (Acts 3:19)
💡 Repentance means a complete turnaround, not just saying sorry.
✅ Action: Take a moment now and confess your sins honestly before God.

✅ Step 3: Build a Daily Relationship with Jesus
📖 “Draw near to God, and He will draw near to you.” (James 4:8)
💡 True faith is lived out daily—prayer, worship, obedience.
✅ Challenge: Spend 15 minutes alone with God today—just you and Him.

✅ Step 4: Live Out Your Faith Publicly
📖 “Let your light shine before others, that they may see your good deeds and glorify your Father in heaven.” (Matthew 5:16)
💡 Following Jesus transforms how you:

Treat people.
Handle struggles.
Share the Gospel.
✅ Challenge: Share your faith story with someone this week.

📜 Faith Declaration for January 8 📜
"I declare that my faith is not based on tradition but on a personal relationship with Jesus Christ. I will not settle for attending church—I will live fully for Christ. I surrender my heart, mind, and life completely to Him."

🔥 The "Live as a True Christian" Challenge 🔥
✅ Step 1: Spend time in personal prayer today.
✅ Step 2: Share a testimony of how God transformed your life.
➡️ Let’s create a global movement of true disciples! 🌍

🌌 "It’s Time for Authentic Faith, Not Just Church Attendance" 🌌
📖 “You will seek Me and find Me when you seek Me with all your heart.” (Jeremiah 29:13)

This isn’t just a post—it’s your personal invitation.
Today, God is calling you to go deeper.
💡 Are you ready to stop just attending and start truly following Jesus?

🙏 A Prayer for January 8, 2025 🙏
Heavenly Father,
Today, I choose to move beyond religion and pursue a real relationship with You. Break every mindset that has kept me bound in routine. Help me seek You daily, trust You fully, and follow You wholeheartedly. May my life be a reflection of Your love, grace, and truth.
In Jesus' name, Amen. ✝️

title: 🔥 CAN CHRISTIANS HAVE DEMONS? THE TRUTH YOU NEED TO KNOW! 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 CAN CHRISTIANS HAVE DEMONS? THE TRUTH YOU NEED TO KNOW! 🔥
📖 Ephesians 4:27 – "Do not give the devil a foothold."

Many Christians assume that once they accept Jesus, they are completely immune to demonic influence. They believe, “A Christian cannot have demons because the Holy Spirit lives in them.” But is that what the Bible actually teaches?
If Christians can’t have demons, why do so many struggle with addiction, depression, uncontrollable anger, lust, and spiritual oppression?
👉 This is a topic that most churches refuse to talk about—but the enemy doesn’t stop attacking just because you’re saved.
🚨 CAN A CHRISTIAN BE POSSESSED? CAN THEY BE DEMONIZED? OR IS IT SOMETHING ELSE? KEEP READING—THE TRUTH MAY SHOCK YOU!

🔥 1. CAN A CHRISTIAN BE POSSESSED? NO. BUT CAN THEY BE DEMONIZED? YES.
📖 Colossians 1:13 – "He has delivered us from the domain of darkness and transferred us to the kingdom of His beloved Son."

The Bible makes it clear that a true believer belongs to Christ. A Christian cannot be fully possessed by demons because they are no longer under Satan’s ownership. However, that does not mean they cannot be attacked, oppressed, or influenced by demons.
In the Greek New Testament, the word "daimonizomai" (δαιμονίζομαι) is often translated as "possessed by a demon," but it more accurately means to be under the influence or oppression of a demon.

🔥 A Christian can be:
✔️ Demonically oppressed – Constant spiritual heaviness, torment, and fear.
✔️ Demonically influenced – Struggling with thoughts and temptations from the enemy.
✔️ Demonically afflicted – Physical or mental affliction caused by demonic forces.
👉 A demon cannot take full control of a true believer, but it CAN oppress, influence, and attach itself to areas of sin, trauma, or spiritual weakness.

🔥 2. HOW DO DEMONS ATTACK CHRISTIANS?
📖 1 Peter 5:8 – "Be sober-minded; be watchful. Your adversary the devil prowls around like a roaring lion, seeking someone to devour."
Demons gain access to Christians when doors are left open. Here are some of the main ways demons attack believers:

🔴 UNREPENTED SIN – Willful sin creates an entry point for demonic activity.
📖 James 1:14-15 – "Each person is tempted when they are dragged away by their own evil desire and enticed. Then, after desire has conceived, it gives birth to sin; and sin, when it is full-grown, gives birth to death."

🔴 TRAUMA & UNFORGIVENESS – Emotional wounds, bitterness, and grudges give demons legal ground.
📖 Ephesians 4:31 – "Get rid of all bitterness, rage, and anger."

🔴 OCCULT INVOLVEMENT – Witchcraft, horoscopes, false religions, and superstitions open spiritual doors.
📖 Deuteronomy 18:10-12 – "Let no one be found among you who practices divination or sorcery."

🔴 NEGATIVE SPOKEN WORDS & CURSES – Words carry spiritual power.
📖 Proverbs 18:21 – "The tongue has the power of life and death."

🔴 SEXUAL SIN – Fornication, pornography, and adultery create spiritual bonds with darkness.
📖 1 Corinthians 6:18 – "Flee from sexual immorality. All other sins a person commits are outside the body, but whoever sins sexually sins against their own body."
🚨 A demon cannot just “jump” into a Christian. It needs a legal right—an open door. And many believers are unknowingly inviting demonic attacks!

🔥 3. BIBLICAL PROOF THAT DEMONS ATTACK BELIEVERS
Some people say, "A Christian can’t have demons!" but the Bible tells a different story.

🔴 KING SAUL – Oppressed by an evil spirit after rebelling against God.
📖 1 Samuel 16:14 – "Now the Spirit of the Lord had departed from Saul, and an evil spirit from the Lord tormented him."

🔴 PETER – Influenced by Satan to speak against Jesus' mission.
📖 Matthew 16:23 – "Jesus turned and said to Peter, ‘Get behind me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to me.’"

🔴 ANANIAS & SAPPHIRA – Filled with Satan’s deception, even though they were part of the church.
📖 Acts 5:3 – "Peter said, ‘Ananias, why has Satan filled your heart to lie to the Holy Spirit?’"

🔴 PAUL – Afflicted by a demonic "thorn in the flesh."
📖 2 Corinthians 12:7 – "A messenger of Satan was given to torment me, to keep me from becoming conceited."
🚨 If demons could attack God’s people in the Bible, what makes you think they can’t attack Christians today?

🔥 4. HOW CAN A CHRISTIAN BE DELIVERED FROM DEMONIC ATTACKS?
📖 James 4:7 – "Submit to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you."
If you feel tormented, oppressed, or under spiritual attack, there is freedom in Jesus!

🔥 STEPS TO DELIVERANCE:
✔️ REPENT & RENOUNCE SIN – Close every door by turning away from sinful habits.
📖 Acts 3:19 – "Repent, then, and turn to God, so that your sins may be wiped out."

✔️ BREAK UNHOLY TIES – Renounce all past occult practices, soul ties, and demonic agreements.
📖 2 Corinthians 6:17 – "Come out from among them and be separate, says the Lord."

✔️ FORGIVE & LET GO OF BITTERNESS – Release all anger and unforgiveness.
📖 Matthew 6:14 – "If you forgive others, your heavenly Father will also forgive you."

✔️ FAST & PRAY FOR DELIVERANCE – Some demonic strongholds require fasting.
📖 Mark 9:29 – "This kind can only come out by prayer and fasting."

✔️ FILL YOURSELF WITH GOD’S WORD – Replace lies with biblical truth.
📖 Ephesians 6:17 – "Take the sword of the Spirit, which is the Word of God."

✔️ SURROUND YOURSELF WITH SPIRITUAL WARFARE – Worship, prayer, and godly community.
📖 2 Corinthians 10:4 – "The weapons of our warfare are not carnal but mighty through God for the pulling down of strongholds."

🔥 FINAL WARNING: DON’T IGNORE THE ENEMY!
📖 2 Corinthians 2:11 – "Lest Satan should take advantage of us, for we are not ignorant of his devices."
Satan’s greatest trick is convincing believers that he has no influence over them. But the Bible warns us to be alert!

💡 REAL-LIFE DECISION:
✔️ Will you recognize the enemy’s attacks and fight back in the name of Jesus?
❌ Or will you stay in spiritual blindness, allowing Satan to have a foothold in your life?
📖 Luke 10:19 – "I have given you authority to trample on snakes and scorpions and to overcome all the power of the enemy."
👉 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?

🙏 POWERFUL PRAYER FOR DELIVERANCE 🙏
"Lord Jesus, I renounce every sin, every stronghold, and every open door that has allowed the enemy into my life. I break all demonic influence in the name of Jesus! Fill me with Your Spirit and protect me from all evil. In Jesus’ name, AMEN!"
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: THE DAYS OF NOAH ARE HERE—VIOLENCE, PERVERSION, AND GLOBAL REBELLION!
paragraphs:
THE DAYS OF NOAH ARE HERE—VIOLENCE, PERVERSION, AND GLOBAL REBELLION!
📖 Matthew 24:37 – "As it was in the days of Noah, so it will be at the coming of the Son of Man."

Jesus warned us that before His return, the world would look just like it did in the days of Noah.
Look around—what do you see?
A world full of violence.
A society drowning in perversion.
A generation that has turned its back on God.
🚨 We are living in the final moments before judgment. The signs are all around us, yet most people are too distracted to see it.
👉 DON’T BE BLIND TO WHAT’S HAPPENING! READ THIS BEFORE IT’S TOO LATE!

1. THE WORLD IS FILLED WITH VIOLENCE—JUST LIKE IN NOAH’S TIME
📖 Genesis 6:11 – "Now the earth was corrupt in God’s sight, and the earth was filled with violence."

In Noah’s day, the world was drowning in violence, and God had had enough.
Today, history is repeating itself.

🔴 Wars and rumors of wars—Nations are rising against nations.
🔴 Mass shootings, murders, riots—Life has lost its value.
🔴 Lawlessness is increasing—Evil is celebrated, and justice is ignored.

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
Turn on the news. What do you see? Death, destruction, and hatred spreading like wildfire.
People are more outraged over hurt feelings than over innocent lives being taken.
📖 2 Timothy 3:1-3 – "In the last days, people will be lovers of themselves, boastful, proud, abusive, without love, brutal, and treacherous."
👉 When a society rejects God, violence takes over. And today, we are drowning in it.

2. PERVERSION AND SEXUAL SIN HAVE TAKEN OVER—JUST LIKE IN NOAH’S TIME
📖 Genesis 6:5 – "The Lord saw that the wickedness of man was great in the earth, and that every intention of the thoughts of his heart was only evil continually."

Noah’s generation was consumed by sin, lust, and immorality.
The world today is no different.

🔴 LGBTQ+ agenda pushed on children—Confusion is being normalized.
🔴 Pornography addiction destroying marriages—Lust is celebrated as "freedom."
🔴 Sexual sin everywhere—Casual hookups, adultery, and perversion are glorified.

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
People today parade their sin in the streets, demanding that others celebrate it.
What God calls an abomination (Leviticus 18:22), the world calls "progress."
📖 Romans 1:24-27 – "Because of this, God gave them over to shameful lusts... men committed shameful acts with other men and received in themselves the due penalty for their error."
👉 When a society embraces sin, God eventually hands them over to it.

3. THE WORLD HAS REJECTED GOD AND HIS TRUTH—JUST LIKE IN NOAH’S TIME
📖 Genesis 6:3 – "My Spirit shall not strive with man forever."

Before the flood, people ignored Noah’s warnings. They mocked him, continued in sin, and lived as if judgment would never come.
The same is happening today.

🔴 The Bible is banned in schools, but sin is promoted.
🔴 Christians are mocked for standing for truth, but wickedness is celebrated.
🔴 People openly blaspheme God without fear of judgment.

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
Noah preached for 120 years. Not a single person repented.
Today, the world laughs at those who preach repentance, just like they laughed at Noah—until the rain began to fall.
📖 2 Peter 3:3-4 – "In the last days, scoffers will come, saying, ‘Where is this coming He promised?’"
👉 The same world that rejected Noah’s warnings is rejecting the warnings today. But judgment is coming.

4. GOD’S JUDGMENT IS COMING—JUST LIKE IN NOAH’S TIME
📖 Matthew 24:39 – "They knew nothing about what would happen until the flood came and took them all away."

The people in Noah’s time didn’t believe judgment was coming—until it was too late.
They ignored the warnings, and the flood destroyed them all.

🔴 Today, God is warning the world again.
🔴 The flood of judgment is coming—not with water, but with fire.
🔴 Jesus is coming soon, and this time, there will be no second chances.

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
Just like in Noah’s day, the warnings are everywhere.
The signs are clear.
But most people refuse to listen.
📖 2 Thessalonians 1:8-9 – "He will punish those who do not know God and do not obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus."
👉 When the floodgates of God’s judgment open, there will be no escape.

5. THE DOOR OF SALVATION WILL SOON CLOSE—JUST LIKE IN NOAH’S TIME
📖 Genesis 7:16 – "Then the Lord shut him in."

When the rain started, it was too late.
The door to the ark was shut by God Himself—and no one else could enter.

🔴 Today, Jesus is the ark.
🔴 The door is still open—but not for long.
🔴 Once it closes, there will be no second chances.

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
People mock the return of Jesus just like they mocked Noah.
But when the trumpet sounds, their laughter will turn into screams.
📖 Luke 13:25 – "Once the owner of the house gets up and closes the door, you will stand outside knocking and pleading, ‘Lord, open the door for us!’ But He will answer, ‘I don’t know you.’"
👉 Are you inside the ark, or will you be left outside?

FINAL WARNING: DON’T WAIT UNTIL IT’S TOO LATE!
📖 Hebrews 3:15 – "Today, if you hear His voice, do not harden your hearts."

🔥 THE WORLD IS DROWNING IN SIN—BUT JESUS IS THE ONLY WAY TO BE SAVED!
❌ Don’t be like those who ignored Noah’s warnings.
❌ Don’t wait until the rain starts falling.
❌ Don’t gamble with your soul.

💡 REAL-LIFE DECISION:
You have two choices:
✔️ Surrender to Jesus and be saved.
❌ Ignore the warnings and face judgment.
📖 Romans 10:9 – "If you confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God raised Him from the dead, you will be saved."
👉 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?

POWERFUL PRAYER TO ESCAPE GOD’S JUDGMENT
"Lord Jesus, I repent of my sins. I see the signs, and I know You are coming soon. I don’t want to be left outside when the door closes. Save me, change me, and make me ready for Your return. In Jesus’ name, AMEN."
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: 🔥 "THE MARK OF THE BEAST IS COMING – MOST WILL TAKE IT WITHOUT KNOWING!" 🚀🔥
paragraphs: 🔥 "THE MARK OF THE BEAST IS COMING – MOST WILL TAKE IT WITHOUT KNOWING!" 🚀🔥

📖 Revelation 13:16-17 – "And he causes all, both small and great, rich and poor, free and slave, to receive a mark on their right hand or on their forehead, so that no one may buy or sell unless he has the mark—the name of the beast or the number of its name."

🚨 The Bible warns that a time is coming when the Antichrist will rise, and the whole world will be forced to take the Mark of the Beast. But what exactly is this mark? Will it be a microchip, a tattoo, or something more deceptive? And why will most people take it without even realizing it?
The time is near. The warning is clear. Are you ready?

🔥 1. WHAT IS THE MARK OF THE BEAST?
The Bible describes the Mark of the Beast as a mandatory identifier that people will need to buy or sell.
📖 Revelation 14:9-10 – "If anyone worships the beast and its image and receives its mark on his forehead or on his hand, he will also drink the wine of God’s wrath."
🚨 This is NOT just an economic system—it is a mark of loyalty to the Antichrist.

🔥 Possible forms of the Mark:
❌ A digital implant or microchip used for transactions.
❌ A biometric scan or digital ID required to access money or services.
❌ A symbolic pledge of allegiance to the world’s final dictator.
🔥 One thing is certain: Those who take the mark are pledging allegiance to Satan’s kingdom!

🔥 2. WHY WILL MOST PEOPLE TAKE IT WITHOUT KNOWING?
📖 2 Corinthians 4:4 – "The god of this world has blinded the minds of unbelievers."
✅ The Mark of the Beast will NOT be forced at first—it will be introduced as a convenient solution to global problems.

🚨 Here’s how people will be deceived:
✔️ A global crisis (economic collapse, war, or pandemic) will create chaos.
✔️ A new financial system will be introduced to "fix" the crisis.
✔️ The world will be told: "You must comply to participate in society."
📖 1 Thessalonians 5:3 – "For when they say, ‘Peace and safety!’ then sudden destruction will come upon them."
🔥 Most people will take the mark willingly—believing it’s for their own good.

🔥 3. THE MARK IS DIRECTLY CONNECTED TO WORSHIP
📖 Revelation 13:15 – "And the image of the beast was allowed to speak and to cause all who would not worship the image of the beast to be slain."
🚨 Taking the Mark is not just about buying and selling—it is about worship.

✅ The Bible makes it clear: Those who take the mark will be pledging their allegiance to the Beast (Antichrist).
✅ It will not just be an economic decision—it will be a spiritual decision.
✅ This is why those who take the mark CANNOT be saved!

📖 Revelation 14:11 – "And the smoke of their torment goes up forever and ever, and they have no rest, day or night, these worshipers of the beast and its image, and whoever receives the mark of its name."
🚨 Taking the mark is permanent! There is no repentance after receiving it!

🔥 4. WHAT ABOUT BELIEVERS? WILL WE BE FORCED TO TAKE IT?
📖 Revelation 3:10 – "Because you have kept My word about patient endurance, I will keep you from the hour of trial that is coming on the whole world."
🔥 True believers in Christ will refuse the mark!

✅ Many will be persecuted, imprisoned, or even killed for rejecting it.
✅ The Bible warns that those who refuse the mark will be unable to buy or sell.
✅ But GOD will provide for His people!
📖 Matthew 6:31-33 – "Do not be anxious, saying, ‘What shall we eat?’ or ‘What shall we drink?’… But seek first the kingdom of God, and all these things will be added to you."
🚨 Do NOT fear the world—FEAR GOD! He will take care of His children.

🔥 5. WHAT CAN YOU DO TO AVOID THE MARK OF THE BEAST?
📖 Revelation 13:9 – "If anyone has an ear, let him hear!"

🔥 1. Give your life FULLY to Jesus Christ now!
✔️ Salvation is found ONLY in Jesus (John 14:6).
✔️ If you are not born again, you will be deceived by the Antichrist.

🔥 2. Know the Word of God!
✔️ Many will be deceived because they don’t know Scripture (Hosea 4:6).
✔️ Test everything against God’s Word!

🔥 3. Be willing to suffer for Christ!
✔️ The world will pressure you to conform—but stand firm! (Romans 12:2)
✔️ Be prepared to lose everything rather than deny Jesus.

title: 🔥 DID JESUS REALLY CLAIM TO BE GOD? YES, AND HERE’S THE PROOF! 🚨🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 DID JESUS REALLY CLAIM TO BE GOD? YES, AND HERE’S THE PROOF! 🚨🔥
📖 John 10:30 – "I and the Father are one."
🚨 Many false teachers, cults, and skeptics say, “Jesus never claimed to be God.” But the Bible tells a different story!

🔥 THE WORLD SAYS: "Jesus was just a prophet, a teacher, or a good man!"
🔥 THE BIBLE SAYS: "In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word WAS GOD!" (John 1:1)
👉 IF JESUS NEVER CLAIMED TO BE GOD, WHY DID THE RELIGIOUS LEADERS WANT HIM KILLED? READ THIS BEFORE YOU FALL FOR THE LIE!

🔥 1. JESUS CLAIMED TO BE GOD—AND THE RELIGIOUS LEADERS KNEW IT!
📖 John 10:33 – "We are not stoning you for any good work," they replied, "but for blasphemy, because you, a mere man, CLAIM TO BE GOD!"

🔥 WHAT JESUS SAID VS. HOW PEOPLE REACTED:
✔️ Jesus said, "I and the Father are one." (John 10:30)
✔️ The Jews IMMEDIATELY picked up stones to kill Him for blasphemy!
🚨 IF JESUS WAS JUST CLAIMING TO BE A PROPHET, WHY DID THEY WANT HIM DEAD?

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
Imagine someone in a courtroom saying, "I am the President of the United States!" If it were a joke, people would laugh. But if they were SERIOUS, they would be arrested for impersonation!
📖 John 8:58 – "Before Abraham was born, I AM!"
👉 JESUS USED THE SAME NAME GOD USED FOR HIMSELF IN EXODUS 3:14—"I AM THAT I AM!"

🔥 2. JESUS ACCEPTED WORSHIP—AND ONLY GOD CAN BE WORSHIPED!
📖 Matthew 14:33 – "Then those who were in the boat worshiped Him, saying, ‘Truly you are the Son of God!’"

🔥 BIBLICAL TRUTH:
✔️ Angels REFUSED worship! (Revelation 22:8-9 – "Do not worship me! Worship God!")
✔️ The apostles REFUSED worship! (Acts 10:25-26 – "Stand up! I am only a man myself!")
✔️ But Jesus ACCEPTED worship—because He IS God!
🚨 IF JESUS WASN’T GOD, HE WOULD HAVE REBUKED PEOPLE FOR WORSHIPING HIM!

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
If someone bowed before a true man of God, that preacher would IMMEDIATELY tell them, "Get up! Worship God alone!" But Jesus never stopped people from worshiping Him.
📖 John 20:28 – "Thomas said to Him, ‘My Lord and my God!’"
👉 THOMAS CALLED JESUS "GOD"—AND JESUS DIDN’T CORRECT HIM!

🔥 3. JESUS CLAIMED TO FORGIVE SINS—SOMETHING ONLY GOD CAN DO!
📖 Mark 2:5-7 – "When Jesus saw their faith, He said to the paralyzed man, ‘Son, your sins are forgiven.’ The teachers of the law thought, ‘Why does this fellow talk like that? He’s blaspheming! Who can forgive sins but God alone?’"

🔥 THINK ABOUT IT:
✔️ If someone steals your car, can I forgive them? NO! Only YOU can forgive them!
✔️ Jesus forgave sins—because He is the One we sin against!
🚨 THE RELIGIOUS LEADERS KNEW THIS MEANT JESUS WAS CLAIMING TO BE GOD!

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
Imagine a judge in court saying, "I forgive all criminals in this city!" The world would say, "Who do you think you are? Only the law can do that!"
📖 Isaiah 43:25 – "I, even I, am He who blots out your transgressions."
👉 JESUS DID WHAT ONLY GOD CAN DO—FORGIVE SINS!

🔥 4. THE DISCIPLES AND APOSTLES PREACHED THAT JESUS IS GOD!
📖 Colossians 2:9 – "For in Christ all the fullness of Deity lives in bodily form."

🔥 DID THE EARLY CHRISTIANS BELIEVE JESUS WAS GOD? YES!
✔️ John 1:1 – "The Word was God."
✔️ Titus 2:13 – "Jesus Christ, our great God and Savior."
✔️ Hebrews 1:8 – "But about the Son He says, ‘Your throne, O GOD, will last forever and ever!’"
🚨 IF JESUS WAS JUST A PROPHET, WHY DID THE APOSTLES PREACH THAT HE WAS GOD?

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A false teacher once said, "Jesus never claimed to be God!" But when shown these verses, he had no answer—because the Bible is CLEAR!
📖 Philippians 2:6 – "Who, being in very nature God, did not consider equality with God something to be used to His own advantage."
👉 JESUS WAS FULLY GOD AND FULLY MAN!

🔥 5. IF JESUS ISN’T GOD, THEN HE DIED FOR NOTHING!
📖 1 John 2:2 – "He is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not only for ours but also for the sins of the whole world."

🔥 WHY DOES THIS MATTER?
✔️ If Jesus was just a man, His death would mean NOTHING!
✔️ Only God’s blood can pay for the sins of the world!
✔️ If Jesus wasn’t God, then Christianity is a LIE!
🚨 BUT JESUS CONQUERED DEATH AND PROVED HE IS GOD!

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
Buddha is dead. Muhammad is dead. Every religious leader is dead. BUT JESUS ROSE FROM THE DEAD—BECAUSE HE IS GOD!
📖 Revelation 1:17-18 – "I am the First and the Last. I was dead, and now look, I am alive forever and ever!"
👉 ONLY GOD HAS POWER OVER LIFE AND DEATH!

🔥 FINAL WARNING: YOU MUST CHOOSE—IS JESUS GOD OR JUST A MAN?
📖 John 8:24 – "If you do not believe that I AM, you will die in your sins."

🔥 THERE ARE ONLY THREE OPTIONS:
❌ 1. Jesus was a liar. (Impossible—His words have changed the world!)
❌ 2. Jesus was insane. (Impossible—His wisdom surpasses all men!)
✅ 3. Jesus is LORD! (The ONLY truth that makes sense!)
🚨 WHAT YOU BELIEVE ABOUT JESUS DETERMINES YOUR ETERNITY!

🔥 REAL-LIFE DECISION:
You have two choices:
✔️ Believe Jesus is God, repent, and be saved!
❌ Reject the truth and face judgment!
📖 Romans 10:9 – "If you confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God raised Him from the dead, you will be saved."
👉 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?

🙏 POWERFUL PRAYER TO SURRENDER TO JESUS!
"Lord Jesus, I believe You are God! I repent of my sins and surrender my life to You. Be my Lord and Savior. Open my eyes to Your truth! In Jesus’ name, AMEN!" 🙏🔥

title: "The Truth About Giving – It’s Not About Money, It’s About Your Heart" 🔥
paragraphs:
"The Truth About Giving – It’s Not About Money, It’s About Your Heart" 🔥
✝️ A Message from Brother John Domino "PiX" S. Asis – Follower of Jesus Christ and a Servant of God
🌍 Many Christians have been misled about giving.
Churches today often focus on tithes and offerings, making people believe that giving is all about money. But is this what Jesus taught?
📖 “Offer your bodies as a living sacrifice, holy and pleasing to God—this is your true and proper worship.” (Romans 12:1)
💡 Giving is not just about money—it’s about your life, your heart, your devotion to God.

🔥 1. The True Meaning of Giving in the Bible
Many pastors and church leaders today have turned giving into a business instead of an act of worship. But God never needed our money—He wants our hearts.
📖 Mark 12:41-44 – The Widow’s Offering

Jesus saw a poor widow give two small coins while others gave large amounts.
He praised her, not because of the amount, but because she gave out of faith and love for God.
God does not measure giving by money, but by the heart and faith behind it.
🚨 Too many churches today teach that financial giving is a requirement to be blessed—but the Bible says blessings come from obedience, not just money.

🔥 2. The Parable of the Talents – It’s Not About Money!
Many people believe the Parable of the Talents is about investing money, but that is a misunderstanding.
📖 Matthew 25:14-30 – The Parable of the Talents

Jesus gave one servant five talents, another two talents, and another one talent.
The first two used and multiplied what was given to them, and they were rewarded.
The last servant hid his talent and was rebuked.
💡 The lesson here is not about money—it’s about faithfulness to what God has given you.
✅ What do "talents" represent?

Your gifts and abilities – Are you using them for God’s glory?
Your time – Are you dedicating time to serve God and help others?
Your devotion – Are you faithful in prayer and obedience?
🚨 Many people are wasting their God-given talents, time, and opportunities—don’t be that person!

🔥 3. What Does "10% Giving" Truly Mean?
Many churches only emphasize tithing money, but God wants more than just 10% of your salary.
✅ Instead of just 10% of your money, God wants 100% of your life.
📖 Colossians 3:23 – "Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for the Lord, not for men."
✅ True biblical giving includes:

10% of your time – Spend time in prayer, Bible study, and worship.
10% of your devotion – Serve God by helping others, sharing His Word, and living righteously.
10% of your talents – Use your abilities for God’s glory, not just for yourself.
🚨 Giving money without giving your heart means nothing to God.
Example:

A man gives 10% of his salary to church but never prays, never reads the Bible, and doesn’t live righteously. ❌
Another man spends time praying, reading the Bible, helping others, and using his talents for God, even though he cannot give much money. ✅
💡 Who do you think truly gives to God? The second man! Because God desires our hearts, not just our wallets.

🔥 4. The Danger of Abusing Tithes and Offerings
Sadly, many pastors and church leaders abuse tithing, using it for personal gain instead of God’s work.
📖 2 Peter 2:1-3 – "There will be false teachers among you. They will exploit you with false words, making money out of you."
📖 Matthew 21:12-13 – Jesus drove out the money changers from the temple because they turned God’s house into a business.
🚨 Signs of a False Pastor or Church Leader:

Preaches about money more than Jesus.
Focuses on financial blessings instead of spiritual growth.
Lives in luxury while church members struggle.
✅ A True Pastor or Church Leader Should:

Teach giving with sincerity, not manipulation.
Encourage people to give their time, devotion, and service, not just money.
Focus on helping others, not enriching themselves.
💡 If your pastor makes Christianity all about money, RUN.

🔥 5. What Does God Truly Want From You?
God is not after your bank account—He’s after your heart.
📖 Matthew 6:33 – "Seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness, and all these things will be added to you."
✅ True Giving According to the Bible:

Give your TIME – Pray, read the Bible, and seek God.
Give your TALENTS – Use your gifts for God’s Kingdom.
Give your LOVE – Help others and show Christ’s love.
💡 If you truly love God, your life will reflect it—not just your money.
🚨 Don’t be deceived by pastors who make Christianity about money.

📜 FAITH DECLARATION FOR JANUARY 17, 2025 📜
"Today, I commit to giving my whole life to God—not just my money. I will serve Him with my time, talents, and devotion. I refuse to be deceived by false teachings about money. My heart belongs to Jesus!"

🔥 THE “TRUE GIVING” CHALLENGE 🔥
✅ Step 1: Spend time with God today – Pray and read His Word.
✅ Step 2: Use your talents for His glory – Serve in ministry, help someone, or share your faith.
✅ Step 3: Give in secret – Bless someone without expecting anything in return.

🌌 GIVE GOD YOUR HEART, NOT JUST YOUR MONEY 🌌
📖 “The greatest commandment is to love the Lord your God with all your heart, soul, and strength.” (Matthew 22:37)
👉 Give your life to God, and He will take care of the rest.

🙏 PRAYER FOR JANUARY 17, 2025 🙏
Heavenly Father,
Thank You for showing me that true giving is about my heart, not just my finances. I give You my life, my time, and my talents. Help me to honor You with everything I have. Protect me from deception, and use me to serve Your Kingdom.
In Jesus’ name, Amen. ✝️

title: 🔥 "IS 'ONCE SAVED, ALWAYS SAVED' A LIE?" 🚀🔥
paragraphs: 🔥 "IS 'ONCE SAVED, ALWAYS SAVED' A LIE?" 🚀🔥
📖 Hebrews 10:26 – "For if we deliberately go on sinning after we have received the knowledge of the truth, no sacrifice for sins is left."
Many Christians today believe in the doctrine of "Once Saved, Always Saved" (OSAS)—the idea that once a person accepts Jesus, they can NEVER lose their salvation, no matter how they live.
But is this really what the Bible teaches?

Can a believer walk away from God, return to sin, and still be saved?
Or does the Bible warn about falling away and losing salvation?
🚨 The truth may shock you! Let’s dive into Scripture and expose the reality behind this doctrine.

🔥 1. CAN A CHRISTIAN LOSE THEIR SALVATION?
📖 2 Peter 2:20-21 – "For if, after they have escaped the defilements of the world through the knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they are again entangled in them and overcome, the last state has become worse for them than the first. For it would have been better for them never to have known the way of righteousness than after knowing it to turn back."
🔥 Peter is clear: It is possible to be saved, then turn back to sin and be in a worse condition than before.
🚨 If OSAS is true, why does the Bible repeatedly warn believers about falling away?

🔥 2. WHAT DID JESUS SAY?
📖 John 15:5-6 – "I am the vine; you are the branches. If you remain in Me and I in you, you will bear much fruit… If anyone does not remain in Me, he is thrown away like a branch and withers; and the branches are gathered, thrown into the fire, and burned."
🔥 Jesus says you must REMAIN in Him. If you don’t, you will be CUT OFF and burned.
✅ A believer must stay connected to Jesus—faith is not a one-time event but a lifelong commitment.
🚨 If "Once Saved, Always Saved" was true, why would Jesus warn about being cut off?

🔥 3. CAN YOU BE ERASED FROM THE BOOK OF LIFE?
📖 Revelation 3:5 – "The one who conquers will be clothed thus in white garments, and I will never blot his name out of the Book of Life."
🚨 This verse implies that some names CAN be blotted out!
🔥 If salvation was permanent no matter what, why would Jesus even mention this possibility?
📖 Exodus 32:33 – "The Lord said to Moses, ‘Whoever has sinned against Me, I will blot out of My book.’"
✅ Salvation is a gift—but you can forfeit it through rebellion and unbelief.

🔥 4. WARNING: YOU CAN FALL AWAY FROM THE FAITH!
📖 Hebrews 6:4-6 – "For it is impossible, in the case of those who have once been enlightened, who have tasted the heavenly gift, and have shared in the Holy Spirit… and then have fallen away, to restore them again to repentance."

🔥 This verse speaks of people who were:
✔️ Enlightened (understood the gospel).
✔️ Tasted the heavenly gift (experienced salvation).
✔️ Shared in the Holy Spirit (were truly saved).
✔️ Then fell away!
🚨 If OSAS was true, why does the Bible say some people fall away and cannot be restored?

🔥 5. WHAT ABOUT ‘NO ONE CAN SNATCH THEM FROM GOD’S HAND’ (JOHN 10:28)?
Many use this verse to defend OSAS:
📖 John 10:28 – "I give them eternal life, and they will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of My hand."

✅ This is true—Satan and others cannot steal you from God.
🚨 BUT IT DOESN’T SAY YOU CAN’T WALK AWAY!
🔥 God will never force you to stay if you choose to rebel.
📖 Luke 15:11-32 – The Prodigal Son willingly left the Father’s house. He was only restored when he REPENTED and returned!

🔥 6. FAITH REQUIRES ENDURANCE – NOT A ONE-TIME DECISION!
📖 Matthew 24:13 – "But the one who endures to the end will be saved."
✅ Salvation is not about how you START—it’s about how you FINISH.
🚨 If salvation was guaranteed, why does Jesus say we must ENDURE?
📖 Philippians 2:12 – "Work out your own salvation with fear and trembling."
🔥 Salvation is not a casual thing—it requires commitment, perseverance, and obedience.

🔥 7. HOW TO REMAIN IN CHRIST AND STAY SAVED!
📖 Hebrews 3:14 – "For we have come to share in Christ, IF indeed we hold our original confidence firm to the end."
🔥 Follow these steps to ensure you remain in Christ:

✅ Stay in the Word (Psalm 119:11)
✅ Keep a strong prayer life (1 Thessalonians 5:17)
✅ Repent quickly when you sin (1 John 1:9)
✅ Remain in fellowship with true believers (Hebrews 10:25)
✅ Endure persecution and trials for Christ (James 1:12)
🚨 Do NOT be deceived—salvation requires faithfulness to the end!

🔥 FINAL CONCLUSION: SALVATION CAN BE LOST IF YOU ABANDON CHRIST!
✅ "Once Saved, Always Saved" is a dangerous false doctrine.
✅ The Bible warns about falling away, being cut off, and names being erased from the Book of Life.
✅ Salvation requires faithfulness, endurance, and obedience—not just a one-time prayer.
✅ No one can steal you from God’s hand, but you can walk away through rebellion and unbelief.
🚨 DON’T PLAY WITH YOUR SALVATION—STAY FAITHFUL TO JESUS UNTIL THE END!

✅ 👍 CLICK LIKE if this teaching opened your eyes!
✅ ❤️ CLICK HEART if you will remain in Christ until the end!
📢 🚨 WARNING: Many are being deceived into thinking they can live however they want and still go to heaven. SHARE THIS NOW to spread the truth!

🙏 PRAYER FOR ENDURANCE
Heavenly Father, I thank You for the gift of salvation. Help me to remain faithful and endure until the end. Keep me from deception, rebellion, and falling away. Strengthen my faith, and let me walk in obedience to Your Word. I choose to stay with You, Lord, no matter what. In Jesus’ name, AMEN! 🙏🔥

title: "Satan Doesn’t Want You to Read This – Exposing His Biggest Lies" 🔥
paragraphs:
"Satan Doesn’t Want You to Read This – Exposing His Biggest Lies" 🔥
✝️ A Message from Brother John Domino "PiX" S. Asis – Follower of Jesus Christ and a Servant of God
🌍 Deception is everywhere. Are you being fooled?
Satan is called the father of lies (John 8:44), and he has been deceiving humanity since the beginning of time.
📖 “And no wonder, for Satan himself masquerades as an angel of light.” (2 Corinthians 11:14)
🚨 He won’t come to you with red horns and a pitchfork—he comes disguised as truth.
💡 If you don’t know his strategies, you are at risk of falling for them.

🔥 1. Satan’s Goal: Keep You Blind to the Truth
The devil’s greatest weapon isn’t power—it’s deception.
📖 “Be alert and of sober mind. Your enemy the devil prowls around like a roaring lion looking for someone to devour.” (1 Peter 5:8)
💡 If you know his lies, you can defeat him with the truth!
🚨 Here are Satan’s biggest lies that are destroying lives today.

🔥 2. The Biggest Lies Satan Wants You to Believe
1️⃣ "There’s No Such Thing as Satan or Hell"
One of Satan’s greatest tricks is convincing people he doesn’t exist.
If people don’t believe in him, they won’t resist him.
📖 “The god of this world has blinded the minds of unbelievers, so they cannot see the light of the gospel.” (2 Corinthians 4:4)
🚨 Truth: Satan is real. Hell is real. And without Jesus, people are headed there.

2️⃣ "You Have Plenty of Time to Get Right With God"
The devil loves procrastination—he convinces people to delay repentance.
Many die unexpectedly, still thinking they had ‘more time.’
📖 “You do not know what tomorrow will bring. What is your life? You are a mist that appears for a little time and then vanishes.” (James 4:14)
🚨 Truth: Tomorrow is not promised—repent and follow Jesus today!

3️⃣ "You Can Be a ‘Good Person’ Without Jesus"
Many believe “I’m a good person, so I’ll go to heaven.”
But NO ONE is good enough—only Jesus saves!
📖 “There is no one righteous, not even one.” (Romans 3:10)
🚨 Truth: Your good deeds can never save you—only faith in Jesus Christ can.

4️⃣ "You Can Live However You Want and Still Go to Heaven"
Many think they can live in sin and still inherit God’s Kingdom.
But the Bible is clear: A transformed life is proof of true faith.
📖 “Do not be deceived: neither the sexually immoral, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor men who practice homosexuality, nor thieves, nor the greedy, nor drunkards, nor slanderers, nor swindlers will inherit the kingdom of God.” (1 Corinthians 6:9-10)
🚨 Truth: Real salvation produces real change—if Jesus saved you, your life will show it!

5️⃣ "All Religions Lead to God"
Many believe “all religions worship the same God.”
But Jesus Himself said there is ONLY ONE WAY to God.
📖 “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.” (John 14:6)
🚨 Truth: Jesus is the ONLY way to heaven. No religion, no good works—only Him.

6️⃣ "Sin Isn’t a Big Deal – God Will Forgive You Anyway"
Satan loves when people treat sin lightly and live carelessly.
He whispers, “It’s just a small sin, God won’t mind.”
📖 “Shall we go on sinning so that grace may increase? By no means! We are those who have died to sin; how can we live in it any longer?” (Romans 6:1-2)
🚨 Truth: Sin separates you from God—repent and walk in righteousness.

7️⃣ "The Bible is Outdated – Follow Your Own Truth"
Today’s world rejects the Bible and promotes “live your truth.”
Satan knows that when people stop reading the Word, they lose discernment.
📖 “The grass withers and the flowers fade, but the Word of our God stands forever.” (Isaiah 40:8)
🚨 Truth: The Bible is eternal—culture changes, but God’s Word never does.

🔥 3. How to Defeat Satan’s Lies
1️⃣ Know the Word of God
The Bible is your weapon against deception.
Jesus defeated Satan’s temptations by quoting Scripture.
📖 “Take the helmet of salvation and the sword of the Spirit, which is the Word of God.” (Ephesians 6:17)
🚨 The more you know God’s Word, the harder it is for Satan to fool you.

2️⃣ Stay Close to Jesus in Prayer
Satan attacks weak Christians who don’t pray.
Prayer connects you to God and strengthens your spirit.
📖 “Pray without ceasing.” (1 Thessalonians 5:17)
🚨 A prayerless Christian is a powerless Christian!

3️⃣ Surround Yourself with Strong Believers
The enemy targets those who isolate themselves.
Fellowship with true believers will keep you strong in faith.
📖 “Encourage one another and build each other up.” (1 Thessalonians 5:11)
🚨 Lone Christians are easy prey—stay connected to the Body of Christ!

📜 FAITH DECLARATION FOR JANUARY 19, 2025 📜
"Today, I choose to stand in truth and reject Satan’s lies. I will live by God’s Word, walk in holiness, and boldly expose deception. I belong to Jesus, and Satan has no power over me!"

🔥 THE “EXPOSE SATAN” CHALLENGE 🔥
✅ Step 1: Identify and reject any lies you’ve believed.
✅ Step 3: Encourage 3 friends to grow in truth and study God’s Word.

🌌 SATAN IS A LIAR – DON’T FALL FOR HIS TRICKS 🌌
📖 “You shall know the truth, and the truth shall set you free.” (John 8:32)

👉 The only way to defeat Satan’s deception is to know the truth.
👉 Are you ready to expose the enemy and walk in victory?

🙏 PRAYER FOR JANUARY 19, 2025 🙏
Heavenly Father,
Open my eyes to see the truth and reject every lie of the enemy. Fill me with discernment so I will not be deceived. Strengthen my faith, deepen my love for Your Word, and help me to boldly expose the devil’s tactics. I belong to You, Lord—keep me in Your truth!
In Jesus’ name, Amen. ✝️

title: 🔥 "ARE YOU FOLLOWING CHRIST—OR JUST FOLLOWING A CHURCH?" 🚀🔥
paragraphs: 🔥 "ARE YOU FOLLOWING CHRIST—OR JUST FOLLOWING A CHURCH?" 🚀🔥
📖 Matthew 16:24 – "Then Jesus told His disciples, ‘If anyone would come after Me, let him deny himself and take up his cross and follow Me.’"

🚨 Many churches today demand loyalty to their organization rather than to Jesus Christ.
🚨 They pressure people to stay, tithe only to them, and avoid other churches.

🔥 But what does the Bible really say?
🔥 Are we called to be loyal to a church—or to CHRIST ALONE?
Today, we will expose the truth and destroy the man-made rules that control believers.

🔥 1. DOES THE BIBLE SAY YOU MUST BELONG TO ONLY ONE CHURCH?
📖 1 Corinthians 12:12-14 – "For just as the body is one and has many members, and all the members of the body, though many, are one body, so it is with Christ."
🚨 Truth: The Bible teaches that ALL believers are members of the Body of Christ, NOT just one local church!
❌ Some pastors use Matthew 6:24 ("You cannot serve two masters") to say you must commit to only ONE church—but this verse is about serving God vs. money, NOT church membership!

✅ Biblical truth:
✔️ Paul ministered to multiple churches (Romans 16:5, Acts 16:5).
✔️ Early believers met in homes and gathered in different places (Acts 2:42-47).
✔️ Nowhere in Scripture does Jesus say, "You must belong to only one local church!"
🔥 Your loyalty is to Jesus—not an institution!

🔥 2. IS IT WRONG TO INVITE PEOPLE TO ANOTHER CHURCH?
📖 Galatians 1:8-9 – "If anyone is preaching to you a gospel contrary to the one you received, let him be accursed."
🚨 Truth: Many churches today protect their numbers instead of protecting the gospel.

❌ They say, "Don't invite members from other churches!"
❌ They make people feel guilty for leaving, even if the church is corrupt.

🔥 But Jesus constantly called people OUT of false religion!
✔️ He exposed the Pharisees (Matthew 23:13-15).
✔️ Paul warned against false teachers (2 Corinthians 6:17).
✔️ The Bible commands us to leave churches that compromise truth (Revelation 18:4).
🔥 The goal is to follow Christ—not defend a denomination!

🔥 3. SHOULD YOU STAY IN A CHURCH TO ‘HELP MAKE IT BETTER’ INSTEAD OF LEAVING?
📖 Revelation 2:5 – "Remember therefore from where you have fallen; repent, and do the works you did at first. If not, I will come to you and remove your lampstand from its place, unless you repent."
🚨 Truth: If a church is spiritually DEAD, staying won’t fix it!

✅ Jesus rebuked churches that strayed from the truth.
✅ He warned them to repent—or be removed!
✅ If a church refuses correction, believers must leave and go where the gospel is honored!
📖 2 John 1:10-11 – "If anyone comes to you and does not bring this teaching, do not receive him into your house or give him any greeting, for whoever greets him takes part in his wicked works."
🔥 If a church refuses to follow God's Word, staying there is spiritual suicide!

🔥 4. SHOULD YOU STOP LOOKING FOR A PERFECT CHURCH?
📖 2 Timothy 4:2-4 – "For the time is coming when people will not endure sound teaching… but will accumulate for themselves teachers to suit their own passions."
🚨 Truth: No church is perfect, but there is a difference between imperfection and corruption!

✅ If a church preaches the gospel and stays true to the Bible, support it!
❌ If a church teaches false doctrine, tolerates sin, or prioritizes man’s traditions, LEAVE!
🔥 Jesus is building HIS Church—not a building or a denomination! (Matthew 16:18)

🔥 5. WHERE SHOULD YOUR TITHES GO? ONLY TO YOUR CHURCH?
📖 2 Corinthians 9:7 – "Each one must give as he has decided in his heart, not reluctantly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver."
🚨 Truth: The Bible NEVER says tithes must go ONLY to a local church!

❌ Many churches misquote Malachi 3:10 to demand tithes—but this was part of the Old Testament law for ISRAEL!
✅ The New Testament teaches cheerful giving, not mandatory percentages (2 Corinthians 9:6-7).
✅ The early church supported missionaries, the poor, and gospel work (Acts 4:32-35, Galatians 6:6).
🔥 Tithing is about giving to GOD—not financing a church business!

🔥 6. SHOULD ONLY YOUR PASTOR OFFICIATE WEDDINGS & DEDICATIONS?
📖 Colossians 3:17 – "And whatever you do, in word or deed, do everything in the name of the Lord Jesus."
🚨 Truth: Marriage is before God, NOT a church institution!

✅ There is NO biblical rule that says only your pastor can officiate a wedding or child dedication.
✅ What matters is that the ceremony is done in faith and in accordance with God's Word.
✅ The early church did not require a specific pastor to be involved in these events.
🔥 Don’t let church traditions override biblical truth!

🔥 7. SHOULD YOU LEAVE A CHURCH IN ‘PEACE’—EVEN IF IT’S CORRUPT?
📖 Galatians 1:10 – "For am I now seeking the approval of man, or of God? Or am I trying to please man? If I were still trying to please man, I would not be a servant of Christ."

🚨 Truth: Some pastors say, "If you leave the wrong way, God won’t bless you."
❌ This is MANIPULATION, NOT Scripture!

✅ If a church is corrupt, believers must leave immediately (Revelation 18:4).
✅ You don’t owe a man-made system your loyalty—your loyalty is to CHRIST!
🔥 Don’t stay in a dead church out of fear—FOLLOW JESUS!

🙏 POWERFUL PRAYER FOR DISCERNMENT
"Lord Jesus, open my eyes to follow YOU, not just a religious system! Give me discernment to know when a church is honoring You—and when it is leading people astray. If I am in a place of compromise, give me the courage to leave and go where Your truth is preached. I choose You above all else! In Jesus’ name, AMEN!" 🙏🔥

title: 🔥 WHOEVER CAUSES A LITTLE ONE TO STUMBLE—JESUS' TERRIFYING WARNING! (MATTHEW 18:6) 🚨🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 WHOEVER CAUSES A LITTLE ONE TO STUMBLE—JESUS' TERRIFYING WARNING! (MATTHEW 18:6) 🚨🔥
📖 Matthew 18:6 – "But whoever causes one of these little ones who believe in Me to stumble, it would be better for him to have a heavy millstone hung around his neck, and to be drowned in the depth of the sea."

🚨 Jesus wasn’t playing around when it came to protecting the innocent. He gave one of the most terrifying warnings in all of Scripture: If you lead a child—or a baby Christian—into sin, you’re better off being drowned in the ocean!

🔥 THE WORLD SAYS: "Let people believe whatever they want!"
🔥 THE BIBLE SAYS: "Teach them the truth so they won’t fall away!" (Proverbs 22:6, Hebrews 5:12-14)
👉 Are you leading others toward Jesus, or are you allowing the world to corrupt them?

🔥 1. JESUS TAKES THE SPIRITUAL PROTECTION OF CHILDREN & BABY CHRISTIANS SERIOUSLY!
📖 Psalm 127:3 – "Children are a heritage from the Lord, offspring a reward from Him."
📖 1 Peter 2:2 – "Like newborn babies, crave pure spiritual milk, so that by it you may grow up in your salvation."

🔥 IN GOD’S EYES:
✅ Children are a blessing, not a burden.
✅ New believers (baby Christians) must be protected and guided.
✅ Those who mislead them will face judgment.

🚨 BUT LOOK AT THE WORLD TODAY!
❌ Schools are teaching kids to reject biblical truth.
❌ Media is poisoning young minds with sin and rebellion.
❌ Churches are failing to disciple new believers, leaving them vulnerable!

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
Many churches today do NOT disciple new believers properly. They get them saved but don’t teach them how to follow Jesus. As a result, they stay spiritually weak and are easily deceived by false teachers.
📖 Hosea 4:6 – "My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge."
🚨 IF JESUS WARNED AGAINST CAUSING CHILDREN TO STUMBLE, HOW MUCH MORE WILL HE JUDGE THOSE WHO DESTROY NEW BELIEVERS?

🔥 2. LEADING OTHERS INTO SIN BRINGS HEAVY JUDGMENT!
📖 Luke 17:2 – "It would be better for him to be thrown into the sea with a millstone around his neck than to cause one of these little ones to stumble."

🔥 WHAT DOES JESUS MEAN?
👉 A millstone was a massive stone used for grinding grain—it was HEAVY.
👉 Being drowned with one meant NO ESCAPE—CERTAIN DEATH.
👉 Jesus is saying that leading a child or a new believer into sin is SO SERIOUS that drowning would be a "lighter" punishment compared to what awaits in judgment!

🚨 WHO IS JESUS WARNING?
❌ People who expose children to sin and perversion.
❌ False teachers who deceive young believers.
❌ Christians who act hypocritically, causing others to lose faith.

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
Many new believers are excited about their faith, but when they see "Christians" living like the world—compromising, gossiping, acting selfishly—they become discouraged and fall away.
📖 Romans 14:13 – "Decide never to put a stumbling block or hindrance in the way of a brother."
👉 Will YOUR actions strengthen or weaken the faith of others?

🔥 3. PARENTS, TEACHERS, AND CHURCH LEADERS—YOU ARE ACCOUNTABLE!
📖 Proverbs 22:6 – "Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it."
📖 Hebrews 5:12 – "Though by this time you ought to be teachers, you need someone to teach you the elementary truths of God’s word all over again."
🚨 RAISING CHILDREN & DISCIPLING NEW BELIEVERS IS NOT OPTIONAL!

🔥 WHAT GOD EXPECTS FROM PARENTS & LEADERS:
✅ TEACH THEM GOD’S WORD—Not just on Sundays, but every day! (Deuteronomy 6:7)
✅ PROTECT THEM FROM CORRUPTION—Guard what they watch, hear, and learn! (Psalm 101:3)
✅ SHOW THEM HOW TO FOLLOW JESUS—Live the example, don’t just speak it! (1 Corinthians 11:1)
🚨 BUT IF YOU FAIL TO TEACH THEM, THE WORLD WILL!

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A new believer joins a church but is ignored, never discipled, and eventually goes back to their old sinful life because no one helped them grow.
📖 Ephesians 6:4 – "Do not provoke your children to wrath, but bring them up in the discipline and instruction of the Lord."
👉 DON’T LET THIS HAPPEN TO THOSE GOD HAS PLACED UNDER YOUR CARE!

🔥 4. SATAN WANTS TO DESTROY THE NEXT GENERATION & WEAKEN NEW BELIEVERS!
📖 Exodus 1:22 – "Pharaoh gave this order: ‘Throw every Hebrew boy into the Nile, but let the girls live.’"

🔥 IN EVERY GENERATION, SATAN ATTACKS THE WEAK:
❌ Pharaoh killed baby boys in Egypt.
❌ King Herod murdered babies trying to kill Jesus.
❌ Today, millions of unborn babies are killed through abortion.
❌ False teachers deceive and weaken new Christians.
🚨 THIS IS SPIRITUAL WARFARE!

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
Many churches today focus on entertainment, not discipleship, leaving new believers spiritually defenseless.
📖 1 Corinthians 3:2 – "I gave you milk, not solid food, for you were not ready for it."
👉 WILL YOU LET THE DEVIL STEAL THIS GENERATION, OR WILL YOU STAND FOR THEM?

🔥 5. WHAT MUST YOU DO? PROTECT CHILDREN & BABY CHRISTIANS AT ALL COSTS!
📖 Ephesians 5:11 – "Have nothing to do with the fruitless deeds of darkness, but rather expose them."

🔥 HOW TO PROTECT THE NEXT GENERATION:
✅ TEACH THEM GOD’S WORD DAILY! (Deuteronomy 11:19)
✅ MONITOR WHAT THEY WATCH, READ, AND LISTEN TO! (Psalm 101:3)
✅ PRAY FOR THEM AND WITH THEM! (1 Thessalonians 5:17)
✅ DISCIPLE NEW BELIEVERS—HELP THEM GROW STRONG IN FAITH! (Matthew 28:19-20)
🚨 JESUS IS COMING BACK. ARE YOU READY?

🙏 POWERFUL PRAYER FOR CHILDREN & NEW BELIEVERS!
"Lord Jesus, protect the hearts and minds of our children and new believers. Expose the lies of the enemy and fill them with Your truth. Give parents and spiritual leaders the courage to raise them in righteousness. Strengthen their faith and keep them from stumbling. In Jesus’ name, AMEN!" 🙏🔥

title: "The Truth About Church Hypocrisy – What Jesus Really Said" 🔥
paragraphs:
"The Truth About Church Hypocrisy – What Jesus Really Said" 🔥
✝️ A Message from Brother John Domino "PiX" S. Asis – Follower of Jesus Christ and a Servant of God
🌍 Jesus never had a problem with sinners—He had a problem with religious hypocrites.

He never condemned prostitutes, tax collectors, or thieves who repented.
But He called out the religious leaders for their fake righteousness.
📖 “Woe to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You are like whitewashed tombs, which look beautiful on the outside but on the inside are full of the bones of the dead and everything unclean.” (Matthew 23:27)
🚨 The same religious hypocrisy exists today. Many churches look holy on the outside but are filled with corruption, pride, and greed.
💡 Jesus exposed fake religion then, and He exposes it now!

🔥 1. What is Hypocrisy?
Hypocrisy is pretending to be godly while secretly living in sin.
📖 “These people honor Me with their lips, but their hearts are far from Me.” (Isaiah 29:13)
💡 A true Christian doesn’t just say the right words—they live them.
🚨 Today, many churches are guilty of the same hypocrisy Jesus rebuked.

🔥 2. The 3 Types of Church Hypocrisy Jesus Condemned
1️⃣ Fake Holiness – Looking Religious, But Living in Sin
The Pharisees wore religious robes and acted righteous but were corrupt inside.
Many churchgoers today dress well on Sundays but live in sin the rest of the week.
📖 “Woe to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You clean the outside of the cup and dish, but inside they are full of greed and self-indulgence.” (Matthew 23:25)
🚨 Truth: God sees beyond your church attendance—He looks at your heart.

2️⃣ Religious Pride – Thinking They’re Better Than Others
The Pharisees looked down on sinners, but Jesus ate with them and changed their lives.
Many churchgoers today judge others while ignoring their own sin.
📖 “To some who were confident of their own righteousness and looked down on everyone else, Jesus told this parable.” (Luke 18:9)
🚨 Truth: True Christianity is about humility, not self-righteousness.

3️⃣ Using Religion for Power and Money
The Pharisees used God’s name to control people and make money.
Today, some pastors treat church like a business instead of a place of worship.
📖 “Jesus entered the temple courts and drove out all who were buying and selling there. He overturned the tables of the money changers.” (Matthew 21:12)
🚨 Truth: The Church exists to glorify God, not to make men rich.

🔥 3. How Hypocrisy is Destroying the Church Today
🚨 People are leaving the Church—not because they hate Jesus, but because they hate fake Christianity.

1️⃣ Preachers focus on entertainment instead of the Gospel.
2️⃣ Church members gossip about people instead of praying for them.
3️⃣ The poor are ignored, while the rich are given special treatment.
4️⃣ Sin is tolerated inside the Church, but truth-tellers are silenced.
📖 “They tie up heavy, cumbersome loads and put them on other people’s shoulders, but they themselves are not willing to lift a finger to move them.” (Matthew 23:4)
🚨 People need the truth—not religious games.

🔥 4. Are You Part of the Problem or the Solution?
Jesus calls us to be real disciples, not religious actors.

✅ A true Christian lives in humility, not pride.
✅ A true Christian seeks holiness, not appearance.
✅ A true Christian serves people, not themselves.
📖 “Whoever wants to be great among you must be your servant.” (Matthew 20:26)
🚨 It’s time to stop playing church and start being the Church!

🔥 5. What Can We Do to Fix This?
1️⃣ Examine Your Own Heart First
Are you truly living for Jesus, or just pretending?
Are you practicing what you preach?
📖 “Examine yourselves to see whether you are in the faith; test yourselves.” (2 Corinthians 13:5)
🚨 Stop pointing fingers—fix your own life first!

2️⃣ Speak Up Against Hypocrisy
Jesus called out religious fakes—so should we.
But we must do it with love and truth.
📖 “Preach the Word; be ready in season and out of season; correct, rebuke, and encourage—with great patience and careful instruction.” (2 Timothy 4:2)
🚨 Silence allows corruption to grow—stand for righteousness!

3️⃣ Be a True Example of Christ
People won’t listen to what we say if our lives don’t match it.
Show love, live holy, and stand for truth.
📖 “Let your light shine before others, that they may see your good deeds and glorify your Father in heaven.” (Matthew 5:16)
🚨 Actions speak louder than words!

📜 FAITH DECLARATION FOR JANUARY 20, 2025 📜
"Today, I choose to be a true follower of Jesus—not just a religious person. I will live in humility, holiness, and truth, and I will stand against hypocrisy in the Church."

🔥 THE “REAL CHRISTIANITY” CHALLENGE 🔥
✅ Step 1: Examine your heart—are you truly following Jesus?
✅ Step 2: Stand up against hypocrisy and religious deception.
✅ Step 3: Tag 3 friends and challenge them to live authentically for Jesus.

🌌 JESUS WANTS A REAL RELATIONSHIP – NOT FAKE RELIGION 🌌
📖 “God is spirit, and His worshipers must worship in the Spirit and in truth.” (John 4:24)

👉 Christianity is about Jesus, not religious traditions.
👉 Are you following Christ or just playing church?

🙏 PRAYER FOR JANUARY 20, 2025 🙏
Heavenly Father,
Forgive us for the times we have fallen into hypocrisy. Help us to live in truth, holiness, and love. Give us the courage to stand against fake religion and be true examples of Your Kingdom. Let our faith be real, and let our lives reflect Jesus in everything we do.
In Jesus’ name, Amen. ✝️

title: "Why ‘Christian’ Does Not Always Mean Saved – The Danger of False Converts" 🔥
paragraphs:
"Why ‘Christian’ Does Not Always Mean Saved – The Danger of False Converts" 🔥
✝️ A Message from Brother John Domino "PiX" S. Asis – Follower of Jesus Christ and a Servant of God
🌍 A hard truth: Not everyone who calls themselves a ‘Christian’ is truly saved.

Just because someone attends church doesn’t mean they belong to Christ.
Just because someone prays doesn’t mean they have a relationship with God.
Just because someone knows Bible verses doesn’t mean their heart is transformed.
💡 Being a Christian is not about a label—it’s about a transformed life through Jesus Christ.
📖 “Not everyone who says to Me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter the kingdom of heaven, but only the one who does the will of My Father who is in heaven.” (Matthew 7:21)

🔥 The Problem: Cultural Christianity vs. True Christianity
In today’s world, many claim the name of Christ but deny Him with their lives.
What is Cultural Christianity?

Believing in God, but living like He doesn’t exist.
Saying “I’m a Christian” because of family tradition, not personal faith.
Attending church but having no personal relationship with Jesus.
📖 “They honor Me with their lips, but their hearts are far from Me.” (Matthew 15:8)
Cultural Christianity is dangerous because it gives people a false sense of security—thinking they’re saved when they’re not.

🔥 The Warning: Jesus Said Many Will Be Shocked on Judgment Day
Imagine standing before Jesus, thinking you're saved… only to hear Him say:
📖 “I never knew you. Depart from Me, you workers of lawlessness.” (Matthew 7:23)
Jesus isn’t looking for religious activity—He’s looking for a heart surrendered to Him.
🚨 The scariest part? Many will think they are saved, but Jesus will reject them.

🔥 What Does TRUE Salvation Look Like?
1️⃣ A Personal Relationship with Jesus, Not Just Religion
Christianity isn’t just about going to church—it’s about knowing Christ personally.
📖 “This is eternal life: that they know You, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom You have sent.” (John 17:3)

2️⃣ A Changed Heart, Not Just Empty Words
Many say they love Jesus, but their actions deny Him.
📖 “If anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation; the old has passed away, the new has come.” (2 Corinthians 5:17)

3️⃣ True Faith in Jesus ALONE, Not Good Works
Salvation is by grace alone, through faith alone, in Christ alone—not by being “good.”
📖 “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.” (John 14:6)

🔥 Signs of a False Convert vs. A True Christian
⚠️ A false convert says "I believe in Jesus" but continues to live in unrepentant sin.
✔️ A true Christian turns from sin and seeks to follow Christ.

⚠️ A false convert relies on good works to be saved.
✔️ A true Christian trusts in Jesus alone for salvation.

⚠️ A false convert goes to church for tradition, not transformation.
✔️ A true Christian lives daily for Jesus with genuine faith.

⚠️ A false convert ignores the Bible and prays only in emergencies.
✔️ A true Christian loves the Word of God and seeks His will.

⚠️ A false convert thinks everyone is "going to heaven" because they’re "good."
✔️ A true Christian knows that only those in Christ are saved.

🔥 How to Know If You’re Truly Saved
❌ Being “religious” won’t save you.
❌ Trying to be a “good person” won’t save you.
❌ Having Christian parents won’t save you.
✅ Only faith in Jesus Christ can save you.
📖 “Believe in the Lord Jesus, and you will be saved.” (Acts 16:31)

🔥 What Must You Do to Be Sure You’re Truly Saved?
1️⃣ Examine Your Heart.
Ask yourself: “Do I truly know Jesus, or do I just know about Him?”

2️⃣ Repent and Believe in Jesus Christ Alone.
📖 “If you confess with your mouth, ‘Jesus is Lord,’ and believe in your heart that God raised Him from the dead, you will be saved.” (Romans 10:9)

3️⃣ Seek a Relationship, Not Just Religion.
📖 “Draw near to God, and He will draw near to you.” (James 4:8)

4️⃣ Follow Jesus Daily.
Read His Word, obey His teachings, and grow in faith.
📖 “Whoever wants to be My disciple must deny themselves and take up their cross daily and follow Me.” (Luke 9:23)

📜 FAITH DECLARATION FOR JANUARY 16, 2025 📜
"Today, I reject cultural Christianity. I don’t just want the name ‘Christian’—I want to truly follow Jesus. I surrender my heart fully to Him and place my faith in Christ alone for salvation."

🔥 THE “TRUE CHRISTIAN” CHALLENGE 🔥
✅ Step 1: Examine your heart—are you truly saved, or just religious?
✅ Step 2: If you’re truly saved, share your testimony today.
✅ Step 3: Tag 3 friends and challenge them to evaluate their faith.

🌌 DON'T JUST CALL YOURSELF A CHRISTIAN – BE ONE 🌌
📖 “Be doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving yourselves.” (James 1:22)

👉 It’s time to stop playing church and start following Jesus for real.
👉 Eternity is too long to be wrong. Make sure your faith is real today.

🙏 PRAYER FOR JANUARY 16, 2025 🙏
Heavenly Father,
Thank You for showing me that salvation is not about a title but a true relationship with Jesus Christ. I repent from trusting in my own goodness or traditions, and today, I put my full faith in Jesus alone. Help me to live as a true follower, walking in obedience and love for You.
In Jesus’ name, Amen. ✝️

title: 🔥 "IS A PERSON WHO COMMITS SUICIDE SAVED? WHAT DOES THE BIBLE SAY?" 🚀🔥
paragraphs: 🔥 "IS A PERSON WHO COMMITS SUICIDE SAVED? WHAT DOES THE BIBLE SAY?" 🚀🔥

📖 1 Corinthians 3:16-17 – "Do you not know that you are God’s temple and that God’s Spirit dwells in you? If anyone destroys God’s temple, God will destroy him. For God’s temple is holy, and you are that temple."
Suicide is one of the most painful and controversial topics, especially for families who have lost loved ones in this way. Many ask:

❌ "If a Christian commits suicide, do they go straight to hell?"
❌ "Can someone take their own life and still be saved?"
❌ "Is suicide an unforgivable sin?"
🚨 What does the Bible really say? Let’s dive into Scripture and uncover the truth.

🔥 1. SUICIDE IS A SIN – IT IS SELF-MURDER
📖 Exodus 20:13 – "You shall not murder."

✅ Suicide is self-murder—taking a life that belongs to God.
✅ The Bible condemns all forms of murder, including killing oneself.
✅ Our bodies belong to God, not to us (1 Corinthians 6:19-20).
📖 Romans 14:7-8 – "For none of us lives to himself, and none of us dies to himself. If we live, we live to the Lord, and if we die, we die to the Lord."
🚨 Life is a gift from God. We do not have the right to take it!

🔥 2. WHAT HAPPENS TO SOMEONE WHO COMMITS SUICIDE?
There are two scenarios we must consider:
1️⃣ The person was an unbeliever (rejected Christ).

If someone dies without Christ, no matter how they die, they go to hell (John 3:36, Revelation 20:15).
Suicide does not send them to hell—unbelief does!
2️⃣ The person was a true, born-again believer.

This is more complicated, but we must ask: Does one final sin erase salvation?
📖 Romans 8:38-39 – "For I am sure that neither death nor life… nor anything else in all creation will be able to separate us from the love of God in Christ Jesus our Lord."

✅ If a person was truly saved, their last action (suicide) does not override God’s grace.
✅ Suicide is still a sin, but it is not the "unforgivable sin."
✅ However, this does NOT mean suicide is acceptable!
🚨 Suicide is a tragedy, but salvation depends on faith in Jesus, not on how someone dies.

🔥 3. WHAT IS THE UNFORGIVABLE SIN?
📖 Matthew 12:31-32 – "Every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven, but the blasphemy against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven."

✅ The ONLY unforgivable sin is rejecting the Holy Spirit’s call to salvation.
✅ Suicide is NOT the unforgivable sin.
✅ The true danger is if a person commits suicide while rejecting Jesus—they die in unbelief!
🚨 The biggest issue is NOT suicide—it’s whether someone knew Jesus as their Savior before they died!

🔥 4. BIBLICAL EXAMPLES OF SUICIDE – DID THEY GO TO HELL?
📖 Judas Iscariot (Matthew 27:5) – Betrayed Jesus, felt guilty, and hanged himself.
🚨 Judas went to hell—not because of suicide, but because he rejected Christ! (John 17:12)

📖 King Saul (1 Samuel 31:4-6) – Fell on his own sword.
📖 Samson (Judges 16:28-30) – Pulled down the temple, killing himself and his enemies.
✅ Samson is mentioned in Hebrews 11:32 as a man of faith—suggesting he was saved despite his final act!
🚨 The Bible does not say all suicides go to hell—it depends on their faith in God!

🔥 5. SUICIDE IS A SPIRITUAL ATTACK FROM SATAN!
📖 John 10:10 – "The thief comes only to steal, kill, and destroy; I came that they may have life and have it abundantly."

✅ Suicide is NEVER from God—it is a LIE from Satan!
✅ The devil wants people to believe there is "no way out" and that "death is the only option."
✅ But Jesus offers hope, healing, and deliverance!
🚨 No matter how bad things seem, suicide is NOT the answer—Jesus is!

🔥 6. WARNING: SUICIDE HAS DEVASTATING CONSEQUENCES!
📖 Ecclesiastes 7:17 – "Why should you die before your time?"

✅ Suicide is irreversible—it cannot be undone!
✅ It causes extreme pain to family and loved ones.
✅ It cuts short the plans God had for that person’s life.
🚨 If you are struggling with suicidal thoughts, SEEK HELP NOW!
📖 Psalm 34:17-18 – "The Lord is near to the brokenhearted and saves the crushed in spirit."
🔥 Jesus can heal every pain, every wound, and every broken heart!

🔥 FINAL CONCLUSION: DOES SUICIDE SEND A PERSON TO HELL?
✅ Suicide is a sin, but it is NOT the unforgivable sin.
✅ If someone was a true believer, suicide does NOT erase their salvation.
✅ However, suicide is NEVER God's will—it is a lie from Satan!
✅ The real danger is dying without Christ—THAT is what sends a person to hell!
🚨 DO NOT LET SATAN WIN! CHOOSE LIFE!

✅ 👍 CLICK LIKE if this teaching blessed you!
✅ ❤️ CLICK HEART if you believe in the power of Jesus over depression!
✅ 🚀 CLICK SHARE to spread hope and truth to those struggling with suicidal thoughts!
📢 🚨 WARNING: Someone you know might be struggling with suicidal thoughts. SHARE THIS NOW to save a life!

🙏 PRAYER FOR TODAY
Heavenly Father, I pray for those who feel hopeless and lost. Remind them that You have a plan and a purpose for their lives. Break the chains of depression, fear, and lies from the enemy. Fill their hearts with Your peace and hope. Let them know they are loved, valued, and chosen by You. In Jesus’ name, AMEN! 🙏🔥

title: 🔥 "IF YOU DIED TONIGHT, WOULD GOD LET YOU INTO HEAVEN?" 🚀🔥
paragraphs: 🔥 "IF YOU DIED TONIGHT, WOULD GOD LET YOU INTO HEAVEN?" 🚀🔥

📖 Matthew 7:22-23 – "Many will say to Me on that day, ‘Lord, Lord, did we not prophesy in Your name, and cast out demons in Your name, and do many mighty works in Your name?’ And then I will declare to them, ‘I never knew you; depart from Me, you workers of lawlessness!’"

🚨 What if you took your last breath tonight?
Would you wake up in the presence of Jesus? Or would you open your eyes in eternal separation from God?
Many people THINK they are going to heaven—but Jesus warned that many will be SHOCKED on Judgment Day! Let’s dive into the truth and see what the Bible really says.

🔥 1. MOST PEOPLE THINK THEY ARE GOING TO HEAVEN—BUT ARE THEY?
📖 Proverbs 16:25 – "There is a way that seems right to a man, but its end is the way to death."

✅ Many people believe they will go to heaven because they:
❌ Attend church occasionally.
❌ Try to be a "good person."
❌ Help the poor or do good deeds.
❌ Were baptized as a child.
❌ Believe in God but never truly surrendered to Christ.
🚨 None of these things can save you! Salvation is NOT about being a "good person"—it’s about being born again in Christ!
📖 John 3:3 – "Jesus answered him, ‘Truly, truly, I say to you, unless one is born again he cannot see the kingdom of God.’"
🔥 Are you truly born again, or just religious?

🔥 2. ETERNAL DESTINY IS SEALED AT DEATH—NO SECOND CHANCES!
📖 Hebrews 9:27 – "It is appointed for man to die once, and after that comes judgment."

✅ The moment you die, your eternity is sealed forever.
✅ There is no purgatory, no "waiting period," and no second chance to repent.
✅ You will either stand before God as His child or as His enemy.

📖 2 Thessalonians 1:8-9 – "In flaming fire, inflicting vengeance on those who do not know God and on those who do not obey the gospel of our Lord Jesus. They will suffer the punishment of eternal destruction, away from the presence of the Lord."
🚨 Hell is real, and many people are heading there thinking they are "good enough" for heaven!

🔥 3. HOW DO YOU KNOW IF YOU ARE TRULY SAVED?
📖 2 Corinthians 13:5 – "Examine yourselves, to see whether you are in the faith. Test yourselves. Or do you not realize this about yourselves, that Jesus Christ is in you—unless indeed you fail to meet the test?"

🔥 Ask yourself these questions:
✅ Have I truly repented of my sins, or do I still live in them? (Luke 13:3)
✅ Do I obey Jesus' commands, or do I just claim to follow Him? (John 14:15)
✅ Do I bear fruit in my life, or do I live like the world? (Matthew 7:16-17)
✅ Do I trust in Jesus ALONE, or do I rely on good works and religion? (Ephesians 2:8-9)
🚨 Many people claim to be "Christian," but their lives show otherwise. Are you truly saved?

🔥 4. JESUS IS THE ONLY WAY—NOT RELIGION, GOOD WORKS, OR CHURCH MEMBERSHIP!
📖 John 14:6 – "Jesus said to him, ‘I am the way, and the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.’"
🔥 There is ONLY ONE WAY to heaven—JESUS!

❌ Not by being a "good person."
❌ Not by church attendance.
❌ Not by religious traditions or family background.
✅ ONLY by surrendering fully to Jesus Christ and being born again!
🚨 Have you truly given your life to Jesus, or are you just religious?

🔥 5. HOW TO BE 100% SURE YOU ARE GOING TO HEAVEN!
📖 Romans 10:9 – "If you confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God raised Him from the dead, you will be saved."

✅ Steps to True Salvation:
✔️ Admit you are a sinner (Romans 3:23).
✔️ Believe that Jesus Christ died and rose again for you (John 3:16).
✔️ Confess and repent of your sins (Acts 3:19).
✔️ Surrender your life fully to Jesus as Lord (Luke 9:23).
🚨 If you are not 100% sure of your salvation, TODAY is the time to surrender to Christ!

🔥 FINAL CONCLUSION: WHERE WILL YOU GO WHEN YOU DIE?
✅ Salvation is NOT about being a "good person"—it’s about being born again in Jesus Christ!
✅ The moment you die, your eternity is sealed—heaven or hell. No second chances.
✅ If you trust in anything other than Jesus ALONE, you are in danger of eternal separation from God!
🚨 DO NOT WAIT! REPENT AND FOLLOW JESUS NOW BEFORE IT’S TOO LATE!

✅ 👍 CLICK LIKE if this teaching blessed you!
✅ ❤️ CLICK HEART if you are 100% sure you are saved!
✅ 🚀 CLICK SHARE to wake up those who are deceived about salvation!
📢 🚨 WARNING: Many people think they are going to heaven, but they are deceived. SHARE THIS NOW to bring them to the truth!

🙏 PRAYER FOR SALVATION
Heavenly Father, I come before You as a sinner in need of grace. I confess my sins and turn away from them. I believe that Jesus Christ died for me and rose again. Today, I surrender my life fully to You. Be my Lord, my Savior, and my King. Fill me with Your Holy Spirit and lead me in truth. Thank You for saving me! In Jesus’ name, AMEN! 🙏🔥
