title: "Are We Living in the Last Days? Signs of Jesus’ Return" 🔥
paragraphs:
"Are We Living in the Last Days? Signs of Jesus’ Return" 🔥
✝️ A Message from Brother John Domino "PiX" S. Asis – Follower of Jesus Christ and a Servant of God
🌍 Look around. The world is falling apart.

Wars and conflicts are increasing.
Natural disasters are striking harder than ever.
Morality is collapsing.
Hatred, lawlessness, and deception are everywhere.
🚨 Is this just another bad time in history? Or are we witnessing the signs of the Last Days?

📖 “You will hear of wars and rumors of wars, but see to it that you are not alarmed. Such things must happen, but the end is still to come. Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be famines and earthquakes in various places. All these are the beginning of birth pains.” (Matthew 24:6-8)
💡 The Bible warned us thousands of years ago—and it’s happening NOW.

🔥 1. Jesus Gave Us Signs to Watch For
Many people ignore the warnings or say, “People have been saying this for years.”
But Jesus told us to stay alert and recognize the signs.
📖 “When you see all these things, you know that it is near, right at the door.” (Matthew 24:33)
💡 We are seeing ALL the signs happening together—at a level never seen before.

🔥 2. What Are the Signs of the Last Days?
1️⃣ Increase in Wars and Conflicts
We are seeing wars, civil unrest, and violent conflicts worldwide.
Rumors of war spread daily between nations.
📖 “Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.” (Matthew 24:7)
🚨 Global tensions are higher than ever!

2️⃣ Lawlessness and Moral Collapse
Crime, corruption, and wickedness are rising.
Sexual immorality, perversion, and broken families are becoming normal.
Evil is celebrated, and righteousness is mocked.
📖 “People will be lovers of themselves, lovers of money, boastful, proud, abusive, disobedient to their parents, ungrateful, unholy, without love, unforgiving, slanderous, without self-control, brutal, not lovers of the good.” (2 Timothy 3:1-3)
🚨 The world has completely abandoned biblical morals.

3️⃣ False Prophets and Deception Everywhere
Fake pastors and false religions are misleading millions.
False signs, miracles, and demonic deceptions are fooling people.
People love false teachers who tell them what they want to hear.
📖 “For false messiahs and false prophets will appear and perform great signs and wonders to deceive, if possible, even the elect.” (Matthew 24:24)
🚨 The world is following lies instead of truth!

4️⃣ Increase in Natural Disasters and Climate Chaos
Earthquakes, hurricanes, wildfires, floods, and extreme weather are worse than ever before.
The world calls it “climate change,” but Jesus told us this would happen.
📖 “There will be famines and earthquakes in various places. All these are the beginning of birth pains.” (Matthew 24:7-8)
🚨 These disasters are not just random—they are warnings!

5️⃣ Rise of a One-World System
The world is preparing for global control—economically, politically, and religiously.
Governments push for digital ID, cashless economies, and mass surveillance.
The idea of a global leader (Antichrist) is becoming more accepted.
📖 “It also forced all people, great and small, rich and poor, free and slave, to receive a mark on their right hands or on their foreheads, so that they could not buy or sell unless they had the mark.” (Revelation 13:16-17)
🚨 A global system of control is forming—just as the Bible predicted!

🔥 3. What Should We Do?
1️⃣ Don’t Ignore the Signs – Be Ready!
Jesus is coming soon—this is not the time to be asleep spiritually.
Many will mock these warnings, but that’s another sign of the Last Days.
📖 “You must be ready, because the Son of Man will come at an hour when you do not expect Him.” (Matthew 24:44)
💡 The biggest danger is thinking you have more time.

2️⃣ Repent and Surrender to Jesus NOW
Many people are still playing with sin—but tomorrow is not promised.
Jesus could return any moment, or your life could end at any time.
📖 “Repent, for the kingdom of heaven has come near.” (Matthew 4:17)
🚨 Make sure you are saved and following Jesus with your whole heart!

3️⃣ Share the Gospel Urgently
People are dying without Jesus every day.
We have a short time to warn them and lead them to Christ.
📖 “Go into all the world and preach the Gospel to all creation.” (Mark 16:15)
🚨 The time to share Jesus is NOW—before it’s too late!

📜 FAITH DECLARATION FOR JANUARY 19, 2025 📜
"I believe we are living in the Last Days. I choose to stay awake, live for Jesus, and warn others before it’s too late. I will not ignore the signs—I will prepare my heart and proclaim the truth."

🔥 THE “LAST DAYS” CHALLENGE 🔥
✅ Step 1: Examine your heart—are you truly saved, or just religious?
✅ Step 3: Warn others about the signs of Jesus’ return!

🌌 DON’T WAIT – JESUS IS COMING SOON 🌌
📖 “Look, I am coming soon! Blessed is the one who keeps the words of the prophecy written in this scroll.” (Revelation 22:7)

👉 Will you be ready when Jesus returns?
👉 Or will you be one of those who ignored the warnings?

🙏 PRAYER FOR JANUARY 19, 2025 🙏
Heavenly Father,
Thank You for giving us the signs of Your return. I don’t want to be caught sleeping spiritually. Wake me up! Help me to live in full obedience to You and boldly share the truth with others. Let me be found faithful when You return.
In Jesus’ name, Amen. ✝️

title: "What Most Christians Get Wrong About Salvation – The Hard Truth Revealed" 🔥
paragraphs:
"What Most Christians Get Wrong About Salvation – The Hard Truth Revealed" 🔥
✝️ A Message from Brother John Domino "PiX" S. Asis
🌍 This message isn’t just another post. It’s a divine wake-up call.
👉 What if I told you that many Christians are misunderstanding the most important truth of all—Salvation?
📖 “For it is by grace you have been saved, through faith—and this is not from yourselves, it is the gift of God—not by works, so that no one can boast.” (Ephesians 2:8-9)

Yet, millions of believers still live as if:
❌ Salvation can be earned through good works.
❌ Church attendance and rituals make someone saved.
❌ Being "a good person" is enough for eternal life.
Today, let’s break down the truth. If we don’t get salvation right, we miss the core message of Jesus.

🌟 The Common Misunderstandings About Salvation 🌟
Salvation isn’t complicated—but many have distorted it. Let’s expose the myths and replace them with truth.

1️⃣ Myth: "I'm Saved Because I Go to Church"
Truth: Church attendance doesn't save you—Jesus does.
💡 While being part of a church is important, no building can grant you eternal life.
📖 “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.” (John 14:6)
✅ Reflection: Are you depending on church routines instead of a personal relationship with Jesus?

2️⃣ Myth: "Being a Good Person Guarantees Heaven"
Truth: Salvation isn’t based on morality—it's based on grace.
💡 If being "good" was enough, Jesus wouldn't have needed to die on the cross.
📖 “For all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God.” (Romans 3:23)

💬 A Story:
A man once told me, “I’ve never done anything really bad—why wouldn’t God accept me?” The truth is, even the smallest sin separates us from God, and only Jesus can bridge that gap.
✅ Reflection: Are you trusting in your goodness or Christ’s sacrifice for salvation?

3️⃣ Myth: "I Have to Earn My Salvation Through Works"
Truth: Salvation is a free gift, not a reward for good behavior.
💡 No amount of charity, rituals, or religious acts can pay for your sins—only the blood of Jesus can.
📖 “He saved us, not because of righteous things we had done, but because of His mercy.” (Titus 3:5)
✅ Reflection: Are you trying to earn God’s love or receiving it by faith?

4️⃣ Myth: "Saying a Prayer Once Means I'm Saved Forever"
Truth: True salvation transforms your life.
💡 Saying a prayer without heart change is empty. True faith produces fruit.
📖 “Faith without works is dead.” (James 2:17)

💬 A Story:
A woman I know said the sinner’s prayer at a youth camp but never changed how she lived. Years later, she truly surrendered to Jesus and experienced a complete heart transformation.
✅ Reflection: Is your faith producing real transformation or just words?

🔥 The Biblical Truth About Salvation 🔥
Salvation is a GIFT from God, received through faith in Jesus Christ alone.
📖 “If you declare with your mouth, ‘Jesus is Lord,’ and believe in your heart that God raised Him from the dead, you will be saved.” (Romans 10:9)
✅ Here's the TRUTH:

You can’t earn salvation.
You can’t buy it.
You can only receive it by surrendering to Jesus.
🌍 The Real Steps to Experience True Salvation 🌍
1️⃣ Admit You’re a Sinner
📖 “For all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God.” (Romans 3:23)

2️⃣ Believe in Jesus as the Only Savior
📖 “For God so loved the world that He gave His one and only Son, that whoever believes in Him shall not perish but have eternal life.” (John 3:16)

3️⃣ Confess and Repent
📖 “Repent, then, and turn to God, so that your sins may be wiped out.” (Acts 3:19)

4️⃣ Surrender and Follow Jesus Daily
📖 “Take up your cross and follow Me.” (Luke 9:23)

🔥 3 Ways to Know If You’re Truly Saved 🔥
✅ 1. Your Life Bears Spiritual Fruit

Do you love more? Forgive more? Trust God more?
✅ 2. The Holy Spirit Convicts and Guides You

Do you feel drawn to repentance and growth?
✅ 3. Your Heart Longs for Jesus

Are you pursuing a deeper relationship with Him?
📜 Faith Declaration for January 7 📜
"I declare that salvation is through Christ alone! I am not saved by my works but by grace through faith. I surrender fully to Jesus Christ as my Lord and Savior, trusting Him completely for my eternity."

🔥 The "Salvation Truth Challenge" 🔥
✅ Step 1: Reflect on your salvation—Do you truly trust Jesus alone?
✅ Step 3: Tag 3 friends who need to hear the truth about salvation.
➡️ Let’s ignite a global revival of truth!

🌌 "Salvation Is Not a Religion – It’s a Relationship" 🌌
📖 “You will seek Me and find Me when you seek Me with all your heart.” (Jeremiah 29:13)

This isn't just information—it's a divine invitation.
Today could be your breakthrough.
💡 Are you ready to stop performing and fully trust Jesus?

🙏 A Prayer for January 7, 2025 🙏
Heavenly Father,
Thank You for the gift of salvation through Jesus Christ. I confess that I am a sinner and in need of Your grace. I believe that Jesus died for my sins and rose again to give me eternal life. Today, I surrender fully to You—my heart, my mind, and my life. Transform me and make me a reflection of Your love.
In Jesus’ name, Amen. ✝️
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: 🔥 January 6: Stop Playing Church – Follow Jesus Wholeheartedly 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 January 6: Stop Playing Church – Follow Jesus Wholeheartedly 🔥
✝️ A Message from Brother John Domino "PiX" S. Asis
🌍 It’s January 6, 2025.
Today, I want to speak directly to your heart. This message isn't random—if you’re reading this, God is calling you right now.
Are you truly following Jesus—or just going through the motions?
📖 “These people honor Me with their lips, but their hearts are far from Me.” (Matthew 15:8)
It’s easy to attend church, recite verses, and sing songs, but is your heart fully surrendered to Christ? This message is your wake-up call:
Stop playing church. Start following Jesus completely.

🌟 Why Do People “Play Church” Without Truly Following Jesus? 🌟
Many Christians fall into the trap of performing faith instead of living it. And it’s dangerous because it feels like you’re doing enough—but inside, something is missing.

➡️ Comfort Over Conviction: It’s easier to stay in the shallow end than let God challenge your life.
➡️ Fear of Judgment: Some follow the crowd to avoid criticism rather than seek truth.
➡️ Cultural Christianity: Raised in church but never personally encountering Jesus.
➡️ Habit Without Heart: Attending out of routine, not out of devotion.

💬 A Testimony:
I once met a man who had been attending church for 15 years, yet he felt spiritually empty. He knew all the hymns, could quote Scripture, but lacked a personal connection with Jesus. It wasn’t until he humbled himself in prayer, saying:
"Lord, I’ve been doing this wrong. I surrender completely."
👉 That day, everything changed.

🔥 What Jesus Really Desires From You 🔥
Jesus didn’t die for religion.
He died to restore a relationship between you and God.

1️⃣ Jesus Wants Your Whole Heart ❤️ (Not Half-Devotion)
Real faith isn’t about performing—it’s about complete surrender.
📖 “Love the Lord your God with all your heart, all your soul, and all your mind.” (Matthew 22:37)

💬 A Story:
A young woman in Kenya shared how she had been attending church every Sunday but never felt close to God. It wasn’t until she started praying in private, with no music, no crowd—just her and God—that her faith came alive.

✅ Reflection: Close your eyes right now and ask yourself:
"Is my heart truly surrendered—or am I just performing faith?"

2️⃣ Jesus Wants Authentic Worship, Not Performance 🎶
Worship isn’t just singing songs—it’s a lifestyle.
📖 “God is spirit, and His worshipers must worship in the Spirit and in truth.” (John 4:24)
💡 True worship is:

Speaking kindly when it’s difficult.
Forgiving when it feels undeserved.
Trusting when the path seems unclear.
✅ Action Step: Write down 3 ways you can worship God through your actions this week.

3️⃣ Jesus Wants Transformation, Not Tradition 🌱
Faith should change you from the inside out.
📖 “Therefore, if anyone is in Christ, the new creation has come: The old has gone, the new is here!” (2 Corinthians 5:17)

💬 A Story:
A man struggling with addiction told me, “I didn’t need more religion—I needed Jesus to transform my heart.” Once he surrendered, he experienced freedom like never before.
✅ Reflection: What area of your life still needs transformation? Invite God into it today.

🌍 Why Attending Church Isn’t Enough 🌍
Going to church is important—but it’s not enough without a personal relationship with Christ.

The church is a body, not a building.
The Bible is a guide, not a checklist.
The rituals are reminders, not the source of salvation.
📖 “You are the light of the world. A city on a hill cannot be hidden.” (Matthew 5:14)
✅ Reflection: Is your faith visible outside the church walls?

🔥 3 Steps to Stop Playing Church and Follow Jesus Fully 🔥
1️⃣ Make Your Faith Personal, Not Performative
Stop performing for people—start seeking God personally.
✅ Pray privately.
✅ Read Scripture to grow, not just memorize.
✅ Serve without seeking praise.

2️⃣ Let Go of Empty Traditions
✅ Test every belief against the Bible.
✅ Follow Jesus, not systems.
✅ Seek truth, not opinions.
📖 “For no one can lay any foundation other than the one already laid, which is Jesus Christ.” (1 Corinthians 3:11)

3️⃣ Let the Holy Spirit Lead Your Life Daily
✅ Invite the Holy Spirit to guide your decisions.
✅ Surrender control and trust God’s timing.
✅ Live with courage and bold faith.
📖 “The Spirit gives life; the flesh counts for nothing.” (John 6:63)

📜 Faith Declaration for January 6 📜
"I refuse to play church. I choose to follow Jesus fully—heart, soul, and mind. My faith is not a performance. I surrender my life to Christ, not traditions or appearances. I live for Him alone."

🔥 The "Live Fully for Christ" Challenge 🔥
✅ Step 1: Spend 10 minutes in unscripted prayer tonight.
✅ Step 3: Tag 3 friends who need this truth.
➡️ Let’s spark a global revival together!

🌌 "It’s Time to Break Free – No More Empty Religion" 🌌
📖 “You will seek Me and find Me when you seek Me with all your heart.” (Jeremiah 29:13)

This is your moment.
Stop attending church—be the church.
💡 Are you ready to surrender fully?

🙏 A Prayer for January 6, 2025 🙏
Heavenly Father,
I surrender my heart completely today. Break the chains of empty religion and awaken my spirit to follow Jesus wholeheartedly. Help me live boldly for You, not out of obligation but out of love. May my life reflect Your grace and truth in everything I do.
In Jesus’ name, Amen. ✝️

title: 🔥 "PURGATORY IS A LIE – THE TRUTH ABOUT WHAT HAPPENS AFTER DEATH!" 🚀🔥
paragraphs: 🔥 "PURGATORY IS A LIE – THE TRUTH ABOUT WHAT HAPPENS AFTER DEATH!" 🚀🔥
📖 Hebrews 9:27 – "And just as it is appointed for man to die once, and after that comes judgment."

Many people, especially in Catholicism, believe in purgatory—a supposed place where souls go after death to be "cleansed" of their sins before entering heaven. But is this biblical truth or a man-made lie?
Does purgatory exist, or is it a deception that leads people away from the saving power of Jesus Christ? Let’s go deep into Scripture and uncover the truth!

🔥 1. WHAT IS PURGATORY? WHERE DID THIS IDEA COME FROM?
Purgatory is a Catholic doctrine that teaches:
❌ When a person dies, they may not be "pure enough" for heaven but also not bad enough for hell.
❌ They must go to purgatory, where they suffer and "pay" for their sins before entering heaven.
❌ Living people can pray, give money, or do good works to help "shorten" a loved one’s time in purgatory.
🚨 BUT THE BIBLE NEVER TEACHES THIS! Purgatory is a man-made doctrine, created by the Roman Catholic Church to control people and profit from false hope.
📖 Nowhere in the Bible does God say we must suffer AFTER death to be purified!

🔥 2. THE BIBLE SAYS THERE ARE ONLY TWO DESTINATIONS AFTER DEATH – HEAVEN OR HELL!
📖 Luke 16:22-23 – "The rich man also died and was buried, and in Hades, being in torment, he lifted up his eyes and saw Abraham far off and Lazarus at his side."

🔥 When people die, they immediately go to one of two places:
✅ Believers in Christ go to be with the Lord in heaven (2 Corinthians 5:8 – "To be absent from the body is to be present with the Lord.")
❌ Unbelievers go to a place of torment, awaiting final judgment in the lake of fire (Revelation 20:15 – "If anyone’s name was not found written in the book of life, he was thrown into the lake of fire.")
🚨 There is NO middle place! No second chances! No temporary suffering before heaven!

🔥 3. JESUS ALREADY PAID FOR OUR SINS – PURGATORY DENIES THE CROSS!
📖 John 19:30 – "It is finished!"

✅ When Jesus died on the cross, He paid the FULL price for our sins.
✅ He took our punishment, our suffering, and our judgment upon Himself.
✅ If purgatory were real, it would mean that Jesus' sacrifice wasn’t enough!
📖 Hebrews 10:14 – "For by one offering He has perfected forever those who are being sanctified."
🔥 JESUS PAID IT ALL! We don’t need purgatory because His sacrifice was once and for all!

🔥 4. COMMON CATHOLIC ARGUMENTS DEBUNKED!
❌ "What about 1 Corinthians 3:15? Doesn’t it say we will be saved ‘through fire’?"
📖 1 Corinthians 3:13-15 – "Each one’s work will be revealed by fire… If anyone’s work is burned up, he will suffer loss, but he himself will be saved."

👉 This verse is NOT about purgatory! It talks about believers being rewarded in heaven, not punished for sins.
👉 The fire tests our WORKS, not our souls. It’s about losing rewards, not salvation.
❌ "What about 2 Maccabees 12:46? Doesn’t it mention praying for the dead?"
📖 2 Maccabees 12:46 – "It is therefore a holy and wholesome thought to pray for the dead, that they may be loosed from sins."

👉 This book is NOT part of the Bible! It is from the Apocrypha—writings rejected by Jesus, the apostles, and the Jewish people.
👉 Even if it were valid, it contradicts the Bible, which says there is no forgiveness after death! (Hebrews 9:27)
🚨 We cannot pray people into heaven! Once they die, their fate is sealed.

🔥 5. WHAT HAPPENS WHEN WE DIE? THE BIBLICAL TRUTH!
📖 Hebrews 9:27 – "It is appointed for man to die once, and after that comes judgment."

✅ When a person dies, they immediately go to heaven or hell. There is no "waiting place."
✅ Believers go to be with Jesus in paradise (Luke 23:43).
✅ Unbelievers go to Hades, awaiting final judgment (Luke 16:22-23).
✅ On Judgment Day, all will stand before God—believers will be rewarded, and unbelievers will be condemned (Revelation 20:12-15).
🚨 No second chances. No temporary suffering. No purgatory!

🔥 FINAL CONCLUSION: PURGATORY IS A LIE!
✅ The Bible teaches only TWO eternal destinations—heaven or hell.
✅ Jesus PAID the full price for our sins—purgatory denies His finished work.
✅ There is NO second chance after death—your fate is sealed the moment you die.
✅ Purgatory is a false teaching created by the Catholic Church—it is NOT in God’s Word!
🚨 DO NOT BE DECEIVED! TRUST IN JESUS NOW BEFORE IT’S TOO LATE!

✅ 👍 CLICK LIKE if this teaching blessed you!
✅ ❤️ CLICK HEART if you know Jesus’ blood washes away ALL sins!
✅ 🚀 CLICK SHARE to expose the false doctrine of purgatory and spread biblical truth!
📢 🚨 WARNING: Many people are deceived by the Catholic Church’s false teachings. SHARE THIS NOW to help them escape deception!

🙏 PRAYER FOR TODAY
Heavenly Father, I thank You that Jesus paid the FULL price for my sins. I reject every false teaching that adds to Your perfect sacrifice. Open the eyes of those deceived by the lie of purgatory and lead them to the truth of Your Word. I put my faith in Jesus alone for salvation. In Jesus’ name, AMEN! 🙏🔥
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: 🔥 SATAN WANTS YOU TO ‘JUST HAVE FUN’—BECAUSE HE KNOWS WHERE IT LEADS! 🚨🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 SATAN WANTS YOU TO ‘JUST HAVE FUN’—BECAUSE HE KNOWS WHERE IT LEADS! 🚨🔥
📖 Ecclesiastes 11:9 – "You who are young, be happy while you are young, and let your heart give you joy in the days of your youth. Follow the ways of your heart and whatever your eyes see, but know that for all these things, God will bring you into judgment."
🚨 The devil doesn’t need you to worship him—he just needs you to live for pleasure!

🔥 THE WORLD SAYS: "You only live once—enjoy your life, do whatever makes you happy!"
🔥 THE BIBLE SAYS: "The world and its desires pass away, but whoever does the will of God lives forever." (1 John 2:17)
👉 Are you living for fun, or are you living for Christ?

🔥 1. THE GREATEST DECEPTION: "IF IT FEELS GOOD, IT MUST BE RIGHT!"
📖 Proverbs 14:12 – "There is a way that seems right to a man, but in the end, it leads to death."

🔥 SATAN’S FAVORITE LIES:
❌ "It’s just harmless fun!"
❌ "You’re young—enjoy life while you can!"
❌ "God wants you to be happy, so do whatever makes you feel good!"
🚨 THE TRUTH: NOT EVERYTHING THAT FEELS GOOD IS GOOD FOR YOU!

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
Would you eat food that smells good but is poisoned?
👉 Of course not! But this is exactly how Satan works—he makes sin look attractive, but its end is destruction.
📖 James 1:15 – "Then desire, when it has conceived, gives birth to sin, and sin, when it is fully grown, brings forth death."
🚨 WHAT STARTS AS ‘HARMLESS FUN’ CAN END IN SPIRITUAL DEATH!

🔥 2. THE DEVIL DOESN’T NEED YOU TO BE EVIL—HE JUST NEEDS YOU TO BE DISTRACTED!
📖 Luke 8:14 – "They are choked by life’s worries, riches, and pleasures, and they do not mature."

🔥 SATAN’S TACTIC:
❌ He doesn’t always tempt you with obvious sin—he just keeps you too busy for God!
❌ Instead of prayer, you waste hours scrolling social media.
❌ Instead of reading the Bible, you binge-watch entertainment.
❌ Instead of sharing the Gospel, you stay silent because you’re "too busy."
🚨 AND THAT’S EXACTLY HOW HE WINS!

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A frog placed in boiling water will jump out immediately.
👉 But if the water is heated slowly, the frog won’t notice until it’s too late!
📖 1 Peter 5:8 – "Be sober-minded and watchful. Your adversary the devil prowls around like a roaring lion, seeking someone to devour."
🚨 THE DEVIL WON’T ALWAYS ATTACK YOU LOUDLY—SOMETIMES, HE SLOWLY NUMBS YOU UNTIL YOU’RE TRAPPED!

🔥 3. LIVING FOR PLEASURE LEADS TO SPIRITUAL BLINDNESS!
📖 2 Timothy 3:4 – "Lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God."

🔥 WHAT HAPPENS WHEN YOU LIVE FOR FUN?
❌ You stop caring about God.
❌ You start making excuses for sin.
❌ You feel "too busy" for prayer and church.
❌ You surround yourself with worldly influences.
🚨 BEFORE YOU KNOW IT, YOUR HEART GROWS COLD!

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
Many people think, "I’ll follow Jesus later. Right now, I just want to enjoy life."
👉 But what if later never comes?
📖 Luke 12:19-20 – "‘You have plenty of good things laid up for many years. Take life easy; eat, drink, and be merry.’ But God said, ‘You fool! This very night your life will be demanded from you.’"
🚨 NO ONE KNOWS WHEN THEIR LAST DAY WILL BE! DON’T WAIT TO GET RIGHT WITH GOD!

🔥 4. SATAN USES ENTERTAINMENT TO CORRUPT YOUR SOUL!
📖 Psalm 101:3 – "I will set no wicked thing before my eyes."

🔥 HOW THE DEVIL USES MEDIA & ENTERTAINMENT:
❌ Music normalizes rebellion, lust, and sin.
❌ Movies glorify darkness, witchcraft, and sexual immorality.
❌ Social media keeps you addicted, wasting precious time.
🚨 WHAT YOU CONSUME SHAPES YOUR SPIRITUAL LIFE!

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
If you pour dirty water into a glass every day, will it ever stay clean?
👉 NO! In the same way, if you constantly fill your heart with worldly things, how can you expect to stay spiritually strong?
📖 Galatians 6:7-8 – "Do not be deceived: God cannot be mocked. A man reaps what he sows."
🚨 WHAT YOU FEED YOUR SOUL TODAY WILL AFFECT YOUR ETERNITY!

🔥 5. WHAT MUST YOU DO? CHOOSE JESUS OVER TEMPORARY PLEASURE!
📖 1 John 2:17 – "The world and its desires pass away, but whoever does the will of God lives forever."

🔥 HOW TO BREAK FREE FROM SATAN’S TRAP:
✅ PUT GOD FIRST—Make Him your priority, not entertainment! (Matthew 6:33)
✅ CHOOSE HOLINESS—Reject anything that leads you away from Jesus! (2 Corinthians 6:17)
✅ SURROUND YOURSELF WITH GODLY PEOPLE—They will keep you accountable! (Hebrews 10:25)
✅ GUARD YOUR EYES & EARS—Be careful what you watch and listen to! (Psalm 101:3)
✅ USE YOUR LIFE FOR JESUS—Don’t waste time, because time is running out! (Ephesians 5:16)
🚨 SATAN WANTS YOU TO ‘JUST HAVE FUN’ BECAUSE HE KNOWS WHERE IT LEADS—HELL!
📖 Matthew 16:26 – "What does it profit a man to gain the whole world, yet forfeit his soul?"
🔥 CHOOSE WISELY! DON’T TRADE ETERNITY FOR TEMPORARY PLEASURE!

🙏 POWERFUL PRAYER FOR DELIVERANCE FROM WORLDLINESS!
"Lord Jesus, open my eyes to the traps of the enemy. Help me to desire holiness over pleasure and to live fully for You. Remove every distraction and strengthen me to walk in righteousness. I surrender my life to You completely! In Jesus’ name, AMEN!" 🙏🔥
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: 🔥 SATAN’S MOST DANGEROUS TRAP—AND MOST CHRISTIANS FALL FOR IT! 🚨🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 SATAN’S MOST DANGEROUS TRAP—AND MOST CHRISTIANS FALL FOR IT! 🚨🔥
📖 2 Corinthians 11:14 – "Even Satan disguises himself as an angel of light."
🚨 SATAN DOESN’T ALWAYS COME WITH HORNS AND A PITCHFORK—SOMETIMES HE COMES AS ‘GOOD ADVICE’ OR A ‘HARMLESS CHOICE!’

🔥 THE WORLD SAYS: "Just do what makes you happy!"
🔥 THE BIBLE SAYS: "There is a way that seems right to a man, but its end is the way of death." (Proverbs 14:12)
👉 MANY THINK THEY’RE SAFE—BUT THEY’RE WALKING STRAIGHT INTO SATAN’S TRAP! READ THIS BEFORE IT’S TOO LATE!

🔥 1. SATAN’S TRAP ISN’T ALWAYS OBVIOUS—IT LOOKS GOOD!
📖 Genesis 3:6 – "When the woman saw that the fruit of the tree was good for food and pleasing to the eye, she took some and ate it."

🔥 SATAN’S STRATEGY:
❌ He doesn’t tempt you with obvious evil—he makes sin look beautiful.
❌ He doesn’t tell you to reject God—he just makes you "too busy" to seek Him.
❌ He won’t say, "Follow me!"—he’ll say, "Follow your heart!"
🚨 BUT THE HEART CAN LIE!

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A young Christian started skipping church because "God knows my heart." Then, they stopped praying because "God understands." Before long, they were deep in sin, thinking "I’m still a good person."
📖 Jeremiah 17:9 – "The heart is deceitful above all things and desperately wicked."
👉 SATAN DOESN’T NEED YOU TO HATE GOD—HE JUST NEEDS YOU TO IGNORE HIM!

🔥 2. SATAN USES "GOOD THINGS" TO PULL YOU AWAY FROM GOD!
📖 Luke 8:14 – "The seed that fell among thorns stands for those who hear, but as they go on their way, they are choked by life’s worries, riches, and pleasures, and they do not mature."

🔥 COMMON TRAPS THAT SEEM "HARMLESS":
❌ Success & wealth – "You’re too busy to pray and read the Bible."
❌ Comfort & entertainment – "Just relax, don’t take faith too seriously."
❌ Relationships – "It’s okay to compromise if you love them."
❌ False religion – "As long as you’re spiritual, you’re fine."
🚨 SATAN KNOWS YOU WON’T RUN INTO SIN—SO HE SLOWLY DISTRACTS YOU UNTIL YOU’RE TOO FAR GONE!

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A woman loved God, but she started dating an unbeliever, thinking, "I can change him." Instead, he changed her. She stopped praying, stopped attending church, and eventually, her faith died.
📖 1 Corinthians 15:33 – "Do not be misled: 'Bad company corrupts good character.'"
👉 ARE YOU LETTING "GOOD THINGS" CHOKE OUT YOUR FAITH?

🔥 3. SATAN LOVES TO TWIST SCRIPTURE TO DECEIVE YOU!
📖 Matthew 4:6 – "If You are the Son of God," he said, "throw Yourself down. For it is written…"

🔥 SATAN USES HALF-TRUTHS TO LEAD YOU INTO A FULL LIE!
❌ "God is love—so He won’t send anyone to hell!"
❌ "Jesus died for all—so it doesn’t matter how you live!"
❌ "You don’t need church—God knows your heart!"
🚨 SATAN KNOWS THE BIBLE—DO YOU?

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A pastor stopped preaching about sin because he didn’t want to "judge." He said, "Jesus loves everyone!" But he ignored "Repent, or you will perish!" (Luke 13:3).
📖 Galatians 1:8 – "If anyone preaches a gospel other than the one we preached to you, let them be under God’s curse!"
👉 ARE YOU FOLLOWING A WATERED-DOWN GOSPEL THAT FEELS GOOD BUT LEADS TO DESTRUCTION?

🔥 4. SATAN’S FINAL TRAP—MAKING YOU THINK YOU HAVE TIME!
📖 2 Corinthians 6:2 – "Now is the time of God’s favor, now is the day of salvation!"

🔥 SATAN’S FAVORITE LIES ABOUT TIME:
❌ "You can get serious about God later!"
❌ "You’re young—enjoy life first!"
❌ "There’s no rush—God understands!"
🚨 BUT YOU AREN’T PROMISED TOMORROW!

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A young man ignored warnings to turn to Jesus. He thought he had time. One day, he died in a car accident. The saddest words? "He planned to give his life to Christ later." But later never came.
📖 James 4:14 – "You do not know what will happen tomorrow. Your life is a mist that appears for a little while and then vanishes."
👉 ARE YOU PUTTING OFF SALVATION, THINKING YOU HAVE TIME?

🔥 5. HOW TO ESCAPE SATAN’S TRAPS & STAY STRONG IN CHRIST!
📖 Ephesians 5:14 – "Wake up, sleeper, rise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you."

🔥 HOW TO OVERCOME SATAN’S DECEPTION:
✅ READ THE BIBLE DAILY – Know the truth so you won’t believe lies! (Psalm 119:105)
✅ PRAY FOR DISCERNMENT – Ask God to expose hidden traps! (James 1:5)
✅ SURROUND YOURSELF WITH STRONG BELIEVERS – Don’t walk alone! (Proverbs 27:17)
✅ OBEY GOD IMMEDIATELY – Don’t delay repentance! (Hebrews 3:15)
✅ PREACH THE GOSPEL – The more you share the truth, the harder it is for Satan to silence you! (Romans 1:16)
🚨 SATAN WANTS YOU IGNORANT, DISTRACTED, AND COMFORTABLE—BUT JESUS WANTS YOU ON FIRE FOR HIM!
📖 John 10:10 – "The thief comes only to steal, kill, and destroy; I have come that they may have life, and have it abundantly."
🔥 THE CHOICE IS YOURS—WILL YOU WAKE UP OR STAY DECEIVED?

🙏 POWERFUL PRAYER TO BREAK SATAN’S TRAPS!
"Lord Jesus, open my eyes to every deception I have believed. Fill me with Your truth and give me the boldness to stand for You. I reject Satan’s lies, and I choose to walk in Your Word. Use me to bring others out of darkness! In Jesus’ name, AMEN!" 🙏🔥
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: 🔥 "January 3: Trusting God with the Unknowns of This Year" 🔥
paragraphs: 🔥 "January 3: Trusting God with the Unknowns of This Year" 🔥

🌄 It’s January 3, 2025. The year is just beginning, and with it comes excitement, plans, and perhaps some uncertainty. You may have questions about what this year holds, but here’s the good news: God is already there.
📖 “Trust in the Lord with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding; in all your ways submit to Him, and He will make your paths straight.” (Proverbs 3:5-6)
No matter what lies ahead, you can trust God to guide you, provide for you, and fulfill His purpose in your life. Today is an opportunity to surrender your worries to Him and step forward in faith.

🌟 What Are You Holding Onto? 🌟
Do you find yourself holding onto fears about the future? Concerns about your job, relationships, or health? God invites you to release those burdens to Him.

💬 Example: A woman I know started 2024 worried about her family’s financial situation. Instead of letting fear consume her, she committed to daily prayer, asking God for wisdom and provision. By midyear, unexpected doors opened—new job opportunities and financial breakthroughs reminded her of God’s faithfulness.
👉 What about you? Is there something you need to release to God today?

🔥 3 Truths About Trusting God with Your Year 🔥
1️⃣ God Knows the Future 🌅
While we don’t know what tomorrow holds, God does. He sees the bigger picture, and His plans are always good.

💬 Example: A missionary couple I met had no idea how they would fund their trip to serve in Southeast Asia. But as they prayed and trusted God, unexpected donations poured in, and their needs were met beyond their expectations.
📖 “For I know the plans I have for you,” declares the Lord, “plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future.” (Jeremiah 29:11)
📝 Action Step: Write down one worry you have for this year. Pray over it and give it to God, trusting Him to guide your path.

2️⃣ God Provides What You Need 💖
When you trust God, you’ll find that He provides exactly what you need at the right time—not always what you expect, but always what’s best.

💬 Example: A family in South America prayed for months about finding a home closer to their church. Just when they were about to give up, a friend offered them a rental property that was perfect for their needs.
📖 “And my God will meet all your needs according to the riches of His glory in Christ Jesus.” (Philippians 4:19)
📝 Action Step: Reflect on a time God provided for you in the past. Let it remind you of His faithfulness as you face the future.

3️⃣ God Walks with You Always 🌌
You’re never alone. No matter what this year holds, God promises to walk beside you every step of the way.

💬 Example: Last year, a man in the Philippines faced a difficult season of illness. He shared how he felt God’s presence in the prayers and support of his church family. He said, “I realized I was never alone—God was with me through it all.”
📖 “Even though I walk through the darkest valley, I will fear no evil, for You are with me; Your rod and Your staff, they comfort me.” (Psalm 23:4)
📝 Action Step: Take a moment today to thank God for His presence in your life. No matter what you face, He is with you.

🌍 Surrender Your Year to God 🌍
As 2025 unfolds, there will be unexpected joys and unforeseen challenges. But when you trust God with your year, you can walk in confidence, knowing He’s in control.
➡️ What’s one area of your life you need to surrender to God today? Whether it’s your plans, your fears, or your relationships, He’s ready to carry the burden with you.

📜 Faith Declaration for January 3 📜
“I trust God with my future. I surrender my worries, plans, and fears to Him, knowing He is faithful to guide me, provide for me, and walk with me through every moment of this year.”

🔥 The "Trust God Today Challenge" 🔥
1️⃣ Write down one worry or fear you have about this year. Surrender it to God in prayer.
2️⃣ Reflect on a time when God’s faithfulness surprised you.
3️⃣ Encourage someone else today with a reminder of God’s goodness and provision.
➡️ Let’s inspire one another to trust God more deeply this year!

🌌 "God Is Faithful Yesterday, Today, and Forever" 🌌
📖 “Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and today and forever.” (Hebrews 13:8)
God’s faithfulness doesn’t change. He was with you last year, He’s with you today, and He’ll be with you tomorrow. Step into this year with courage and confidence, trusting Him every step of the way.

🙏 A Prayer for January 3, 2025 🙏
Heavenly Father,
Thank You for being a God we can trust. As we step into this new day, help us to surrender our worries and fears to You. Teach us to rely on Your guidance, Your provision, and Your presence in every moment of our lives. Let us walk in faith, knowing that You are always with us.
In Jesus’ name, Amen. ✝️
✨ Let’s inspire the world to trust God with this year and every moment ahead! 🌍❤️✨
#TrustGodWith2025 #faithoverfear #Godisfaithful #surrendertoGod #startfreshwithfaith #walkwithjesusdaily #HopeForToday #EveryDayMatters

title: 🔥 ARE YOU A TRUE CHRISTIAN OR JUST A SUNDAY CHURCHGOER? 🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 ARE YOU A TRUE CHRISTIAN OR JUST A SUNDAY CHURCHGOER? 🔥
📖 Luke 9:23 – "Whoever wants to be My disciple must deny themselves and take up their cross daily and follow Me."
Many people claim to be Christians. They go to church, they pray before meals, and they might even own a Bible. But does that make them true followers of Jesus?

🚨 Going to church doesn’t make you a Christian any more than standing in a garage makes you a car.
🚨 Reading the Bible occasionally doesn’t mean you have a relationship with God.
🚨 Saying "I believe in Jesus" means nothing if your life doesn’t reflect it.
👉 ARE YOU TRULY FOLLOWING CHRIST, OR ARE YOU JUST PLAYING CHURCH?

🔥 1. A TRUE CHRISTIAN FOLLOWS JESUS EVERY DAY, NOT JUST ON SUNDAYS
📖 Matthew 7:21 – "Not everyone who says to Me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter the kingdom of heaven, but only the one who does the will of My Father who is in heaven."
🔥 TRUE CHRISTIANITY IS A LIFESTYLE, NOT A WEEKLY RITUAL.

❌ A Sunday churchgoer:
• Worships on Sunday but lives in sin the rest of the week.
• Prays in church but never prays in private.
• Knows about Jesus but doesn’t truly know Him.

✔️ A true Christian:
• Worships God every day, not just when people are watching.
• Prays consistently, even in secret.
• Doesn’t just believe in Jesus but follows Him fully.

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
Imagine someone who tells their spouse, "I love you," but then ignores them every day except for one hour on Sunday.
Would you call that a real relationship? Of course not! So why do people treat God that way?
👉 Jesus isn’t looking for weekend Christians. He’s looking for disciples!

🔥 2. A TRUE CHRISTIAN LIVES IN OBEDIENCE TO GOD
📖 John 14:15 – "If you love Me, keep My commandments."
🔥 REAL FAITH PRODUCES OBEDIENCE.

❌ A Sunday churchgoer:
• Says, "God knows my heart" to excuse their sin.
• Ignores God’s commands and follows the world.
• Thinks just believing in Jesus is enough.

✔️ A true Christian:
• Obeys God, even when it’s hard.
• Turns away from sin and seeks holiness.
• Understands that true faith leads to a changed life.

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
If a doctor tells you, "You need to stop eating junk food or you’ll die," but you continue eating it, do you really trust the doctor?
If you say you believe in Jesus but ignore what He commands, do you really believe in Him?
👉 Jesus doesn’t just want believers—He wants followers!

🔥 3. A TRUE CHRISTIAN STANDS STRONG IN THEIR FAITH
📖 Romans 12:2 – "Do not conform to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind."
🔥 A TRUE CHRISTIAN CHOOSES JESUS OVER THE WORLD.

❌ A Sunday churchgoer:
• Loves the world more than God.
• Compromises their faith to fit in.
• Stays silent about Jesus to avoid offending people.

✔️ A true Christian:
• Puts God first, no matter the cost.
• Stands for truth, even when it’s unpopular.
• Boldly shares the gospel without fear.

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
If you were arrested for being a Christian, would there be enough evidence to convict you?
If no one at work or school knows you’re a Christian, are you truly living for Christ?
👉 Being a Christian isn’t about comfort—it’s about commitment!

🔥 4. A TRUE CHRISTIAN BEARS FRUIT
📖 Matthew 7:16 – "You will recognize them by their fruits."
🔥 YOUR ACTIONS REVEAL IF YOU TRULY BELONG TO JESUS.

❌ A Sunday churchgoer:
• Goes to church but remains spiritually dead.
• Lives no differently than an unbeliever.
• Has no passion for God or sharing the gospel.

✔️ A true Christian:
• Grows in faith and spiritual maturity.
• Shows love, kindness, patience, and self-control.
• Desires to spread the gospel and make disciples.

💡 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A tree is known by its fruit. If an apple tree never produces apples, is it really an apple tree?
If someone claims to be a Christian but their life produces no fruit, are they truly saved?
👉 If Jesus has changed your heart, it should show in your life!

🔥 FINAL WARNING: CHURCH MEMBERSHIP WON’T SAVE YOU!
📖 2 Corinthians 13:5 – "Examine yourselves to see whether you are in the faith."

🚨 THE TRUTH IS, MANY PEOPLE WHO THINK THEY ARE CHRISTIANS… ARE NOT.
• They go to church but don’t have a relationship with Jesus.
• They say they believe in God but live like He doesn’t exist.
• They sing worship songs but their hearts are far from Him.

🔥 DON’T BE A CASUAL CHRISTIAN—BE A TRUE DISCIPLE!
✔️ Surrender your whole life to Jesus.
✔️ Live in obedience, not just empty belief.
✔️ Follow Jesus every day, not just on Sundays.
📖 Matthew 16:24 – "Whoever wants to be My disciple must deny themselves and take up their cross and follow Me."
👉 WILL YOU BE A TRUE CHRISTIAN, OR JUST A CHURCHGOER?

🙏 POWERFUL PRAYER TO TRULY FOLLOW JESUS
"Lord Jesus, I don’t want to just be a Sunday Christian—I want to follow You with my whole heart! Forgive me for living lukewarm. I surrender my life to You completely. Teach me to walk in Your ways every day. In Jesus’ name, AMEN!"
author: Gospel Warrior (John Domino Sanchez Asis)

title: 🔥 THERE IS NO SUCH THING AS ‘YOUR TRUTH’—ONLY GOD’S TRUTH! 🚨🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 THERE IS NO SUCH THING AS ‘YOUR TRUTH’—ONLY GOD’S TRUTH! 🚨🔥
📖 John 17:17 – "Sanctify them by the truth; Your word is truth."
🚨 We live in a world that preaches, "Live your truth!" But what happens when "your truth" contradicts someone else's "truth"?

🔥 THE WORLD SAYS: "Truth is whatever you feel it is!"
🔥 THE BIBLE SAYS: "God’s Word is the ONLY truth!"
👉 Are you following the absolute truth of God, or are you believing the lies of the world?

🔥 1. THE LIE OF "YOUR TRUTH" IS SATAN’S OLDEST TRICK!
📖 Genesis 3:1 – "Did God really say…?"

🔥 SATAN IN THE GARDEN OF EDEN:
The devil didn’t tell Eve, "God is wrong."
He simply asked, "Did God really say that?"

❌ This is exactly what the world does today!
👉 "The Bible is old-fashioned."
👉 "Times have changed."
👉 "Truth is different for everyone."
🚨 BUT TRUTH DOESN’T CHANGE!
📖 Malachi 3:6 – "I the Lord do not change."

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
Imagine a judge telling a murderer:
"I respect your truth. If you believe killing was right for you, then you’re free to go!"
❌ THAT WOULD BE MADNESS!
👉 So why do people think they can apply this same logic to morality, salvation, and eternity?
🚨 THERE IS ONLY ONE STANDARD—GOD’S WORD!

🔥 2. IF "YOUR TRUTH" CONTRADICTS GOD’S WORD, IT’S A LIE!
📖 2 Timothy 4:3-4 – "For the time will come when people will not endure sound doctrine… but will turn away from the truth and turn aside to myths."
🔥 WHAT THE WORLD SAYS VS. WHAT GOD SAYS:

❌ "Love is love!"
📖 Genesis 2:24 – "A man shall leave his father and mother and be joined to his wife."

❌ "God knows my heart, so I don’t need to change!"
📖 Jeremiah 17:9 – "The heart is deceitful above all things and desperately wicked."

❌ "I can believe whatever I want about God!"
📖 John 14:6 – "I am THE way, THE truth, and THE life. No one comes to the Father except through Me."
🚨 THE TRUTH DOESN’T CARE ABOUT YOUR OPINION—IT STANDS FIRM!

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A man jumps off a building and says, "Gravity is not my truth!"
❌ No matter what he believes, he will hit the ground!
👉 Likewise, ignoring God’s truth won’t stop judgment from coming!

🔥 3. JESUS DIDN’T COME TO TEACH "PERSONAL TRUTH"—HE CAME TO REVEAL GOD’S TRUTH!
📖 John 8:31-32 – "If you abide in My word… you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free."

🔥 JESUS NEVER SAID:
❌ "Follow your heart."
❌ "Do what makes you happy."
❌ "Everyone’s truth is valid."

🔥 JESUS SAID:
✅ "Deny yourself, take up your cross, and follow Me!" (Luke 9:23)
✅ "Repent and believe the Gospel!" (Mark 1:15)
✅ "Sanctify them by the truth; Your word is truth!" (John 17:17)
🚨 JESUS DIDN’T COME TO VALIDATE YOUR FEELINGS—HE CAME TO SAVE YOUR SOUL!

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
If a doctor tells a patient, "You have cancer, but I don’t want to offend you, so I’ll just say you’re fine,"
❌ That doctor is sending them to their death!
👉 In the same way, churches that avoid preaching the full truth are leading people to hell!
🚨 DO YOU WANT A FEEL-GOOD LIE OR A TRUTH THAT SAVES?

🔥 4. THE COST OF REJECTING GOD’S TRUTH—ETERNAL SEPARATION FROM HIM!
📖 2 Thessalonians 2:10-12 – "They refused to love the truth and so be saved. For this reason, God sends them a strong delusion, so that all will be condemned who did not believe the truth."

🔥 WHAT HAPPENS WHEN YOU IGNORE GOD’S TRUTH?
❌ You will be deceived!
❌ You will fall deeper into sin!
❌ You will harden your heart!
❌ You will be unprepared for judgment!
🚨 THIS IS A WARNING—IF YOU REJECT GOD’S TRUTH LONG ENOUGH, HE WILL LET YOU BELIEVE THE LIE!

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A man keeps ignoring his GPS and follows his own "truth" about directions.
👉 He doesn’t end up where he wanted—he gets completely lost!
📖 Proverbs 14:12 – "There is a way that seems right to a man, but in the end, it leads to death."
🚨 DON’T WAIT UNTIL IT’S TOO LATE!

🔥 5. WHAT MUST YOU DO? RETURN TO THE ABSOLUTE TRUTH OF GOD!
📖 John 14:6 – "I am THE way, THE truth, and THE life. No one comes to the Father except through Me."

🔥 HOW TO ESCAPE THE LIES OF THE WORLD:
✅ REJECT "YOUR TRUTH" AND SURRENDER TO GOD’S TRUTH! (Romans 12:2)

title: 🍗🔥 Presenting: PiX Ultimate Chicken Afritada™ – My Most Delicious Dish Ever! 🔥🍍
paragraphs: 🍗🔥 Presenting: PiX Ultimate Chicken Afritada™ – My Most Delicious Dish Ever! 🔥🍍

Mga higala, sa tanan nakong giluto, THIS IS MY FAVORITE! 🤯
Yes, tanan akong dishes lami, pero kini? THE BEST! 😆
This isn’t just afritada—it’s PiX Ultimate Chicken Afritada™!

🔥 Why is this my best dish ever?
✔ The oyster sauce gives it the deepest, richest umami flavor!
✔ Hunt’s Pork & Beans makes the sauce creamy and irresistible!
✔ Pineapple adds the perfect balance of sweetness and tang!
✔ The tomato-based sauce is thick, flavorful, and sticks to the chicken perfectly!

And the verdict?
🎤 My family took one bite, looked at each other, and all at once—BURRRRP! 🤣
💛 "Pa, this is it. This is THE ONE. Wala’y lain luto nimo nga naka-beat ani!"
And I had to agree. Sa tanan nakong giluto, THIS IS THE MOST DELICIOUS. Period. 😆🔥
📖 Biblical Reflection – Excellence in Cooking & Life!

God wants us to always improve—to take the skills He gave us and make something even better!
💡 Colossians 3:23 – “Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for the Lord.”
💡 Ecclesiastes 9:10 – “Whatever your hand finds to do, do it with all your might.”

And that includes COOKING! 😂
If you’re gonna make Chicken Afritada, make it the best Chicken Afritada possible!
🔥 PiX Ultimate Chicken Afritada Recipe (Serves 6) 🔥
🛑 INGREDIENTS (Prepare to Be Blown Away!)

🐔 1 kg (2.2 lbs) chicken (cut into serving pieces)
🍅 1 ½ packs ready-made Afritada sauce
🥫 1 ½ cans (390g each) Hunt’s Pork and Beans
🍍 1 small can (227g) pineapple tidbits (with syrup, optional)
🥕 1 large carrot (cubed)
🫑 1 ½ bell peppers (sliced)
🧅 1 medium onion (chopped)
🧄 4 cloves garlic (minced)
💦 1 ½ cups water or chicken broth
🐓 1 chicken bouillon cube (dissolved in hot water)
✨ 1 small pack Magic Sarap
🐟 1 ½ tbsp fish sauce (patis) or salt to taste
🫙 ¾ tsp ground black pepper
🦪 2 tbsp oyster sauce (for insane umami flavor!)
🔥 3 tbsp cooking oil
🔥 HOW TO COOK PiX ULTIMATE AFRITADA™ – THE NEXT-LEVEL PINOY DISH! 🔥
1️⃣ Sauté the Aromatics – Unlock the Flavor!

🔥 Heat 3 tbsp oil in a pan over medium heat.
🧄 Sauté garlic and onion until fragrant.
👃 If your kitchen smells amazing already, you’re on the right track!
2️⃣ Brown the Chicken – Lock in the Juices!

🐔 Add chicken pieces and cook until lightly browned on all sides (about 5-7 minutes).
👉 This gives the chicken a richer, deeper flavor.
3️⃣ Boost the Flavor – The Secret Touch!

💦 Pour in 1 ½ cups of hot water and dissolve 1 chicken cube in it.
🦪 Stir in 2 tbsp oyster sauce—this will deepen the umami flavor and make the sauce richer!
🔥 Let it simmer for 5 minutes to allow the flavors to blend.
4️⃣ Add the Afritada Sauce – The Heart of the Dish!

🍅 Stir in 1 ½ packs of Afritada sauce and mix well.
🔥 Let it simmer for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
5️⃣ Cook the Carrots – Soft, But Not Mushy!

🥕 Add carrots and let them cook for 10 minutes until slightly soft.
👉 This ensures they soak up all the delicious sauce!
6️⃣ Add Hunt’s Pork & Beans & Pineapple – The Game Changers!

🥫 Stir in 1 ½ cans of Hunt’s Pork & Beans—this makes the sauce richer, thicker, and more flavorful!
🍍 Add pineapple tidbits (with or without syrup, depending on how sweet you like it!).
🔥 Let it cook for 5 more minutes.
7️⃣ Season It Well – The Final Touch!

✨ Sprinkle 1 pack of Magic Sarap, fish sauce, and black pepper.
🥄 Stir well and let it cook for 2 more minutes.
8️⃣ Add Bell Peppers – Color + Aroma = Perfection!

🫑 Add bell peppers and cook for another 2 minutes before turning off the heat.
🔥 This keeps the peppers slightly crisp and fresh.
9️⃣ Serve & Enjoy! – The Moment of Truth!
🍚 Serve hot with steamed rice and watch your family BURP in satisfaction! 🤣
🔥 Why PiX Ultimate Chicken Afritada™ is the Best Dish Ever? 🔥

✅ Oyster sauce makes it mind-blowingly savory! 🦪🔥
✅ Hunt’s Pork & Beans gives it a creamy, rich sauce! 🥫
✅ Pineapple balances the sweet & savory elements perfectly! 🍍
✅ Magic Sarap + Chicken Bouillon = INSANE FLAVOR BOOST! 🧂🔥
✅ It’s the BEST I’ve ever made—and my family agrees! 🤤
🌿 Health Benefits of PiX Ultimate Afritada™:

✅ Boosts Energy – Protein-packed from chicken and beans.
✅ Rich in Vitamin A & C – Thanks to carrots, bell peppers, and pineapple!
✅ Immune System Boost – Garlic, onions, and tomatoes are full of antioxidants!
✅ Good for Digestion – Tomato-based sauces and fiber-rich veggies support gut health!
🔥 Final Thoughts: My New Favorite Dish! 🔥

🔥 If I had to choose only one dish to eat forever—THIS IS IT!
🔥 Sometimes, the best dishes aren’t planned—they just happen!
🔥 If you’re going to cook, make it the BEST version possible!

Sa tanan nakong giluto, this is my #1. And my family agrees—no debate!
Now, kinsa ganahan mo-try ani? 🤣
Let’s share food, faith, and fun! 😆🙌

#TheBestDishEver
#HuntsPorkAndBeansMagic
#OysterSauceForTheWin
#BURPApproved

#TasteAndSee

title: 🔥 THE DEVIL DOESN’T WANT YOU TO READ THIS—HERE’S WHY! 🚨🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 THE DEVIL DOESN’T WANT YOU TO READ THIS—HERE’S WHY! 🚨🔥
📖 Hosea 4:6 – "My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge."
🚨 Satan’s biggest weapon is not force—it’s deception. He doesn’t need to destroy you if he can just keep you blind!

🔥 THE WORLD SAYS: "The Bible is outdated! Just follow your heart!"
🔥 THE BIBLE SAYS: "The heart is deceitful above all things." (Jeremiah 17:9)
👉 What if everything you thought was "harmless" was actually Satan’s trap? Keep reading—this might be the most important message you’ll ever see!

🔥 1. SATAN’S GOAL IS TO KEEP YOU IGNORANT OF THE TRUTH!
📖 2 Corinthians 4:4 – "The god of this world has blinded the minds of unbelievers, so they cannot see the light of the gospel."

🔥 HOW SATAN KEEPS PEOPLE BLIND:
❌ He fills their minds with distractions.
❌ He twists the truth to make lies sound good.
❌ He makes them believe they already know everything.
🚨 WHAT YOU DON’T KNOW CAN DESTROY YOU!

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A man ignored warnings about a bridge being out and kept driving because "I don’t believe it." He realized too late that truth isn’t based on belief—it’s based on reality!
📖 John 8:32 – "Then you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free."
👉 WHAT IF EVERYTHING YOU WERE TAUGHT ABOUT GOD ISN’T BIBLICAL? IT’S TIME TO FIND OUT!

🔥 2. SATAN WANTS YOU TO STAY COMFORTABLE IN A LIE!
📖 2 Timothy 4:3 – "For the time will come when people will not put up with sound doctrine… they will gather around them teachers who say what their itching ears want to hear."

🔥 SATAN’S FAVORITE LIES:
❌ "You’re a good person, so you’ll go to heaven!"
❌ "God loves you, so it doesn’t matter how you live!"
❌ "Hell isn’t real—it’s just a scare tactic!"
🚨 BUT JESUS WARNED ABOUT FALSE TEACHINGS THAT LEAD TO HELL!

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A woman believed "all religions lead to God" until she read John 14:6—"I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me." She realized she had been deceived her whole life.
📖 Matthew 7:13-14 – "Wide is the road that leads to destruction, and many enter through it. But small is the gate and narrow the road that leads to life, and only a few find it."
👉 ARE YOU ON THE NARROW ROAD, OR ARE YOU FOLLOWING THE CROWD?

🔥 3. SATAN WILL DO ANYTHING TO KEEP YOU FROM READING THE BIBLE!
📖 Psalm 119:105 – "Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path."

🔥 WHY SATAN HATES THE BIBLE:
❌ It exposes his lies.
❌ It teaches you how to defeat him.
❌ It shows you the way to eternal life.
🚨 THE LESS YOU READ THE BIBLE, THE MORE VULNERABLE YOU ARE TO DECEPTION!

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A Christian stopped reading his Bible because he was "too busy." Over time, he became weak in faith, started compromising, and eventually walked away from God.
📖 Matthew 4:4 – "Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds from the mouth of God."
👉 ARE YOU STARVING YOUR SOUL BY IGNORING GOD’S WORD?

🔥 4. SATAN WANTS TO SILENCE YOU FROM SPEAKING THE TRUTH!
📖 Romans 10:14 – "How can they believe in the one of whom they have not heard? And how can they hear without someone preaching to them?"

🔥 SATAN’S ATTACK ON CHRISTIANS:
❌ He tells them to "keep their faith private."
❌ He makes them afraid of being "canceled" for speaking truth.
❌ He convinces them that "someone else will preach the gospel."
🚨 BUT IF YOU STAY SILENT, WHO WILL WARN THE LOST?

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A man stayed silent about his faith at work. After a coworker died suddenly, he realized—"I never told him about Jesus."
📖 Ezekiel 33:6 – "If the watchman sees the sword coming and does not blow the trumpet… I will require his blood at the watchman's hand."
👉 WHO NEEDS TO HEAR THE GOSPEL FROM YOU BEFORE IT’S TOO LATE?

🔥 5. WHAT MUST YOU DO? WAKE UP & BREAK FREE FROM SATAN’S TRAP!
📖 Ephesians 5:14 – "Wake up, sleeper, rise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you."

🔥 HOW TO DESTROY SATAN’S LIES:
✅ STUDY THE BIBLE DAILY—Fill yourself with truth! (2 Timothy 3:16-17)
✅ PRAY FOR DISCERNMENT—Ask God to open your eyes! (James 1:5)
✅ SPEAK THE TRUTH—Stop being afraid of offending people! (Galatians 1:10)
✅ SEPARATE FROM SIN—Don’t let the world shape your beliefs! (Romans 12:2)
✅ SHARE THE GOSPEL—Warn others before it’s too late! (Mark 16:15)
🚨 SATAN WANTS YOU IGNORANT, WEAK, AND SILENT—BUT JESUS WANTS YOU STRONG, BOLD, AND FREE!
📖 John 10:10 – "The thief comes only to steal, kill, and destroy; I have come that they may have life, and have it abundantly."
🔥 THE CHOICE IS YOURS—WILL YOU WAKE UP OR STAY DECEIVED?

🙏 POWERFUL PRAYER TO BREAK SATAN’S DECEPTION!
"Lord Jesus, open my eyes to every lie I have believed. Fill me with Your truth and give me the boldness to stand for You. I reject Satan’s deception, and I choose to walk in Your Word. Use me to bring others out of darkness! In Jesus’ name, AMEN!" 🙏🔥

title: 🔥 STOP MAKING EXCUSES—YOUR SOUL IS AT RISK! 🚨🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 STOP MAKING EXCUSES—YOUR SOUL IS AT RISK! 🚨🔥
📖 Luke 14:18 – "But they all alike began to make excuses."

🚨 MANY PEOPLE WANT HEAVEN—BUT FEW WANT TO FOLLOW JESUS! WHY?
Because they have EXCUSES!
❌ "I’ll follow God later!"
❌ "I’m too busy!"
❌ "God understands!"

🔥 BUT THE TRUTH IS—EXCUSES WON’T SAVE YOU ON JUDGMENT DAY!
📖 2 Corinthians 6:2 – "Now is the day of salvation!"
👉 ARE YOU TRULY FOLLOWING JESUS, OR JUST MAKING EXCUSES? THIS MESSAGE MAY BE YOUR FINAL WARNING!

🔥 1. "I’LL FOLLOW GOD LATER!"—BUT WHAT IF THERE IS NO LATER?
📖 James 4:14 – "You do not know what will happen tomorrow. Your life is a mist that appears for a little while and then vanishes."

🔥 THE DEVIL’S FAVORITE LIE:
"You have plenty of time to get right with God!"
🚨 BUT YOU AREN’T PROMISED TOMORROW!

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A young man planned to follow Jesus "later"—but he never got the chance. He died suddenly in a car accident. He thought he had more time, but hell is full of people who thought the same.
📖 Proverbs 27:1 – "Do not boast about tomorrow, for you do not know what a day may bring."
👉 ARE YOU PUTTING OFF YOUR SALVATION, THINKING YOU HAVE TIME?

🔥 2. "I’M TOO BUSY!"—BUT NOTHING IS MORE IMPORTANT THAN YOUR SOUL!
📖 Mark 8:36 – "What does it profit a man to gain the whole world and lose his soul?"
🔥 SATAN DOESN’T NEED YOU TO HATE GOD—HE JUST NEEDS YOU DISTRACTED!

❌ Too busy with work? Your job won’t save you!
❌ Too busy with family? Your family can’t save you!
❌ Too busy having fun? Eternity is forever!
🚨 DON’T WAIT UNTIL IT’S TOO LATE!

A woman was too busy chasing success. She said, "I’ll focus on God when I retire." But she died at 45. She planned for her future on earth but ignored her eternity.
📖 Ecclesiastes 12:1 – "Remember your Creator in the days of your youth."
👉 WHAT IS KEEPING YOU TOO "BUSY" TO FOLLOW JESUS?

🔥 3. "GOD UNDERSTANDS MY HEART!"—YES, AND THAT SHOULD SCARE YOU!
📖 Jeremiah 17:9 – "The heart is deceitful above all things, and desperately wicked."

🔥 WHAT PEOPLE SAY:
❌ "God knows my heart, so I don’t have to repent!"
❌ "I love God in my own way, so I don’t need to obey the Bible!"
❌ "God is loving, so He won’t judge me!"
🚨 BUT THE BIBLE SAYS—IF YOU LOVE GOD, YOU WILL OBEY HIM!

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A man lived in sin but said, "God understands!" He ignored every warning. But on Judgment Day, Jesus won’t say ‘I understand’—He will say ‘DEPART FROM ME!’
📖 Matthew 7:21-23 – "Not everyone who says to Me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter the kingdom of heaven."
👉 ARE YOU USING "GOD UNDERSTANDS" AS AN EXCUSE FOR DISOBEDIENCE?

🔥 4. "I’M A GOOD PERSON!"—BUT GOOD PEOPLE DON’T GO TO HEAVEN, SAVED PEOPLE DO!
📖 Romans 3:10 – "There is no one righteous, not even one."

🔥 THE LIE:
"I don’t need Jesus—I’m a good person!"
🚨 BUT THE BIBLE SAYS YOUR GOODNESS ISN’T ENOUGH!

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A man spent his life helping others but never surrendered to Jesus. He thought his "good deeds" would save him. But without Jesus, NO ONE is good enough!
📖 Isaiah 64:6 – "All our righteous acts are like filthy rags."
👉 ARE YOU TRUSTING IN YOUR GOODNESS INSTEAD OF JESUS?

🔥 5. "I GO TO CHURCH!"—BUT CHURCH WON’T SAVE YOU, ONLY JESUS CAN!
📖 John 14:6 – "I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me."

🔥 WHAT PEOPLE THINK:
❌ "I go to church, so I’m saved!"
❌ "My parents are Christian, so I’m fine!"
❌ "I grew up religious!"
🚨 BUT JESUS DIDN’T DIE FOR A RELIGION—HE DIED TO SAVE YOU!

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A churchgoer thought attending church was enough. He never repented, never read the Bible, and never truly followed Jesus. But a church membership won’t get you into heaven!
📖 Matthew 15:8 – "These people honor Me with their lips, but their hearts are far from Me."
👉 ARE YOU RELIGIOUS, OR ARE YOU SAVED?

🔥 FINAL WARNING: NO MORE EXCUSES—IT’S TIME TO FOLLOW JESUS!
📖 Hebrews 3:15 – "Today, if you hear His voice, do not harden your hearts."

🔥 EXCUSES WON’T STAND BEFORE GOD!
❌ "I was too busy!" – Your time was a gift from God!
❌ "I thought I had more time!" – You were warned!
❌ "I was a good person!" – Your righteousness wasn’t enough!
❌ "I went to church!" – Salvation is through Jesus, not a building!
🚨 JESUS IS CALLING—BUT THE DOOR WON’T STAY OPEN FOREVER!

🔥 REAL-LIFE DECISION:
You have two choices:
✔️ Repent, surrender, and follow Jesus!
❌ Keep making excuses—and face judgment!
📖 Romans 10:9 – "If you confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God raised Him from the dead, you will be saved."
👉 WHAT WILL YOU CHOOSE?

🙏 POWERFUL PRAYER TO SURRENDER TO JESUS!
"Lord Jesus, I surrender my excuses! I repent of my sins and choose to follow You completely. No more delays, no more distractions! Be my Lord and Savior! In Jesus’ name, AMEN!" 🙏🔥

title: "Going to Church Doesn’t Make You a Christian – Knowing Jesus Does" 🔥
paragraphs:
"Going to Church Doesn’t Make You a Christian – Knowing Jesus Does" 🔥
✝️ A Message from Brother John Domino "PiX" S. Asis – Follower of Jesus Christ and a Servant of God
🌍 A shocking truth: Not everyone in church is truly saved.

Sitting in a church does not make you a Christian any more than sitting in a garage makes you a car.
Reading the Bible does not guarantee you know Jesus unless you obey Him.
Saying "I'm a Christian" means nothing if your life doesn’t reflect Christ.
📖 “Not everyone who says to Me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter the kingdom of heaven, but only the one who does the will of My Father who is in heaven.” (Matthew 7:21)
💡 Jesus didn’t come to create churchgoers—He came to save souls.

🔥 The Truth: Religion Can’t Save You – Only Jesus Can
Many people think they are saved because they:
✅ Go to church every Sunday.
✅ Own a Bible and know verses.
✅ Pray when they need something.

But Jesus didn’t say, "Attend church and be saved."
He said:
📖 “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.” (John 14:6)
🚨 Christianity is not a religion—it’s a relationship with Jesus Christ.

🔥 Why Church Attendance Alone is Not Enough
1️⃣ Jesus is Looking for a Relationship, Not a Routine
Many people show up to church but don’t show up in their walk with Jesus.
📖 “This people honors Me with their lips, but their heart is far from Me.” (Matthew 15:8)
💡 Christianity is not about religious activities—it’s about knowing Jesus personally.

2️⃣ The Pharisees Went to ‘Church’ Every Day – And Still Went to Hell
The Pharisees were experts in religion, yet Jesus called them hypocrites.

📖 “You study the Scriptures diligently because you think that in them you have eternal life. These are the very Scriptures that testify about Me, yet you refuse to come to Me to have life.” (John 5:39-40)
🚨 Knowing ABOUT Jesus is not the same as KNOWING Jesus.

3️⃣ Faith Without Obedience is Dead
Going to church without true faith is like owning a gym membership but never exercising.
📖 “Faith by itself, if it is not accompanied by action, is dead.” (James 2:17)
💡 A true Christian doesn’t just listen to the Word—they live it out.

🔥 How Do You Know If You’re Truly a Christian?
Jesus gave clear signs of what a real Christian looks like:
✅ 1. You have a personal relationship with Jesus.

You don’t just talk about God—you talk to Him daily.
📖 “This is eternal life: that they know You, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom You have sent.” (John 17:3)
✅ 2. Your life is transformed by the Holy Spirit.

You repent from sin and strive to live in holiness.
📖 “If anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation; the old has passed away, the new has come.” (2 Corinthians 5:17)
✅ 3. You obey Jesus’ commands.

It’s not about just believing—it’s about following.
📖 “Whoever has My commands and keeps them is the one who loves Me.” (John 14:21)
🔥 Warning: Many Churchgoers Will Be Shocked on Judgment Day
Jesus said that many people will think they are saved, only to hear these terrifying words:
📖 “I never knew you. Depart from Me, you workers of lawlessness.” (Matthew 7:23)
🚨 Going to church won’t save you. Knowing Jesus will.

🔥 How to Truly Follow Jesus (Not Just Be Religious)
1️⃣ Repent and Believe in Jesus Christ Alone.

Going to church doesn’t save you—Jesus does.
📖 “Unless you repent, you will all perish.” (Luke 13:3)
2️⃣ Commit to a Daily Relationship with Jesus.

Read the Bible, pray, and obey His Word every day.
📖 “Draw near to God, and He will draw near to you.” (James 4:8)
3️⃣ Live Out Your Faith in Public, Not Just in Church.

Christianity is 24/7, not just Sunday mornings.
📖 “Let your light shine before others.” (Matthew 5:16)
🚀 The real proof of your faith is not inside the church—it’s in how you live every day.

📜 FAITH DECLARATION FOR JANUARY 18, 2025 📜
"Today, I choose to KNOW Jesus, not just go to church. I surrender my heart fully to Him and commit to a real relationship with Christ—not just religious habits."

🔥 THE “KNOW JESUS” CHALLENGE 🔥
✅ Step 1: Examine your heart—are you truly saved, or just religious?
✅ Step 2: If you’re truly saved, share your testimony today.
✅ Step 3: Tag 3 friends and challenge them to evaluate their faith.

🌌 DON'T JUST GO TO CHURCH – BE THE CHURCH 🌌
📖 “Be doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving yourselves.” (James 1:22)

👉 It’s time to stop playing church and start following Jesus for real.
👉 Eternity is too long to be wrong. Make sure your faith is real today.

🙏 PRAYER FOR JANUARY 18, 2025 🙏
Heavenly Father,
Thank You for showing me that salvation is not about a title but a true relationship with Jesus Christ. I repent from trusting in my own goodness or traditions, and today, I put my full faith in Jesus alone. Help me to live as a true follower, walking in obedience and love for You.
In Jesus’ name, Amen. ✝️

title: 🔥 "This Is Your Year: The Global Call to Live Boldly for Christ" 🔥
paragraphs: 🔥 "This Is Your Year: The Global Call to Live Boldly for Christ" 🔥
🌍 Happy New Year! 🌍 January 1, 2025, marks the start of a new chapter—a chance to live boldly for Jesus. But let me ask you:
👉 Are you truly living for Christ, or are you letting the distractions of the world take His place?

📖 Jesus said, “What good is it for someone to gain the whole world, yet forfeit their soul?” (Mark 8:36). This isn’t just a question—it’s a wake-up call for every believer across the globe. Today is the day to start fresh and step fully into your God-given purpose. 🕊️

🌍 Your Life Matters—Globally 🌍
💬 Imagine this: What if 2025 isn’t just about personal resolutions but about a worldwide movement of faith? What if millions of believers stood together, united in love and purpose, sharing the light of Christ in every corner of the Earth?

✨ The world is looking for hope, and you are called to be that light.
🌟 Example: Last year, a group of friends in Kenya started sharing daily Bible verses online. Their simple posts reached thousands of people across continents, sparking conversations about salvation.
Your faith can make an impact too—right where you are.

🌟 Reflect: What Did 2024 Reveal About Your Faith? 🌟
❓ Were there times you felt close to God? Or were there moments when life’s busyness, struggles, or distractions pulled you away?

💬 Personal Story: A young man I met last year confessed that he spent most of 2024 chasing material success. He said, “I achieved my goals, but I felt empty. Something was missing.” His turning point came when he started each morning with prayer and Scripture. He said, “When I put Jesus first, everything else started to fall into place.”
✨ What about you? Is there something you need to let go of from 2024 to embrace God’s plans in 2025?

🔥 3 Resolutions for a Christ-Centered Year 🔥
1️⃣ Seek God First Every Day 🌅
In a world full of noise, starting your day with Jesus sets the tone for everything else. Even a few moments of prayer or Scripture can transform your mindset.
💬 Example: A teacher in Brazil started her mornings by reading one chapter of Psalms. She shared, “It gave me peace and reminded me to approach each day with love and patience.”
📖 “But seek first His kingdom and His righteousness, and all these things will be given to you as well.” (Matthew 6:33)
📝 Action Step: Begin tomorrow with a simple prayer: “Lord, guide my steps today. Let Your will, not mine, be done.”

2️⃣ Serve Others with Love 🌍
The world is hurting, and you are called to be the hands and feet of Jesus. Whether it’s helping a neighbor, supporting a local outreach, or sharing encouragement, your actions can reflect His love.

💬 Example: Last year, believers in the Philippines organized feeding programs for children affected by disasters. They didn’t just provide meals—they prayed with families and shared the hope of Christ.
📖 “We are God’s handiwork, created in Christ Jesus to do good works.” (Ephesians 2:10)
📝 Action Step: Look for one way to serve someone this week—it could be volunteering, helping a neighbor, or offering a kind word.

3️⃣ Trust God Completely 🙌
2025 will have its challenges, but remember: God is already there. Trusting Him means surrendering your fears and believing in His perfect plan.

title: 🔥 Presenting: PiX ULTIMATE ADOBO – The Next-Level Adobo with a Divine Twist! 🔥
paragraphs: 🔥 Presenting: PiX ULTIMATE ADOBO – The Next-Level Adobo with a Divine Twist! 🔥
✨ BBQ-Infused, Orange-Enhanced, Banana Blossom-Boosted, Peppermint-Kissed, and Faith-Filled Adobo! ✨
Mga higala, today I bring you my most powerful, most legendary, and most heavenly adobo version yet—🔥 PiX ULTIMATE ADOBO! 🔥
This isn’t just adobo. This is an experience. This is faith, love, and miracles simmered into one glorious dish! 😆

💡 What makes it ULTIMATE?
🔥 BBQ sauce – for that smoky, sweet, bold flavor.
🍊 Orange juice – for a citrusy balance.
🍌 Banana blossoms – for extra umami depth.
🌿 Peppermint leaves – for a surprising, refreshing twist.
🙏 Prayer & Faith – because every good dish starts with the blessings of the Lord!
📖 Biblical Reflection: Cooking = Faith
Adobo is like faith—it takes time, patience, and the right ingredients. Sometimes, life feels sour like vinegar, but with a little sweetness and heat, everything balances out.

✨ Romans 8:28 – “All things work together for good to those who love God.”
(Yes, even burnt onions and overcooked pork!) 🤣

✨ Proverbs 16:3 – “Commit to the Lord whatever you do, and He will establish your plans.”
(Including your adobo recipe!) 😆

✨ Psalm 34:8 – “Taste and see that the Lord is good.”
(Amen! And also, taste and see that my adobo is WOW!)
🔥 PiX ULTIMATE ADOBO Recipe (Serves 10) 🔥
🛑 INGREDIENTS (Prepare to be Blessed!)

🐖 5 lbs (2.2 kg) pork belly (or pork shoulder, cut into chunks)
🧄 12 cloves garlic, minced (para sa extra blessing!)
🧅 2 large onions, sliced (for depth of flavor)
🍊 ½ cup fresh orange juice (for a divine citrusy touch)
🍖 ½ cup barbecue sauce (adds smoky sweetness & bold flavor)
🫙 1 ½ cups soy sauce (for that umami punch)
🍶 ¾ cup white vinegar (or cane vinegar for the OG adobo tang)
💦 2 cups water (to balance flavors)
🍂 4 bay leaves (adds the legit adobo aroma)
🫑 2 tbsp whole black peppercorns (for that extra kick)
🍯 2 tbsp brown sugar (for a little caramelized goodness)
🧂 ½ tsp salt (adjust to taste)
🔥 3 tbsp cooking oil (for searing the pork)
🥔 3 large potatoes, peeled and cubed (optional, pero mas nindot!)
🥚 4 boiled eggs (optional, pero mas power!)
🍌 1 cup banana blossoms (for deep, natural sweetness)
🌿 ½ cup fresh peppermint leaves (for a unique refreshing twist)
🍚 5 cups cooked rice (para di ta gutom!)
🔥 INSTRUCTIONS: How to Make PiX ULTIMATE ADOBO! 🔥
1️⃣ Marinate Like a True Chef

🥢 In a large bowl, mix pork, barbecue sauce, soy sauce, garlic, black peppercorns, orange juice, and bay leaves.
🕐 Marinate for at least 1 hour (pero overnight is the secret to MAXIMUM FLAVOR!).
🙏 While waiting, pray for patience, kay lami jud ni unya!
2️⃣ Sear Like a Warrior Chef

🔥 Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
🍖 Sear the pork chunks until browned on all sides (this is where the magic begins!).
👉 Remove from the pot and set aside.
3️⃣ Sauté the Aromatics Like a Master

🧄 In the same pot, add onions and more garlic.
👃 Sauté until fragrant—if your neighbors start knocking, you're doing it right. 🤣
4️⃣ Simmer with Love & Patience

🥩 Return the seared pork to the pot.
🍶 Add the vinegar (DO NOT STIR for 3-5 minutes or risk offending the cooking gods!).
💦 Pour in water and any leftover marinade.
🧂 Add salt and brown sugar to balance the flavors.
🔥 Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer.
⏳ Cover and cook for 1 to 1.5 hours until the pork is fall-apart tender.
🙏 At this point, take a deep breath and say, “Lord, bless this masterpiece.”
5️⃣ Add Banana Blossoms, Potatoes & Thicken the Sauce

🍌 Add banana blossoms and let simmer for 10 minutes.
🥔 Toss in potatoes and simmer for 15 minutes until tender.
🍊 The orange juice caramelizes, making the sauce EXTRA RICH!
🥄 Let the sauce reduce to your preferred consistency.
6️⃣ Final Touches & Flavor Boosters

🥚 Add boiled eggs for extra protein and heavenly goodness!
🌿 Just before serving, toss in fresh peppermint leaves—this enhances the aroma and adds a refreshing surprise.
🥄 Taste-test and adjust seasoning (like a true chef).
7️⃣ Serve & Prepare for Compliments!
🍚 Serve hot with steamed rice—ready to bless your family’s taste buds!
🔥 Why PiX ULTIMATE ADOBO is the Best? 🔥

✅ BBQ sauce = smoky, sweet, and bold! 🍖🔥
✅ Orange juice = fresh, citrusy, and flavorful! 🍊
✅ Banana blossoms = extra umami, deep richness! 🍌
✅ Peppermint leaves = an unexpected but amazing surprise! 🌿
✅ Perfect balance of tangy, sweet, and savory flavors!
🎤 Final Thoughts & Encouragement

🔥 Life, like adobo, needs a little twist sometimes. Don’t be afraid to innovate, adjust, and take risks!
🔥 The best things take time to simmer—don’t rush God’s process in your life!
🔥 Cooking is worship too! When you cook with love, patience, and faith, every meal becomes a blessing.
🔥 And most importantly—FOOD IS LOVE. Share it, enjoy it, and let it bring people together!

Let’s inspire each other sa kitchen ug sa kinabuhi! 😆🙌

title: 🍲 Introducing: PiX Mekus Mekus Pork™ – My Own Sari-Sari with a Twist!
paragraphs: 🍲 Introducing: PiX Mekus Mekus Pork™ – My Own Sari-Sari with a Twist!

Mga higala, today I bring you another kitchen masterpiece—Mekus Mekus Pork™! 🤣
This is my own wild, delicious, and ultimate version of Sari-Sari (Filipino mixed vegetable stew), where I took whatever was available, threw it in the pot, and let faith do the rest.

🔥 Why is it called "Mekus Mekus Pork™"?
Because everything is “mekus mekus” (halo-halo, sagol-sagol, mixed-mixed)
✅ Walay sayop! Kung unsay naa sa ref, pwede na!
✅ No recipe rules! Basta lami, padayon lang!
✅ Pork + shrimp + gulay = Next-Level Comfort Food!

And when my family tasted it?
💛 "Pa, unsa ni? Murag Sari-Sari pero mas upgraded! Mekus Mekus kaayo, pero grabe ka lami!"
At that moment, I knew—I had created another kitchen miracle. 😎✨
📖 Biblical Reflection – Life is Like Mekus Mekus Pork!

🔥 Sometimes, life feels like a messy mix of ingredients—we don’t always understand why things happen.
🔥 But when we trust God, He takes all the unexpected moments and turns them into something beautiful and flavorful.

✨ Romans 8:28 – “And we know that in all things, God works for the good of those who love Him.”
(So even if imong ingredients murag random, TRUST THE PROCESS! 😂)

✨ Ecclesiastes 3:1 – “There is a time for everything, and a season for every activity under the heavens.”
(Kung naa kay squash ug shrimp karon, maybe that’s part of God’s plan for a new recipe! 🤣)
🔥 PiX Mekus Mekus Pork™ Recipe (Serves 6-8) 🔥
(A.K.A. Kung Unsay Naa, Luto Lang!™ 🤣)
🛑 INGREDIENTS (All the Mekus Mekus Goodness!)
For the Main Dish:

🐖 ½ lb pork belly (sliced)
🦐 ½ lb shrimp (peeled and deveined)
🍆 1 medium eggplant (sliced)
🎃 1 cup squash (cubed)
🟢 1 cup okra (sliced)
🌶️ 1 bell pepper (substituting string beans—trust me!)
🥬 1 cup bitter melon (optional, for the strong-hearted! 😆)
🍅 1 medium tomato (chopped)
🧅 1 small onion (chopped)
🧄 3 cloves garlic (minced)
For the Flavor Base:

💦 3 cups water or pork broth (para sabaw galore!)
🐟 2 tbsp fish sauce (patis) or salt to taste
🫙 ½ tsp ground black pepper
🔥 2 tbsp cooking oil
🔥 HOW TO COOK PiX Mekus Mekus Pork™ – The Ultimate Sari-Sari! 🔥
1️⃣ Prepare Ingredients – The More, The Merrier!

🥦 Wash and slice all vegetables.
🦐 Clean and devein shrimp.
🥩 Slice pork into bite-sized pieces.
🙏 Pray that this dish turns out AMAZING! 😂
2️⃣ Sauté the Aromatics – Unlock the Flavor!

🔥 Heat oil in a pan over medium heat.
🧄 Sauté garlic, onion, and tomato until soft and fragrant.
💨 If it smells amazing, YOU’RE DOING IT RIGHT!
3️⃣ Cook the Pork – Crispy + Flavorful!

🐖 Add pork belly and cook until browned and slightly crispy—about 5-7 minutes.
👉 This step locks in all the meaty goodness!
4️⃣ Add the Broth – The Magic Begins!

💦 Pour in water or pork broth and let it simmer for 5-10 minutes.
🔥 This is where all the flavors start to blend together!
5️⃣ Cook the Vegetables – Layering the Goodness!

🎃 Add squash first and let it soften for a few minutes.
🍆 Then, add eggplant, okra, and bitter melon (if using).
🔥 Stir occasionally and let the veggies absorb the pork flavor!
6️⃣ Season to Taste – The Final Touch!

🐟 Stir in fish sauce (or salt) and black pepper.
🥄 Adjust seasoning as needed—taste-test like a pro!
7️⃣ Add Bell Pepper & Shrimp – The Last Flavor Explosion!

🦐 Add shrimp and bell pepper, then cook for 3-5 minutes until shrimp turns pink and bell pepper is slightly tender.
🔥 At this point, your kitchen will smell HEAVENLY!
8️⃣ Serve & Enjoy! – Let the Mekus Mekus Begin!

🍚 Serve hot with steamed rice.
🔥 Watch your family fight over the last serving! 🤣
🔥 Why PiX Mekus Mekus Pork™ is a Must-Try? 🔥

✅ It’s customizable! (Basta naa kay pork, veggies, ug shrimp—laban lang!)
✅ Perfect balance of flavors—sweet, savory, and umami in one bite!
✅ Easy to cook! (Kahit beginner, kaya ni!)
✅ *Budget-friendly but tastes like restaurant food!
✅ Great for meal prep and reheats well!
🌿 Health Benefits of PiX Mekus Mekus Pork™:

✅ Boosts Immunity – The mix of veggies (especially bell pepper and squash) provides vitamins A & C!
✅ Heart-Healthy – Okra and eggplant help lower cholesterol!
✅ Good for Digestion – The fiber content in squash, okra, and bitter melon keeps your tummy happy!
✅ High in Protein – Pork and shrimp build muscles and keep you energized!
🔥 Final Thoughts: Life Lessons from Mekus Mekus Pork™! 🔥

🔥 Life is like this dish—you don’t always have everything you need, but you make the most out of what you have!
🔥 The best things in life (and cooking) are the ones we create without overthinking!
🔥 Even a mix-mix of ingredients can turn into something beautiful—just like how God takes all our experiences and makes them part of His perfect plan.
