title: 🔥 WHAT IS RELIGION? CAN IT SAVE YOU? 🚀🔥
paragraphs: 🔥 WHAT IS RELIGION? CAN IT SAVE YOU? 🚀🔥
📖 John 14:6 – "Jesus said to him, ‘I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.’"
Many people believe that being religious is enough to get to heaven—that as long as you belong to a church, follow rituals, or live a "good" life, you are saved. But is this true?
Does religion have the power to save you, or is there something far more important? Let’s dive into Scripture and expose the truth!

🔥 1. WHAT IS RELIGION?
The word "religion" comes from the Latin word "religare," meaning "to bind" or "to reconnect." It refers to systems of belief, worship, and rituals that people follow to connect with God.
There are thousands of religions in the world, but they all fall into one of two categories:

❌ Man-Made Religion – Systems of rules, traditions, and works that attempt to earn salvation.
✅ True Faith in Jesus Christ – A personal relationship with God through faith, not works.
🚨 Religion itself cannot save you—only JESUS can!

🔥 2. CAN RELIGION SAVE YOU? NO! ONLY JESUS CAN!
📖 Ephesians 2:8-9 – "For by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God, not of works, lest anyone should boast."
Salvation is a free gift from God! No religious rituals, traditions, or good deeds can earn it.

📖 Romans 3:20 – "By the works of the law, no flesh will be justified in His sight."
👉 Following religious laws and rituals cannot make you righteous before God.

📖 Acts 4:12 – "There is salvation in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven given among men by which we must be saved."
👉 No religion can save—ONLY JESUS!
🚨 If religion could save, Jesus wouldn’t have needed to die on the cross!

🔥 3. JESUS REJECTED RELIGIOUS HYPOCRISY!
Jesus did NOT come to start a religion—He came to bring salvation and restore a broken relationship with God!

📖 Matthew 23:27-28 – "Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like whitewashed tombs, which outwardly appear beautiful, but within are full of dead men’s bones and all uncleanness."
🔥 The Pharisees were very religious—but they were spiritually DEAD! They followed rules but did not truly know God.

📖 Matthew 7:21-23 – "Not everyone who says to Me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter the kingdom of heaven, but the one who does the will of My Father who is in heaven."
🔥 Many "religious" people will be SHOCKED on Judgment Day when Jesus says, "I NEVER KNEW YOU!"
🚨 Going to church, praying, or reading the Bible is GOOD—but if you don’t have a real relationship with Jesus, it’s all useless!

🔥 4. RELIGION VS. RELATIONSHIP WITH JESUS – WHAT’S THE DIFFERENCE?
❌ Religion tries to earn salvation by works.
✅ A relationship with Jesus receives salvation by grace through faith.

❌ Religion focuses on rules & rituals.
✅ A relationship with Jesus focuses on knowing Him personally.

❌ Religion is based on fear of punishment.
✅ A relationship with Jesus is based on love for God.

❌ Religion tries to "be good enough" for heaven.
✅ A relationship with Jesus trusts in His finished work on the cross.
🚨 RELIGION says "DO" but JESUS says "DONE!" Salvation is already paid for by His blood!

🔥 5. HOW TO BE SAVED – IT’S NOT ABOUT RELIGION!
✅ Salvation is NOT about a religion—it’s about surrendering to Jesus!
📖 Romans 10:9 – "If you confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God raised Him from the dead, you will be saved."
Here’s how to have TRUE salvation:

✔️ Admit you are a sinner (Romans 3:23).
✔️ Believe in Jesus as your only Savior (John 3:16).
✔️ Confess and repent of your sins (Acts 3:19).
✔️ Receive Him into your life as Lord (John 1:12).
🚨 No church, no priest, no good works, and no religious tradition can save you—ONLY JESUS!

🔥 FINAL CONCLUSION: RELIGION WON’T SAVE YOU—ONLY JESUS CAN!
✅ Religion can’t save you—only a true relationship with Jesus will!
✅ Salvation is a free gift from God—it is NOT earned through works or rituals.
✅ Jesus rejected religious hypocrisy and called for true faith.
✅ If you trust in religion instead of Christ, you are in DANGER of being rejected by Him on Judgment Day!
🚨 RELIGION WITHOUT JESUS IS DEAD! REPENT AND FOLLOW CHRIST TODAY!
🚀 FAITH DECLARATION: I CHOOSE JESUS OVER RELIGION!

✅ 👍 CLICK LIKE if this teaching blessed you!
✅ ❤️ CLICK HEART if you have a real relationship with Jesus!
📢 🚨 WARNING: Many people are deceived into thinking that religion alone is enough to save them. SHARE THIS NOW to bring biblical truth!

🙏 PRAYER FOR TODAY
Heavenly Father, I come before You, knowing that religion cannot save me—only Jesus can! I surrender my life to You and ask for a true relationship with You. Remove every false belief, hypocrisy, and religious mindset that keeps me from truly knowing You. Fill me with Your Holy Spirit and lead me in truth. In Jesus’ name, AMEN! 🙏🔥

title: 🔥 RELIGION WON’T SAVE YOU—ONLY JESUS CAN! 🚨🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 RELIGION WON’T SAVE YOU—ONLY JESUS CAN! 🚨🔥
📖 Acts 4:12 – "There is no other name under heaven given to mankind by which we must be saved."

🔥 THE BIBLE SAYS: "You must be born again!" (John 3:3)

📖 Ephesians 2:8-9 – "For it is by grace you have been saved, through faith—and this is not from yourselves, it is the gift of God—not by works, so that no one can boast."

🔥 WHAT RELIGION TEACHES:
❌ "Do good works, and maybe God will accept you!"
❌ "Follow the rules, and you’ll be saved!"
❌ "Belong to the right church, and you’re guaranteed heaven!"
🚨 BUT THE BIBLE TEACHES THAT SALVATION IS THROUGH JESUS ALONE!

A man went to church every Sunday, followed religious traditions, and thought he was saved. But he never had a personal relationship with Jesus. When asked if he knew Christ personally, he said, "I’ve always been Catholic/Baptist/Methodist/etc." He trusted his religion, but NOT Jesus!

👉 DO YOU KNOW JESUS PERSONALLY, OR JUST KNOW ABOUT HIM THROUGH RELIGION?

📖 Isaiah 64:6 – "All our righteous acts are like filthy rags."

🔥 RELIGION SAYS: "Do enough good works, and you’ll make it to heaven!"
🔥 THE BIBLE SAYS: "No one is righteous—not even one!" (Romans 3:10)

A woman spent her life doing charity work, donating money, and helping the poor. But she never surrendered her life to Christ. When she died, she thought her good deeds would be enough. But Jesus said:
📖 Matthew 7:22-23 – "Many will say to Me on that day, ‘Lord, Lord, did we not prophesy in Your name and perform many miracles?’ Then I will tell them plainly, ‘I never knew you. Depart from Me!’"
👉 ARE YOU TRUSTING IN YOUR GOOD WORKS, OR HAVE YOU GIVEN YOUR LIFE TO JESUS?

🔥 3. CHURCH MEMBERSHIP CAN’T SAVE YOU!
📖 Romans 10:9 – "If you confess with your mouth, ‘Jesus is Lord,’ and believe in your heart that God raised Him from the dead, you will be saved."

🔥 RELIGION SAYS: "As long as you’re part of our church, you’re saved!"
🔥 THE BIBLE SAYS: "Unless you are born again, you cannot enter the Kingdom of God!" (John 3:3)

📖 Matthew 15:8 – "These people honor Me with their lips, but their hearts are far from Me."
👉 DO YOU JUST ATTEND CHURCH, OR HAVE YOU SURRENDERED YOUR LIFE TO JESUS?

🔥 4. JESUS CAME TO RESTORE RELATIONSHIP—NOT START A RELIGION!
📖 John 10:10 – "I have come that they may have life, and have it to the full."

🔥 WHY JESUS CAME:
✅ To restore our broken relationship with God (2 Corinthians 5:18-19)
✅ To save us from sin and death (Romans 6:23)
✅ To bring us into the family of God—not into a religious system (John 1:12)
🚨 RELIGION IS ABOUT RULES—JESUS IS ABOUT RELATIONSHIP!

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
Many Pharisees in Jesus' time were deeply religious. They prayed, fasted, and followed the law. But Jesus rebuked them because they had no real love for God.
📖 Matthew 23:27 – "You are like whitewashed tombs—beautiful on the outside but full of dead men’s bones on the inside."
👉 IS YOUR FAITH ABOUT RULES, OR A REAL RELATIONSHIP WITH JESUS?

🔥 5. HOW TO BE SAVED—THE BIBLICAL WAY!
📖 Romans 3:23 – "For all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God."

🔥 WHAT YOU MUST DO:
✅ ADMIT YOU ARE A SINNER (Romans 3:23, 6:23)
✅ BELIEVE JESUS DIED FOR YOUR SINS (Romans 5:8)
✅ CONFESS JESUS AS LORD AND REPENT (Romans 10:9-10, Acts 3:19)
✅ FOLLOW HIM DAILY AND LIVE IN OBEDIENCE (Luke 9:23, John 14:15)
🚨 JESUS WANTS YOUR HEART—NOT YOUR RELIGIOUS ACTS!
📖 2 Corinthians 5:17 – "If anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation; the old has gone, the new is here!"
🔥 MAKE SURE YOU’RE SAVED THE BIBLICAL WAY—NOT THE RELIGIOUS WAY!

🙏 POWERFUL PRAYER FOR TRUE SALVATION!
"Lord Jesus, I realize that religion cannot save me—only You can. I confess that I am a sinner, and I repent of my sins. I believe that You died for me and rose again. Today, I surrender my life to You. I don’t want just religion—I want a real relationship with You! Be my Lord and Savior. In Jesus' name, AMEN!" 🙏🔥

title: "The Devil Doesn’t Always Come With a Pitchfork – He Comes Disguised as Truth" 🔥
paragraphs:
"The Devil Doesn’t Always Come With a Pitchfork – He Comes Disguised as Truth" 🔥
✝️ A Message from Brother John Domino "PiX" S. Asis – Follower of Jesus Christ and a Servant of God
🌍 Satan is not stupid. He knows that if he came to you looking like a red demon with horns and a pitchfork, you would immediately resist him.
🚨 Instead, he disguises himself as an angel of light.
📖 “And no wonder, for Satan himself masquerades as an angel of light.” (2 Corinthians 11:14)
💡 He works through deception, false teachings, and things that seem "good" but are actually leading people to destruction.
🙅‍♂️ Satan doesn’t just try to destroy the church from the outside—he infiltrates it from within.

🔥 1. Satan’s Greatest Weapon: Deception
📖 “The great dragon was hurled down—that ancient serpent called the devil, or Satan, who leads the whole world astray.” (Revelation 12:9)
🚨 Satan’s goal is not to make you worship him—his goal is to make you believe a lie.

He doesn’t need you to bow down to him. All he needs is for you to:
❌ Follow a false version of Jesus.
❌ Believe a twisted version of the Gospel.
❌ Trust emotions over the Word of God.
💡 Once he gets you to believe the wrong thing, you’re already in his trap.

🔥 2. The 5 Biggest Ways Satan Disguises Himself as "Truth"
1️⃣ False Teachings That Sound "Nice" But Are Spiritually Deadly
Satan’s lies often sound loving and harmless—but they are poison.
Many false preachers say things that feel good but contradict the Bible.
📖 “For the time will come when people will not put up with sound doctrine. Instead, to suit their own desires, they will gather around them a great number of teachers to say what their itching ears want to hear.” (2 Timothy 4:3)
🚨 Truth: A message that makes you feel good but doesn’t align with the Bible is a lie.

2️⃣ "All Religions Lead to God"
The world says, “It doesn’t matter what you believe as long as you’re a good person.”
But Jesus was very clear—there is only ONE way to God.
📖 “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.” (John 14:6)
🚨 Truth: If Jesus is the only way, then every other way is a lie.

3️⃣ Miracles and Supernatural Signs That Lead People Away From God
Many assume if something is supernatural, it must be from God.
But Satan can also perform miracles to deceive people.
📖 “For false messiahs and false prophets will appear and perform great signs and wonders to deceive, if possible, even the elect.” (Matthew 24:24)
🚨 Truth: Not every miracle is from God—test everything with Scripture.

4️⃣ Twisting the Bible to Justify Sin
Satan used Scripture to tempt Jesus in the wilderness—he knows the Bible too!
Many today misuse the Bible to justify sin and rebellion.
📖 “Even Satan disguises himself as an angel of light.” (2 Corinthians 11:14)
🚨 Truth: Just because someone uses the Bible doesn’t mean they’re preaching truth—test their message.

The world preaches “love is love”—but true love corrects and saves people from destruction.
Many churches preach love while ignoring holiness and repentance.
📖 “Faithful are the wounds of a friend, but deceitful are the kisses of an enemy.” (Proverbs 27:6)

📖 “But when He, the Spirit of truth, comes, He will guide you into all truth.” (John 16:13)
🚨 Just because something is trending doesn’t mean it’s from God.

title: 🔥 "Why Are Christians Divided? Our Loyalty Belongs to Christ, Not Religion" 🔥
paragraphs: 🔥 "Why Are Christians Divided? Our Loyalty Belongs to Christ, Not Religion" 🔥
🌍 It’s time for a wake-up call. Why do so many Christians argue over denominations, doctrines, and church structures when our ultimate loyalty should be to Jesus Christ alone?

Have we forgotten the words of Jesus?
📖 “A new command I give you: Love one another. As I have loved you, so you must love one another.” (John 13:34)
Jesus never called us to loyalty toward a religion, a man-made establishment, or even a charismatic leader. He called us to follow Him—the Savior, the Truth, and the Life. ✝️

🌟 Why Are Christians Divided? 🌟
It’s heartbreaking to see the body of Christ arguing, criticizing, and dividing over differences that were never meant to separate us.

Here’s why divisions often happen:
➡️ Loyalty to Traditions Over Truth: Some believers become more committed to traditions than to Christ’s teachings.
➡️ Man-Centered Leadership: When leaders are idolized, their words are often elevated above Scripture itself.
➡️ Religious Pride: Many focus on proving their belief system is superior rather than living out Christ’s love.
➡️ Doctrinal Disputes: While truth matters, Jesus never intended theological differences to become barriers between His followers.

🔥 The Truth About Loyalty in Christianity 🔥
💡 Our loyalty must always be to Jesus Christ, not to human systems.
📖 “You shall have no other gods before Me.” (Exodus 20:3)
💬 Example: Paul addressed this very issue in the early church. Some claimed to follow Paul, others Apollos, and others Peter. But Paul rebuked them, saying:
"Is Christ divided? Was Paul crucified for you? Were you baptized in the name of Paul?" (1 Corinthians 1:13)
✅ Paul’s point? We are baptized into Christ, not into denominations, pastors, or ministries.

🌍 Who Should We Be Loyal To? Only Jesus. 🌍
👉 Not a Denomination
👉 Not a Famous Preacher
👉 Not a Building or Church Name
📖 “For no one can lay any foundation other than the one already laid, which is Jesus Christ.” (1 Corinthians 3:11)
➡️ Our loyalty belongs to the One who died for us—Jesus Christ.

🔥 What Happens When We Misplace Our Loyalty? 🔥
Divisions and Conflict:

Churches split.
Christians attack one another instead of standing together.
Spiritual Blindness:

People defend human traditions over biblical truth.
False teachers rise when personal charisma is prioritized over Scripture.
We Lose Focus on the Great Commission:

Instead of preaching Christ, people debate doctrines and personalities.
💡 Jesus warned us against this. He said:
📖 “By this everyone will know that you are My disciples, if you love one another.” (John 13:35)

🔥 How Can We Return Our Loyalty to Christ Alone? 🔥
1️⃣ Fix Your Eyes on Jesus, Not People 🙌
💡 No pastor, No priest, teacher, or leader is perfect. But Jesus is.
📖 “Let us fix our eyes on Jesus, the author and perfecter of our faith.” (Hebrews 12:2)

2️⃣ Test Everything Against Scripture 📖
💡 If a teaching contradicts the Bible, it must be rejected—even if it comes from a respected figure.
📖 “All Scripture is God-breathed and useful for teaching, rebuking, correcting and training in righteousness.” (2 Timothy 3:16)

3️⃣ Unite in the Core Message of the Gospel ✝️
💡 The essentials of faith unite us:

Jesus is the Son of God.
He died and rose again for our sins.
Salvation is by grace through faith.
📖 “There is one body and one Spirit... one Lord, one faith, one baptism.” (Ephesians 4:4-6)

4️⃣ Stop Defending Religion—Start Living the Gospel ❤️
💡 Jesus didn’t come to start a religion—He came to restore a relationship with God.
📖 “God is spirit, and His worshipers must worship in the Spirit and in truth.” (John 4:24)

📜 Faith Declaration for January 4 📜
“I will place my loyalty in Jesus Christ alone. I will not allow divisions, traditions, or human influence to distract me from the truth of the gospel. My faith is in Christ—my Savior, my Redeemer, and my Lord.”

🔥 The "Christ Alone Challenge" 🔥
1️⃣ Identify any area where you may have placed loyalty in a person or system above Christ.
2️⃣ Pray for unity within the global body of believers.
3️⃣ Share the message of unity and love with fellow believers today.
Let’s return to Jesus together.

🌌 "Christ Alone Is Enough" 🌌
📖 “He is before all things, and in Him all things hold together.” (Colossians 1:17)
Our faith was never meant to be built on a system. It was always meant to be built on a Savior.
Let’s break free from man-made divisions and stand united under the name of Jesus Christ.

🙏 A Prayer for Unity and Loyalty to Christ 🙏
Heavenly Father,
Forgive us when we allow divisions, personal pride, and human influence to distract us from Your truth. Help us return to the simplicity of the gospel—faith in Jesus alone. Break down walls of division within the body of Christ and unite us as Your children. May we reflect Your love and truth to a broken world.
In Jesus’ name, Amen. ✝️
✨ Let’s break down walls and return to Christ! 🌍❤️✨
#LoyalToChrist #Jesusaboveall #faithnotreligion #christcenteredfaith #NoMoreDivisions #onebodyonechrist #Christisthefoundation #UnitedInJesus

title: 🔥 "FAITH WITHOUT WORKS IS DEAD" – DOES THIS MEAN WE ARE SAVED BY WORKS? (JAMES 2:26) 🚀🔥
paragraphs: 🔥 "FAITH WITHOUT WORKS IS DEAD" – DOES THIS MEAN WE ARE SAVED BY WORKS? (JAMES 2:26) 🚀🔥
📖 James 2:26 – "For as the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without works is dead also."

Many people misinterpret this verse and believe that salvation requires good works in order to be valid. But is this what the Bible really teaches? Are we saved by works, or is there a deeper meaning to James 2:26? Let’s examine the original Greek, biblical context, and supporting Scripture to find the truth!

🔥 1. WHAT DOES JAMES 2:26 REALLY MEAN?
The key phrase in this verse is "faith without works is dead." What does this mean? To answer, we must first examine the original Greek word for "dead."
📖 Greek: νεκρὰ (nekra) – "lifeless, useless, inactive."
👉 James is NOT saying that works are required for salvation. He is saying that if your faith doesn’t produce good works, it is lifeless, inactive, and useless!
🚨 Faith alone saves, but true faith will always produce good works as evidence.

🔥 2. ARE WE SAVED BY FAITH OR WORKS?
The Bible is clear that salvation is by faith alone in Christ alone—NOT by works!

📖 Ephesians 2:8-9 – "For by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God, not of works, lest anyone should boast."
👉 Salvation is a free gift from God—it cannot be earned!

📖 Romans 3:28 – "For we maintain that a person is justified by faith apart from the works of the law."
👉 Faith justifies us before God, not our works.

📖 Titus 3:5 – "He saved us, not because of works done by us in righteousness, but according to His mercy."
👉 Works do not play a role in saving us—God’s mercy does!
🚨 If we were saved by works, then Jesus’ sacrifice on the cross would be unnecessary. But the Bible teaches that Jesus’ death alone paid for our sins!

🔥 3. WHY DOES JAMES SAY FAITH WITHOUT WORKS IS DEAD?
If we are saved by faith alone, then why does James emphasize works? The answer: James is talking about the EVIDENCE of true faith!

📖 James 2:18 – "Show me your faith without your works, and I will show you my faith by my works."
👉 James is not saying that works save you. He is saying that works prove you are saved!
🔥 EXAMPLE: A tree is alive not because it has fruit, but its fruit proves it is alive. In the same way, good works prove that a person’s faith is real.
🚨 If someone claims to have faith in Jesus but has no change in their life, their "faith" is dead and useless!

🔥 4. PAUL VS. JAMES? NO CONTRADICTION!
Some argue that Paul (who said salvation is by faith alone) and James (who says faith without works is dead) contradict each other. But they don’t!

⚔️ Paul speaks about how we are justified before GOD (by faith alone).
⚔️ James speaks about how we are justified before PEOPLE (by our works as proof of faith).
📖 Example: Abraham was justified by faith (Romans 4:3), but his faith was PROVEN when he offered Isaac (James 2:21).
🚨 Faith is the root. Works are the fruit. You don’t need fruit to be a tree, but a living tree WILL produce fruit!

🔥 5. WHAT KIND OF WORKS PROVE REAL FAITH?
The Bible shows that true faith produces action. Here are some examples of "living" faith:

✅ Repentance from sin (Luke 13:3)
✅ Loving and helping others (1 John 3:17-18)
✅ Sharing the gospel boldly (Mark 16:15)
✅ Obedience to God’s commands (John 14:15)
✅ Forgiving others (Matthew 6:14-15)
🚨 If someone claims to have faith but lives in constant sin with no repentance, their "faith" is dead and false.

🔥 FINAL CONCLUSION: ARE WE SAVED BY WORKS?
✅ NO! We are saved by grace through faith alone (Ephesians 2:8-9).
✅ BUT true saving faith will always produce good works as evidence!
✅ If someone claims to have faith but their life doesn’t reflect it, their "faith" is dead and useless (James 2:26).
🚨 False teachers who claim that "works are necessary for salvation" are preaching a FALSE GOSPEL! The truth is: Good works are the RESULT of salvation, NOT the cause of it!

✅ ❤️ CLICK HEART if you know faith must be alive and active!

title: "Why Right Beliefs About God Matter" 🔥
paragraphs:
"Why Right Beliefs About God Matter" 🔥
✝️ A Message from Brother John Domino "PiX" S. Asis – Follower of Jesus Christ and a Servant of God
🌍 What you believe about God shapes your entire life.
👉 But what if your beliefs are not aligned with biblical truth?
Many people say they believe in God, yet their understanding is often based on:

Cultural beliefs passed down through generations.
Religious traditions that sound right but lack biblical support.
Personal feelings instead of the authority of God’s Word.
📖 “My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge.” (Hosea 4:6)
💡 Truth matters because eternity is at stake. Let’s break this down together.

🔥 1. The Truth About God Must Come From Scripture, Not Feelings
What you believe about God must come from His Word alone.

✅ Wrong Belief: “I feel like God would never judge anyone.”
✅ Biblical Truth: God is both loving and just.
📖 “It is appointed for men to die once, and after that comes judgment.” (Hebrews 9:27)

✅ Wrong Belief: “All religions point to the same God.”
✅ Biblical Truth: Jesus Christ is the only way to salvation.
📖 “Jesus said, ‘I am the Way, the Truth, and the Life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.’” (John 14:6)

✅ Wrong Belief: “If I live a good life, God will accept me.”
✅ Biblical Truth: Salvation is by grace alone, through faith alone.
📖 “For it is by grace you have been saved, through faith... not by works, so that no one can boast.” (Ephesians 2:8-9)

🔥 2. Why Right Beliefs Are Essential for Salvation
Believing in the wrong version of God can have eternal consequences.
📖 “For there is one God and one mediator between God and mankind, the man Christ Jesus.” (1 Timothy 2:5)
✅ Believing the True Gospel Means:

Understanding who Jesus is: Fully God, fully man (John 1:1, Colossians 2:9).
Knowing why He died: To pay for the penalty of sin (Romans 5:8).
Trusting in His finished work alone for salvation (1 Corinthians 15:3-4).

🔥 3. Misconceptions About God That Need to Be Debunked
These common lies are leading people away from the truth:

❌ Myth #1: "God is Love, So He Won't Judge Anyone"
✅ Truth: God is both love and just. He must deal with sin.
📖 “Whoever believes in Him is not condemned, but whoever does not believe stands condemned already.” (John 3:18)

❌ Myth #2: "I Believe in God, So I'm Automatically Saved"
✅ Truth: Belief in God's existence alone doesn't save. Even demons believe.
📖 “You believe there is one God. Good! Even the demons believe—and shudder.” (James 2:19)
Salvation comes only through faith in Jesus Christ.

❌ Myth #3: "The Bible Is Just a Collection of Stories"
✅ Truth: The Bible is the Word of God, inspired and infallible.
📖 “All Scripture is God-breathed and useful for teaching, rebuking, correcting, and training in righteousness.” (2 Timothy 3:16)

🔥 4. Why Right Beliefs Produce Right Living
What you believe about God affects how you live.

✅ Right Belief: Jesus is my Savior → Leads to faithfulness and gratitude.
✅ Right Belief: God is holy → Leads to repentance and a desire for purity.
✅ Right Belief: Salvation is by grace → Leads to humility, not pride.
📖 “Be transformed by the renewing of your mind.” (Romans 12:2)

🔥 5. How to Align Your Beliefs with Biblical Truth
Are you ready to let go of half-truths and follow Jesus fully?
✅ Step 1: Examine Your Beliefs.

Do they align with God’s Word, or personal feelings?
✅ Step 2: Go Back to the Bible.

Make Scripture the final authority in your life.
✅ Step 3: Test Every Teaching.
📖 “Test all things; hold fast to what is good.” (1 Thessalonians 5:21)
✅ Step 4: Trust in Christ Alone.
Salvation is not about how you feel—it’s about trusting His finished work.

📜 FAITH DECLARATION FOR JANUARY 13, 2025 📜
"I reject cultural lies and choose to believe in the God of the Bible. I trust in Jesus Christ alone as my Lord and Savior, and I commit to aligning my life with the truth of His Word."

🔥 THE “TRUTH MATTERS” CHALLENGE 🔥
✅ Step 1: Examine your beliefs in light of Scripture.
✅ Step 2: Share a Bible verse today that reveals God’s truth.
✅ Step 3: Tag 3 friends who need to hear this.

🌌 DON’T SETTLE FOR HALF-TRUTHS – CHOOSE BIBLICAL TRUTH 🌌
📖 “You will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.” (John 8:32)

💡 Your beliefs matter.
Make sure they are grounded in God’s Word—not popular opinions.

🙏 PRAYER FOR JANUARY 13, 2025 🙏
Heavenly Father,
I come before You today, seeking truth in Your Word alone. Protect me from deception and help me to build my faith on the solid foundation of Scripture. I trust fully in Jesus Christ, His finished work on the cross, and His resurrection. Transform my mind and help me live according to Your truth.
In Jesus’ name, Amen. ✝️

title: 🔥 "WORKS CANNOT SAVE YOU – ONLY JESUS CAN!" 🚀🔥
paragraphs: 🔥 "WORKS CANNOT SAVE YOU – ONLY JESUS CAN!" 🚀🔥
📖 Ephesians 2:8-9 – "For by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God, not of works, lest anyone should boast."

Many people believe that being a good person or doing good deeds is enough to earn their way to heaven. They think that if they pray, give to charity, help others, and avoid major sins, they will be saved. But is that what the Bible teaches?
Can good works save you? Or is there only one way to eternal life? Let’s go deep into Scripture and uncover the truth!

🔥 1. SALVATION IS A FREE GIFT – YOU CANNOT EARN IT!
📖 Romans 6:23 – "For the wages of sin is death, but the gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord."
✅ Salvation is a FREE gift from God! If you could earn it, it wouldn’t be a gift—it would be a payment for your works. But the Bible clearly says we are saved by grace, not by works!
📖 Titus 3:5 – "He saved us, not because of works done by us in righteousness, but according to His mercy."
🚨 No amount of good deeds can wash away sin! Only the blood of Jesus can save us.

🔥 2. IF WORKS COULD SAVE, THEN JESUS DIED FOR NOTHING!
📖 Galatians 2:21 – "If righteousness could be gained through the law, Christ died for nothing!"
✅ If being good or following the law could save you, then why did Jesus have to die? His sacrifice would have been unnecessary!
📖 Isaiah 64:6 – "All our righteous deeds are like filthy rags."
🚨 Even our best works are not good enough for heaven! That’s why we need Jesus.

🔥 3. RELIGION AND GOOD WORKS WITHOUT JESUS LEAD TO HELL
📖 Matthew 7:22-23 – "Many will say to Me on that day, ‘Lord, Lord, did we not prophesy in Your name, and cast out demons, and do many mighty works?’ And then I will declare to them, ‘I never knew you; depart from Me, you workers of lawlessness.’"
🚨 These people did good works—they prophesied, did miracles, and even cast out demons! But Jesus still rejected them because they never truly knew Him.
📖 John 14:6 – "Jesus said to him, ‘I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.’"
✅ Good works WITHOUT JESUS mean nothing! Salvation comes ONLY through Christ.

🔥 4. WORKS ARE THE RESULT OF SALVATION, NOT THE CAUSE
📖 James 2:26 – "For as the body without the spirit is dead, so faith without works is dead also."
🚨 Many people misunderstand this verse. James is NOT saying that works save you—he is saying that true faith produces good works as evidence.
✅ Example: A tree is alive not because it has fruit, but its fruit proves it is alive. In the same way, good works prove that a person’s faith is real.
📖 Ephesians 2:10 – "For we are His workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared beforehand that we should walk in them."
✅ Good works are the RESULT of salvation, NOT the cause!

🔥 5. HOW TO BE SAVED – ONLY JESUS CAN SAVE YOU!
📖 Romans 10:9 – "If you confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God raised Him from the dead, you will be saved."

✅ Steps to True Salvation:
✔️ Admit you are a sinner (Romans 3:23).
✔️ Believe in Jesus as your only Savior (John 3:16).
✔️ Confess and repent of your sins (Acts 3:19).
✔️ Receive Him into your life as Lord (John 1:12).
🚨 No amount of good deeds, church attendance, or charity work can save you—ONLY JESUS CAN!

🔥 FINAL CONCLUSION: YOU CANNOT WORK YOUR WAY INTO HEAVEN!
✅ You are saved by grace through faith in Jesus Christ alone!
✅ Good works cannot wash away your sins—only the blood of Jesus can!
✅ If you trust in your good deeds instead of Christ, you are in DANGER of being rejected by Him on Judgment Day!
🚨 STOP TRUSTING IN WORKS AND START TRUSTING IN JESUS!

✅ ❤️ CLICK HEART if you trust in Jesus ALONE for salvation!
✅ 🚀 CLICK SHARE to help others escape the false belief that works can save them!
📢 🚨 WARNING: Many people are deceived into thinking they can "earn" their way to heaven. SHARE THIS NOW to bring biblical truth!

🙏 PRAYER FOR TODAY
Heavenly Father, I come before You, knowing that my good works cannot save me—only Jesus can! I place my full trust in Your grace and the finished work of Christ on the cross. Help me to live out my faith with obedience, love, and action, not to earn salvation but as a response to Your amazing grace. In Jesus’ name, AMEN! 🙏🔥

title: 🔥 "January 2: Every Day Is a Fresh Start with Christ" 🔥
paragraphs: 🔥 "January 2: Every Day Is a Fresh Start with Christ" 🔥

🌄 It’s January 2, 2025. A new day is here, and with it comes a fresh opportunity to walk in God’s grace, love, and purpose. The excitement of the first day of the year may have faded, but here’s the good news: God’s mercies are new every morning.
📖 “Because of the Lord’s great love we are not consumed, for His compassions never fail. They are new every morning; great is Your faithfulness.” (Lamentations 3:22-23)
Today is a gift. How will you use it? Will you embrace God’s purpose, reflect His love, and trust His plan?

🌟 Reflect: What Did January 1 Teach You? 🌟
Yesterday might have been filled with joy, challenges, or even distractions, but today is another chance to walk with Jesus.

💬 Example: A friend of mine shared how she started January 1 with big plans but ended the day feeling overwhelmed by all the goals she had set. Instead of dwelling on her frustration, she chose to pray: “Lord, help me to focus on what truly matters—walking with You.” That simple prayer gave her peace and clarity for today.
👉 What about you? Did anything from yesterday reveal something God wants you to surrender or prioritize today?

🔥 3 Simple Steps to Start Today with Purpose 🔥
1️⃣ Begin with Prayer and Surrender 🙏
Starting your day with Jesus is like setting a compass for your soul. When you align your heart with God’s will, everything else finds its proper place.

💬 Example: A young man in Indonesia begins each day by praying: “Lord, show me how I can serve You today.” He shared how this daily habit has opened unexpected opportunities to share his faith with coworkers.
📖 “In the morning, Lord, You hear my voice; in the morning I lay my requests before You and wait expectantly.” (Psalm 5:3)
📝 Action Step: Take five minutes right now to pray: “Lord, I surrender today to You. Let Your will guide my steps.”

2️⃣ Focus on Gratitude and Growth 🌱
Every day brings blessings—some big, some small. When we cultivate a grateful heart, we position ourselves to grow spiritually and emotionally.

💬 Example: A woman in South Africa started keeping a gratitude journal last year, writing down three things she was thankful for each evening. She said, “Even on tough days, I could see God’s hand in my life.”
📖 “Give thanks in all circumstances; for this is God’s will for you in Christ Jesus.” (1 Thessalonians 5:18)
📝 Action Step: Write down three things you’re thankful for today. Let gratitude shape your perspective.

3️⃣ Look for Opportunities to Reflect Christ’s Love ❤️
Every person you encounter today is someone God loves deeply. Be intentional about showing kindness, encouragement, and compassion.

💬 Example: A man in Canada decided to offer a word of encouragement to someone every day. Yesterday, he complimented a barista at his local coffee shop and left a Bible verse on his receipt. The barista later thanked him, saying it made her day.
📖 “A new command I give you: Love one another. As I have loved you, so you must love one another.” (John 13:34)
📝 Action Step: Choose one person to encourage or serve today—whether it’s a kind word, a prayer, or a simple act of service.

🌍 "Today Is a Mission Field" 🌍
God has placed you where you are for a reason. Your workplace, school, home, or community is your mission field. Every interaction is an opportunity to shine His light.
➡️ What if you viewed today as a chance to make an eternal impact? Small acts of love and faith can ripple far beyond what you see.

📜 Daily Faith Declaration 📜
“I will embrace today as a gift from God. I will seek Him first, live with gratitude, and reflect His love to everyone I meet.”

🔥 The "Live Today Well Challenge" 🔥
1️⃣ Start your day with a prayer of surrender.
2️⃣ Write down three things you’re grateful for today.
3️⃣ Encourage or serve one person before the day ends.

🌌 "God’s Mercies Are New Every Morning" 🌌
📖 “Forgetting what is behind and straining toward what is ahead, I press on toward the goal to win the prize for which God has called me heavenward in Christ Jesus.” (Philippians 3:13-14)
Each day is a fresh opportunity to grow in faith, love others, and walk in God’s purpose. Let’s make today count!

🙏 A Prayer for January 2, 2025 🙏
Heavenly Father,
Thank You for the gift of today. Help us to start this day by seeking You first, embracing Your mercies, and trusting in Your plan. Teach us to live with gratitude and purpose, and let us reflect Your love to everyone we meet. May this day bring glory to Your name.
In Jesus’ name, Amen. ✝️
✨ Let’s inspire the world to embrace every day as a fresh start in Christ! 🌍❤️✨

title: "Not Everything That Looks Christian Is Biblical" 🔥
paragraphs:
"Not Everything That Looks Christian Is Biblical" 🔥
✝️ A Message from Brother John Domino "PiX" S. Asis – Follower of Jesus Christ and a Servant of God
🌍 In a world full of spiritual messages, not everything labeled 'Christian' is biblically true.

It’s easy to be deceived.
✅ That viral faith meme you just shared…
✅ That motivational quote with a Bible verse…
✅ That trending Christian trend on social media…
They may sound good, but are they aligned with Scripture?
📖 “See to it that no one takes you captive through hollow and deceptive philosophy, which depends on human tradition rather than Christ.” (Colossians 2:8)
Let’s break down why this matters.

🔥 The Danger of Feel-Good Memes & Half-Truths
Social media is flooded with "Christian" quotes and inspirational posts that can mislead people.

Here’s the problem:
❌ Half-Truths: Sharing God's love but ignoring sin and the need for repentance.
❌ Twisted Scriptures: Taking verses out of context to fit motivational ideas.
📖 “For the time will come when people will not put up with sound doctrine. Instead, they will gather around them teachers to say what their itching ears want to hear.” (2 Timothy 4:3)
💡 Truth is not measured by popularity—it’s measured by the Word of God.

⚠️ 3 Myths That Sound Christian but Aren't Biblically True:
1️⃣ "God Helps Those Who Help Themselves" (FALSE)
✅ Myth: You have to fix yourself before God helps you.
✅ Truth: God helps the helpless who call upon Him.
📖 “But God demonstrates His own love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.” (Romans 5:8)
God meets us in our brokenness. We don’t clean ourselves up—we come to Him as we are.

2️⃣ "All Paths Lead to God – Just Believe in Something" (FALSE)
✅ Myth: Every religion eventually leads to the same God.
✅ Truth: Jesus is the ONLY way to the Father.
📖 “Jesus said, ‘I am the Way, the Truth, and the Life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.’” (John 14:6)
💡 Not all beliefs are equal. Only faith in Christ alone saves.

✅ Myth: Viral posts with promises of instant blessings for likes and shares.
✅ Truth: God’s blessings are not triggered by social media activity but by His grace.
📖 “Seek first His kingdom and His righteousness, and all these things will be given to you as well.” (Matthew 6:33)
💡 Faith isn't a formula. God works according to His will, not based on a viral post.

🔥 What Makes Something Truly Biblical?
Here’s how to discern if a message aligns with God’s Word:
✅ 1. Is it rooted in Scripture?

Check if the verse used is quoted in context.
Example: Jeremiah 29:11 was written to Israel in exile, not as a personal financial promise.
✅ 2. Does it point back to Jesus?

True messages glorify Christ, not self-help or emotional validation.
📖 “For I resolved to know nothing while I was with you except Jesus Christ and Him crucified.” (1 Corinthians 2:2)
✅ 3. Does it align with the Gospel message?

The true Gospel message is:
Jesus died for our sins. (1 Corinthians 15:3)
He rose again. (1 Corinthians 15:4)
Salvation is by grace through faith alone. (Ephesians 2:8-9)
🌟 Why This Matters for Your Faith
Sharing incomplete truths can:
❌ Lead people to trust in works-based faith.
❌ Confuse those seeking truth.
❌ Water down the power of the Gospel.

✅ As believers, we must be truth bearers, not just trend followers.
📖 “Test all things; hold fast to what is good.” (1 Thessalonians 5:21)

🌍 What Should You Share Instead?
✅ Scripture in Context
✅ The Full Gospel Message
✅ Encouragement That Points to Jesus
💡 Before you hit "Share," ask:

Does this honor Christ?
Is this biblically sound?
Am I pointing people to Jesus or emotional hype?

📜 FAITH DECLARATION FOR JANUARY 12, 2025 📜
"I choose to share only biblical truth. I will test every message I hear and point people back to Jesus Christ alone. He is the Way, the Truth, and the Life!"

🔥 THE “SHARE TRUTH, NOT TRENDS” CHALLENGE 🔥
✅ Step 1: Commit to fact-checking posts against Scripture.
✅ Step 2: Share a verse in context instead of emotional memes.
✅ Step 3: Tag 3 friends and encourage them to be truth-bearers.

🌌 DON’T COMPROMISE – STAND FOR TRUTH 🌌
The world needs truth, not feel-good messages.
People need Jesus, not vague positivity.
📖 “Sanctify them by the truth; Your Word is truth.” (John 17:17)
👉 Are you ready to be a voice for biblical truth?

🙏 PRAYER FOR JANUARY 12, 2025 🙏
Heavenly Father,
Thank You for giving us Your Word as the ultimate source of truth. Help me to discern what is truly biblical and reject messages that twist or water down Your Gospel. Give me boldness to share the truth, not for popularity but for Your glory. Let my words and actions point people to Jesus Christ alone.
In Jesus’ name, Amen. ✝️

title: 🔥 THE DEVIL LOVES SILENT CHRISTIANS—ARE YOU ONE OF THEM? 🚨🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 THE DEVIL LOVES SILENT CHRISTIANS—ARE YOU ONE OF THEM? 🚨🔥
📖 Romans 10:14 – "How will they call on Him in whom they have not believed? And how are they to believe in Him of whom they have never heard? And how are they to hear without someone preaching?"
🚨 Satan doesn’t need you to deny Jesus—he just needs you to keep quiet about Him!

🔥 THE WORLD SAYS: "Faith is personal! Keep your religion to yourself!"
🔥 THE BIBLE SAYS: "Go into all the world and preach the gospel!" (Mark 16:15)
👉 Are you boldly proclaiming Jesus, or are you staying silent while souls perish?

🔥 1. SATAN WANTS YOU TO STAY QUIET BECAUSE HE KNOWS THE POWER OF YOUR VOICE!
📖 Revelation 12:11 – "They overcame him by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of their testimony."

🔥 WHY DOES THE DEVIL WANT YOU TO SHUT UP?
❌ Because YOUR TESTIMONY has power!
❌ Because when you speak, people get saved!
❌ Because the Gospel is a weapon against hell!
🚨 SILENCE IS NOT LOVE—IT'S A DEATH SENTENCE!

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
If you saw a house on fire with people inside, would you stay quiet?
👉 NO! You would shout, scream, and do whatever it takes to warn them!
📖 Ezekiel 33:6 – "If the watchman sees the sword coming and does not blow the trumpet… I will require their blood at the watchman's hand."
🚨 SO WHY ARE SO MANY CHRISTIANS SILENT WHILE THE WORLD BURNS?

🔥 2. WHEN YOU STAY SILENT, YOU HELP THE DEVIL WIN!
📖 2 Corinthians 4:3-4 – "If our gospel is veiled, it is veiled to those who are perishing. The god of this world has blinded the minds of unbelievers."

🔥 HOW SATAN USES SILENCE:
❌ He convinces Christians that speaking out is "offensive."
❌ He makes them afraid of persecution.
❌ He deceives them into thinking their words won’t matter.
🚨 BUT THE TRUTH CAN BREAK CHAINS!

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A man once told a Christian, "Why didn’t you ever tell me about Jesus? If I die and go to hell, it's partly your fault."
📖 Mark 8:38 – "Whoever is ashamed of Me and My words, the Son of Man will be ashamed of him when He comes in His Father's glory."
👉 WILL YOU LET FEAR KEEP YOU SILENT? OR WILL YOU SPEAK THE TRUTH BEFORE IT'S TOO LATE?

🔥 3. JESUS DIDN’T CALL US TO BE SILENT—HE CALLED US TO BE WARRIORS!
📖 Acts 4:20 – "For we cannot but speak of what we have seen and heard."

🔥 JESUS' COMMAND IS CLEAR:
✅ "Go and make disciples!" (Matthew 28:19)
✅ "Proclaim the gospel!" (Mark 16:15)
✅ "Shout it from the rooftops!" (Matthew 10:27)
🚨 THE EARLY CHURCH WASN’T SILENT—THEY PREACHED UNTIL IT COST THEM THEIR LIVES!

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
In many countries, Christians are beaten, arrested, and even killed for sharing the Gospel.
❌ Meanwhile, in free nations, many stay silent out of "fear of offending someone."
📖 Luke 19:40 – "If they keep quiet, the stones will cry out!"
👉 WILL YOU LET A ROCK PRAISE JESUS LOUDER THAN YOU?

🔥 4. WHAT HAPPENS WHEN CHRISTIANS STOP SPEAKING?
📖 Isaiah 5:20 – "Woe to those who call evil good and good evil!"

🔥 LOOK AT THE WORLD TODAY!
❌ Sin is openly celebrated.
❌ Truth is labeled as "hate speech."
❌ Churches are watering down the Gospel.
🚨 WHY? BECAUSE TOO MANY CHRISTIANS ARE SILENT!

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A school recently banned students from bringing Bibles, but they allow satanic books.
❌ Why? Because Christians didn’t speak up!
📖 Proverbs 31:8 – "Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves!"
👉 WILL YOU KEEP LETTING DARKNESS WIN? OR WILL YOU BE THE LIGHT JESUS CALLED YOU TO BE?

🔥 5. WHAT MUST YOU DO? SPEAK UP—THE WORLD NEEDS YOUR VOICE!
📖 Romans 1:16 – "For I am not ashamed of the gospel, for it is the power of God for salvation!"

🔥 HOW TO BREAK THE SILENCE:
✅ SHARE YOUR TESTIMONY—Tell people what Jesus has done in your life! (Revelation 12:11)
✅ PREACH THE GOSPEL—Even if the world hates you for it! (John 15:18-19)
✅ USE EVERY PLATFORM—Social media, work, family, strangers—SPEAK UP! (Matthew 10:32)
✅ WARN OTHERS—Don’t let fear keep you from telling the truth! (Ezekiel 33:6)
🚨 JESUS IS COMING BACK. WILL HE FIND YOU SPEAKING, OR STAYING SILENT?
📖 Matthew 24:14 – "This gospel of the kingdom will be proclaimed throughout the whole world as a testimony to all nations, and then the end will come."
🔥 THE DEVIL LOVES SILENT CHRISTIANS—WILL YOU LET HIM WIN? OR WILL YOU SPEAK OUT FOR JESUS?

🙏 POWERFUL PRAYER FOR BOLDNESS!
"Lord Jesus, give me boldness to speak Your truth without fear. Remove every spirit of timidity and fill me with the fire of the Holy Spirit. I refuse to stay silent while the world perishes. Use my voice to bring people to salvation! In Jesus’ name, AMEN!" 🙏🔥

title: "What If Today Was the Last Day Before Jesus Returns?" 🔥
paragraphs:
"What If Today Was the Last Day Before Jesus Returns?" 🔥
✝️ A Message from Brother John Domino "PiX" S. Asis – Follower of Jesus Christ and a Servant of God
🌍 Imagine this: It’s midnight. You’re lying in bed, scrolling through your phone.

Suddenly, the sky cracks open with a deafening sound.
A trumpet blast shakes the earth.
You run outside, and you see Him—Jesus Christ—returning in glory.
It’s too late to repent. Too late to pray. Too late to choose.
What if today was the last day before Jesus returns? Would you be ready?
📖 “So you also must be ready, because the Son of Man will come at an hour when you do not expect Him.” (Matthew 24:44)

🔥 The Bible Warns Us: Jesus Is Coming Unexpectedly
Many people live as if Jesus is delaying His return.
They think, "I have time to get right with God later."
But Jesus said otherwise.
📖 “For you yourselves know very well that the day of the Lord will come just like a thief in the night.” (1 Thessalonians 5:2)
🚨 A thief doesn’t announce when he’s coming. He comes suddenly. Unexpectedly.

🔥 If Jesus Returned Tonight, What Would He Find?
Jesus Himself asked a haunting question:
📖 “When the Son of Man comes, will He find faith on the earth?” (Luke 18:8)
What will He find when He returns?

✅ A world full of distractions.
✅ Churches full of people, but hearts far from God.
✅ Many who say they love Jesus but deny Him with their lives.
💡 The scariest thing? Many will think they are saved… but Jesus will reject them.
📖 “Not everyone who says to Me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter the kingdom of heaven, but only the one who does the will of My Father who is in heaven.” (Matthew 7:21)
🚨 Don’t just assume you’re ready. MAKE SURE.

🔥 3 Questions to Ask Yourself Right Now
If Jesus comes tonight, can you answer these questions with confidence?
1️⃣ Have I truly placed my faith in Jesus Christ alone for salvation?

Not church attendance. Not good works. Only Jesus.
📖 “Believe in the Lord Jesus, and you will be saved.” (Acts 16:31)
2️⃣ Am I living in obedience to Christ?

True salvation produces a changed life.
📖 “If anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation.” (2 Corinthians 5:17)
3️⃣ Have I shared the Gospel with those around me?

If you KNEW Jesus was coming tomorrow, would you finally tell your friends and family?
📖 “Go and make disciples of all nations.” (Matthew 28:19)
🔥 What Will Happen When Jesus Returns?
The Bible tells us exactly what will happen on that day.

✅ The dead in Christ will rise first.
📖 “For the Lord Himself will descend from heaven… and the dead in Christ will rise first.” (1 Thessalonians 4:16)

✅ Believers will be caught up to meet Him.
📖 “Then we who are alive and remain shall be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air.” (1 Thessalonians 4:17)

✅ Unbelievers will face judgment.
📖 “He will separate the people one from another as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.” (Matthew 25:32)
🚨 For believers, this is a glorious day. For unbelievers, it’s a day of terror.

🔥 How to Be 100% Ready for Jesus’ Return
Jesus isn’t looking for perfect people—He’s looking for prepared people.
Are you ready? Here’s how you can be sure:
✅ 1. Repent and Believe in Jesus Christ.

Turn away from sin and trust in Jesus alone for salvation.
📖 “Unless you repent, you will all perish.” (Luke 13:3)
✅ 2. Live Every Day for Jesus.

Follow Him, not the world.
📖 “Be doers of the Word, not just hearers.” (James 1:22)
✅ 3. Share the Gospel Boldly.

If Jesus is coming soon, why stay silent?
📖 “How can they believe in the one of whom they have not heard?” (Romans 10:14)
📜 FAITH DECLARATION FOR JANUARY 16, 2025 📜
"Today, I choose to live as if Jesus is returning soon. I place my faith in Christ alone for salvation. I will not be distracted, I will not be lukewarm—I will be ready."

🔥 THE “BE READY” CHALLENGE 🔥
✅ Step 1: Make sure YOU are right with God.
✅ Step 3: Tag 3 friends and challenge them to be ready.

🌌 WHAT IF THIS REALLY IS THE LAST DAY? 🌌
📖 “Behold, I am coming soon!” (Revelation 22:12)

👉 Don’t wait until it’s too late. Get right with God TODAY.
👉 Jesus is coming—be ready.

🙏 PRAYER FOR JANUARY 16, 2025 🙏
Heavenly Father,
I know You are coming soon, and I don’t want to be caught unprepared. I repent of my sins and place my full trust in Jesus Christ as my Lord and Savior. Help me live each day for You, and give me boldness to share Your truth with others. Thank You for Your grace and mercy.
In Jesus’ name, Amen. ✝️

title: 🔥 PiX Ultimate Sweet & Savory Pork and Cabbage Soup™ 🔥
paragraphs: 🔥 PiX Ultimate Sweet & Savory Pork and Cabbage Soup™ 🔥
✨ (With BBQ Marinade, Banana Ketchup & Oyster Sauce) ✨

Mga higala, once again, I have created something legendary in the kitchen! 🤯
I took random ingredients, trusted my instincts, and boom—PiX Ultimate Sweet & Savory Pork and Cabbage Soup™ was born! (Murag naa koy hidden talent sa culinary arts, Lord? 🤣)

💡 What makes this soup so special?
🔥 BBQ-marinated pork for that smoky, rich taste.
🍌 Banana ketchup for a sweet & tangy kick!
🦪 Oyster sauce for that deep, umami flavor.
🥬 Cabbage for nutrients, crunch, and balance.

My family took the first sip and said:
💛 "Pa, unsa ni? Dili ni basta-basta nga sabaw, murag pang-restaurant!"
At that moment, I knew I had created something divine. 😎
📖 Biblical Reflection – God Works Through the Unexpected!

Sometimes, the best things in life happen when we least expect them.
Even in the kitchen, we see God's wisdom—He turns simple, available ingredients into something extraordinary.

✨ Ephesians 3:20 – “Now to Him who is able to do immeasurably more than all we ask or imagine…”
(Or in this case, “more delicious than we planned or expected!” 😂)

✨ Psalm 34:8 – “Taste and see that the Lord is good.”
(And also, taste and see that this soup is AMAZING! 😂)
🔥 PiX Ultimate Sweet & Savory Pork and Cabbage Soup™ Recipe (Serves 10) 🔥
🛑 INGREDIENTS (Prepare to be Blessed!)
For the Pork Marinade:

🐖 3 lbs pork belly (or pork chops, sliced thin)
🍖 ½ cup barbecue marinade (para sa smoky goodness!)
🍌 ¼ cup banana ketchup (adds a sweet-savory balance)
🦪 2 tbsp oyster sauce (for umami depth!)
For the Soup:

🧅 2 onions, sliced (for extra aroma)
🧄 8 cloves garlic, minced (pang-immune boost!)
🫚 2-inch piece of ginger, sliced into thin strips (para init sa tiyan!)
💦 15 cups water or chicken broth (about 4 quarts)
🫙 1 tbsp soy sauce (adds depth)
🐟 1 tbsp fish sauce (optional, but adds that seafood umami punch!)
🧂 1½ tsp black pepper (para sa light spice)
🍯 2 tsp sugar (to balance flavors)
🔥 2 tbsp cooking oil (for sautéing)
🥬 1 large head of cabbage, chopped (adds crunch & nutrients!)
🌿 3 green onions, chopped (for garnish)
🔥 HOW TO COOK PiX ULTIMATE SOUP™ 🔥
1️⃣ Marinate the Pork – Flavor Starts Here!

🥢 In a bowl, mix barbecue marinade, banana ketchup, and oyster sauce.
🥩 Add the sliced pork and coat well.
🕐 Let it marinate for at least 30 minutes (pero mas maayo kung overnight—EXTRA FLAVOR!).
2️⃣ Sear the Pork – Unlock the Magic!

🔥 Heat 2 tbsp cooking oil in a large pot over medium heat.
🍖 Add the marinated pork and sear until slightly caramelized.
👉 Remove from the pot and set aside.
3️⃣ Sauté the Aromatics – The Secret to Flavor!

🧄 In the same pot, add onions, garlic, and ginger.
👃 Sauté until fragrant (If your neighbors start asking "Unsa na nga luto?"—you're doing it right! 🤣).
4️⃣ Make the Soup Base – The Soul of the Dish!

💦 Pour in 15 cups of water or chicken broth.
🫙 Add soy sauce, fish sauce (if using), black pepper, and sugar.
🔥 Bring to a boil to combine all flavors.
5️⃣ Simmer the Soup – Patience is the Key!

🥩 Return the seared pork to the pot.
⏳ Cover and simmer for 30 minutes until the pork is tender.
🙏 (While waiting, say a short prayer: “Lord, let this be the best soup ever!” 😂)
6️⃣ Add the Cabbage – For That Crunch & Nutrition!

🥬 Stir in the chopped cabbage.
🔥 Simmer for 5–7 minutes until slightly wilted but still crisp.
7️⃣ Final Adjustments & Serve!

🥄 Taste and adjust seasoning if needed.
🌿 Garnish with chopped green onions.
🍚 Serve hot with steamed rice or vermicelli noodles.
🤤 Prepare for compliments!
🔥 Why PiX Ultimate Sweet & Savory Soup™ is a Must-Try? 🔥

✅ BBQ pork gives it a smoky, sweet, savory taste! 🍖
✅ Banana ketchup adds that unique Filipino twist! 🍌
✅ Oyster sauce deepens the umami factor! 🦪
✅ Cabbage makes it light but filling! 🥬
✅ Super comforting, rich, and perfect for any weather! ☁️☀️🌧️
💡 Health Benefits of PiX Ultimate Soup™:

✅ Boosts Immunity – Thanks to garlic, ginger, and cabbage!
✅ Good for Digestion – Ginger and fiber help with gut health!
✅ Heart-Healthy – Onions & oyster sauce help lower blood pressure!
✅ Protein-Packed – Perfect post-workout meal!
🔥 Final Thoughts: This Soup is a Life Lesson! 🔥

🔥 Life is unpredictable—sometimes, we just have to work with what’s available!
🔥 Just like cooking, faith requires patience—great things take time to simmer.
🔥 Even simple ingredients can create something extraordinary!

So, kinsa ganahan mo-try ani? Or do you also have a "mystery dish" invention?
Let’s inspire each other sa kitchen ug sa kinabuhi! 😆🙌

title: "The Silent Christian – Why Staying Quiet About Jesus Is Dangerous" 🔥
paragraphs:
"The Silent Christian – Why Staying Quiet About Jesus Is Dangerous" 🔥
✝️ A Message from Brother John Domino "PiX" S. Asis – Follower of Jesus Christ and a Servant of God
🌍 In a world desperate for truth, silence can be deadly.
As Christians, we carry the greatest news humanity has ever heard—the Gospel of Jesus Christ. Yet, many remain silent. Why?

Fear of judgment.
Fear of rejection.
Fear of offending others.
But Jesus never called us to blend in or stay comfortable. He called us to speak boldly and proclaim the truth, no matter the cost.
📖 “Whoever acknowledges Me before others, I will also acknowledge before My Father in heaven. But whoever disowns Me before others, I will disown before My Father in heaven.” (Matthew 10:32-33)
💡 Remaining silent about Jesus is dangerous—for you and for those who need to hear the Gospel.

🔥 Why Staying Silent About Jesus Is Dangerous
1️⃣ It Denies the Mission Jesus Gave Us.
Jesus commanded us to go and make disciples of all nations (Matthew 28:19-20). Staying silent about Him is disobedience to His call.
📖 “You are the light of the world. A city on a hill cannot be hidden.” (Matthew 5:14)

Imagine this: If you had the cure for a deadly disease but chose to keep it to yourself, wouldn’t that be cruel?
Jesus is the cure for sin, death, and eternal separation from God—how can we keep this to ourselves?
2️⃣ It Withholds the Gospel from Those Who Need It Most.

Millions are lost and heading toward eternal separation from God.
Many have never heard the Gospel, while others have been misled by false teachings.
📖 “How, then, can they call on the one they have not believed in? And how can they believe in the one of whom they have not heard? And how can they hear without someone preaching to them?” (Romans 10:14)
Your silence could mean the difference between someone hearing the truth or missing it completely.

3️⃣ It Harms Your Witness and Growth in Christ.
Silence weakens your faith over time. Boldly sharing Jesus:

Strengthens your trust in God.
Inspires others to follow Christ.
Keeps your heart aligned with His mission.
📖 “For the Spirit God gave us does not make us timid, but gives us power, love, and self-discipline.” (2 Timothy 1:7)
💡 Fear is not from God. Boldness is a gift of the Holy Spirit.

🔥 How to Break the Silence and Share Jesus Boldly
1️⃣ Overcome Fear with Faith.

Fear is natural, but faith gives us courage.
Trust that God will give you the words to say.
📖 “Do not worry about how or what to say, for it will be given to you in that hour.” (Matthew 10:19)
2️⃣ Start Small but Be Consistent.

Share your faith in daily conversations—with family, friends, coworkers, or strangers.
It doesn’t have to be perfect; it just has to be sincere.
3️⃣ Pray for Boldness and Opportunities.

Ask God to open doors for Gospel conversations.
Pray for courage to speak when the opportunity arises.
📖 “And pray for me, too, that God may open a door for our message, so that we may proclaim the mystery of Christ.” (Colossians 4:3)
4️⃣ Share Your Testimony.

Your story of how Jesus changed your life is powerful.
People may argue theology, but they cannot deny your personal transformation.
📖 “They triumphed over him by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of their testimony.” (Revelation 12:11)

🔥 The Eternal Cost of Staying Silent
👉 For the lost: If we stay silent, they may never hear the truth.
👉 For us: Silence is a form of denial.
📖 “If anyone is ashamed of Me and My words, the Son of Man will be ashamed of them when He comes in His glory.” (Luke 9:26)
💡 Speak now, while there’s still time. Lives—and eternities—are at stake.

📜 FAITH DECLARATION FOR JANUARY 16, 2025 📜
"Today, I choose to boldly share my faith. I refuse to remain silent when the world needs Jesus. With God’s power, I will proclaim the Gospel and let my light shine for His glory."

🔥 THE “BREAK THE SILENCE” CHALLENGE 🔥
✅ Step 1: Share the Gospel with someone this week—start with your testimony.
✅ Step 2: Pray daily for boldness to speak for Jesus.
✅ Step 3: Tag 3 friends to join you in spreading the Gospel.

🌌 TODAY IS THE DAY TO SPEAK UP FOR JESUS 🌌
📖 “Let the redeemed of the Lord tell their story.” (Psalm 107:2)
👉 The world is loud about its lies. It’s time for Christians to be louder with the truth.

🙏 PRAYER FOR JANUARY 16, 2025 🙏
Heavenly Father,
Forgive me for the times I’ve stayed silent about Jesus. Give me boldness to share the Gospel fearlessly. Help me trust in Your Spirit to guide my words and open hearts to the truth. Let my life glorify You as I proclaim Your name boldly.
In Jesus’ name, Amen. ✝️

title: "Religion Won’t Save You – Only Jesus Can" 🔥
paragraphs:
"Religion Won’t Save You – Only Jesus Can" 🔥
✝️ A Message from Brother John Domino "PiX" S. Asis – Follower of Jesus Christ and Servant of God
🌍 This isn’t just another post—it’s a call for transformation.
👉 Imagine dying today, believing religion could save you—only to realize you missed Jesus entirely.

Here’s the truth:
✅ Church attendance won’t save you.
✅ Being a good person won’t erase your sin.
✅ Religious rituals won’t secure your eternity.
📖 “Salvation is found in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven given to mankind by which we must be saved.” (Acts 4:12)
💡 Only Jesus can save you. Not religion. Not works.
This message might challenge you, but truth cannot stay silent.

🌟 RELIGION CAN’T SAVE YOU 🌟
Many sincere people are trapped in the belief that:
✅ Church attendance equals salvation.
✅ Good works cancel sin.
✅ Religious traditions replace a personal relationship with Jesus.
💡 But Jesus didn’t die for empty rituals—He died to set you free.

1️⃣ "Going to Church Makes Me a Christian" (Myth)
📖 “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.” (John 14:6)
✅ Truth: Sitting in a church doesn’t make you a Christian—surrendering your heart to Jesus does.

💬 A Story:
A man once said to me, “I never missed a Sunday service, but I felt spiritually empty.” Only when he turned to Jesus personally—not to religious habits—did his life change.
✅ Reflection: Are you attending church to pursue tradition or to pursue Jesus?

2️⃣ "Being a Good Person Is Enough" (Myth)
📖 “For all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God.” (Romans 3:23)
✅ Truth: No amount of goodness can erase sin—only the blood of Jesus can.
💡 Reality Check: If being good were enough, why did Jesus have to suffer on the cross?
✅ Reflection: Are you trusting in your goodness or God’s grace?

3️⃣ "Following Traditions Saves You" (Myth)
📖 “You nullify the Word of God for the sake of your traditions.” (Mark 7:13)
✅ Truth: Traditions might remind us of God, but they can’t redeem us.
💡 Faith isn’t about rituals—it’s about a transformed heart.
✅ Reflection: Is your faith producing real change, or are you just going through the motions?

🔥 WHAT THE BIBLE TEACHES ABOUT SALVATION 🔥
Here’s what Scripture says:

✅ 1. Salvation is a Gift – You Can’t Earn It
📖 “For it is by grace you have been saved, through faith—and this is not from yourselves, it is the gift of God.” (Ephesians 2:8-9)

✅ 2. Jesus Paid the Price for Your Sins
📖 “But God demonstrates His own love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.” (Romans 5:8)

✅ 3. Repentance and Faith Go Hand in Hand
📖 “Repent and believe the good news!” (Mark 1:15)

✅ 4. True Faith Produces Transformation
📖 “If anyone is in Christ, the new creation has come: The old has gone, the new is here!” (2 Corinthians 5:17)

🌍 HOW TO MOVE FROM RELIGION TO A RELATIONSHIP WITH JESUS 🌍
✅ 1️⃣ Admit You’re a Sinner in Need of Jesus
📖 “For all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God.” (Romans 3:23)

✅ 2️⃣ Believe Jesus is the Only Way
📖 “For God so loved the world that He gave His one and only Son, that whoever believes in Him shall not perish but have eternal life.” (John 3:16)

✅ 3️⃣ Repent and Turn to God
📖 “Repent, then, and turn to God, so that your sins may be wiped out.” (Acts 3:19)

✅ 4️⃣ Trust Fully in Jesus Christ
📖 “Take up your cross and follow Me.” (Luke 9:23)

📜 FAITH DECLARATION FOR JANUARY 9, 2025 📜
"I declare that religion cannot save me. My faith is in Jesus Christ alone. I am saved by His grace, transformed by His truth, and surrendered to His purpose. I choose Jesus today and forever."

🔥 THE "FOLLOW JESUS, NOT RELIGION" CHALLENGE 🔥
✅ Step 1: Pray from your heart—forget routines, just talk to God.
✅ Step 3: Tag 3 friends who need this message of truth.
➡️ Let’s ignite a global movement of faith—share this now! 🌍✝️

🌌 THIS IS YOUR MOMENT – CHOOSE JESUS, NOT RELIGION 🌌
📖 “You will seek Me and find Me when you seek Me with all your heart.” (Jeremiah 29:13)
Religion is empty, but Jesus is everything.
💡 Are you ready to let go of tradition and pursue Jesus fully?

🙏 PRAYER FOR JANUARY 9, 2025 🙏
Heavenly Father,
I trust in Jesus alone for my salvation. Break every chain of religious thinking. Transform my heart, renew my mind, and fill me with Your Holy Spirit. Let my life reflect Your glory.
In Jesus’ name, Amen. ✝️

title: "Heaven or Hell – Why Ignoring Jesus Is the Most Dangerous Choice" 🔥
paragraphs:
"Heaven or Hell – Why Ignoring Jesus Is the Most Dangerous Choice" 🔥
✝️ A Message from Brother John Domino "PiX" S. Asis – Follower of Jesus Christ and a Servant of God
🌍 This message is urgent.
👉 What if today was your last chance to face the truth?

✅ Heaven is real.
✅ Hell is real.
✅ Eternity is not a gamble.
Ignoring Jesus is not just risky—it’s eternally dangerous.
📖 “For the wages of sin is death, but the gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.” (Romans 6:23)
Today, I need to share the truth many avoid, but Jesus Himself warned about it. This is not just a message—it's a wake-up call for your soul.

🌟 What Happens When You Die?
There are only two destinations for eternity: Heaven or Hell.
1. Heaven – Eternal Life with God

A place of perfect peace, joy, and the presence of God.
Reserved for those who have placed their faith alone in Jesus Christ.
📖 “Whoever believes in Him shall not perish but have eternal life.” (John 3:16)
2. Hell – Eternal Separation from God

A place of torment, regret, and complete separation from God's presence.
Created as judgment for Satan and his demons but also for those who reject the truth.
📖 “They will be punished with everlasting destruction and shut out from the presence of the Lord.” (2 Thessalonians 1:9)
💡 Your destination is determined by one thing: What you do with Jesus Christ.

🔥 The Reality of Sin – Why We Need Jesus
✅ Every person is a sinner.
📖 “For all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God.” (Romans 3:23)

✅ Sin separates us from God.
📖 “The wages of sin is death.” (Romans 6:23)

Sin is not just bad behavior—it’s rebellion against God.
The consequence is eternal separation from Him in hell.

🌟 The Good News: Jesus Paid Your Debt!
💡 This is where God’s grace shines the brightest.

God didn’t leave us in our sin.
He sent Jesus Christ—fully God, fully man—to pay the price for us.
On the cross, Jesus took your place.
📖 “But God demonstrates His own love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.” (Romans 5:8)
✅ Three Days Later – Jesus Defeated Death!

He rose from the dead, proving His power over sin and hell. (1 Corinthians 15:3-4)
Now, eternal life is a free gift offered to all who believe.
❌ The Most Dangerous Lie: "I’m a Good Person, I’ll Be Fine"
Many believe they are good enough for heaven.
But goodness can never erase sin.
📖 “For by grace you have been saved, through faith—and this is not from yourselves, it is the gift of God— not by works, so that no one can boast.” (Ephesians 2:8-9)
✅ Salvation is not:

Attending church.
Doing good deeds.
Being religious.
Following traditions.
✅ Salvation is:

Trusting in Jesus Christ ALONE for the forgiveness of your sins. (John 14:6)
🌍 How to Be Saved Today (The Gospel)
The Bible makes it simple and clear:

✅ 1. Admit You’re a Sinner
📖 “For all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God.” (Romans 3:23)

✅ 2. Believe Jesus Died for Your Sins and Rose Again
📖 “Believe in the Lord Jesus Christ and you will be saved.” (Acts 16:31)

✅ 3. Trust in Christ Alone for Salvation
📖 “Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.” (Romans 10:13)

👉 That’s it. No works. No rituals. No conditions.
Faith alone in Jesus Christ alone.

📜 FAITH DECLARATION FOR JANUARY 10, 2025 📜
"Today, I choose Jesus Christ as my Savior. I trust in His finished work on the cross for my salvation, not my works, not my efforts. He alone is my Redeemer and my hope for eternity."

🔥 THE “HEAVEN OR HELL” CHALLENGE 🔥
✅ Step 1: Pray and trust Jesus Christ alone today.
✅ Step 3: Tag 3 friends who need to hear the truth today.

🌌 DON’T WAIT – YOUR ETERNITY MATTERS 🌌
📖 “It is appointed for men to die once, and after that comes judgment.” (Hebrews 9:27)

Heaven and Hell are real places.
👉 Only Jesus can save you.

Don’t wait for “one day” to make things right with God—
Today is the day of salvation. (2 Corinthians 6:2)

🙏 PRAYER FOR JANUARY 10, 2025 🙏
Heavenly Father,
I come before You today, acknowledging I am a sinner in need of Your grace. Thank You for sending Jesus Christ to die for my sins. I place my faith fully in Him, believing in His death and resurrection for my salvation. Thank You for the free gift of eternal life. Help me to live for You, not out of obligation, but out of love for what You’ve done.
In Jesus’ name, Amen. ✝️

title: 🔥 "FREE WILL: DOES GOD FORCE US TO FOLLOW HIM, OR DO WE CHOOSE OUR DESTINY?" 🚀🔥
paragraphs: 🔥 "FREE WILL: DOES GOD FORCE US TO FOLLOW HIM, OR DO WE CHOOSE OUR DESTINY?" 🚀🔥

📖 Deuteronomy 30:19 – "I call heaven and earth to witness against you today, that I have set before you life and death, blessing and curse. Therefore choose life, that you and your offspring may live."

🚨 Does God control every decision we make, or do we have the power to choose?
🚨 If God is sovereign, does that mean free will is an illusion?
🚨 If we have free will, why does God allow evil?
🔥 Today, we expose the truth about free will, choice, and eternal destiny!

🔥 1. FREE WILL IS A GIFT FROM GOD—BUT IT COMES WITH CONSEQUENCES!
📖 Genesis 2:16-17 – "And the Lord God commanded the man, saying, ‘You may surely eat of every tree of the garden, but of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil you shall not eat, for in the day that you eat of it you shall surely die.’"

🚨 God gave Adam and Eve the ability to choose between obedience and sin.
🚨 He warned them about the consequences—but He didn’t stop them from choosing.
🔥 God will never force us to love Him—because love that is forced is not love at all!

✅ We have the power to obey or rebel.
✅ We have the power to accept or reject Christ.
✅ We have the power to choose life or death.
🔥 Every choice has an eternal consequence!

🔥 2. FREE WILL DOES NOT MEAN FREEDOM FROM CONSEQUENCES!
📖 Galatians 6:7-8 – "Do not be deceived: God is not mocked, for whatever one sows, that will he also reap. For the one who sows to his own flesh will from the flesh reap corruption, but the one who sows to the Spirit will from the Spirit reap eternal life."

🚨 Many people think, "I can do whatever I want!"
🚨 Yes, you can—but you CANNOT escape the consequences of your choices!

🔥 EXAMPLES OF FREE WILL & CONSEQUENCES:
✅ Adam and Eve chose to eat the forbidden fruit—they were cast out of Eden.
✅ The Israelites chose to disobey God—they wandered 40 years in the wilderness.
✅ Judas chose to betray Jesus—he ended in destruction.
🔥 Every choice leads to a blessing or a curse—THERE IS NO NEUTRAL GROUND!

🔥 3. GOD’S SOVEREIGNTY AND MAN’S FREE WILL WORK TOGETHER!
📖 Proverbs 16:9 – "The heart of man plans his way, but the Lord establishes his steps."
🚨 God is in control, but He still allows human choices!

🔥 EXAMPLES IN THE BIBLE:
✅ Pharaoh hardened his heart—but God also hardened Pharaoh’s heart. (Exodus 8:15, Exodus 9:12)
✅ Joseph’s brothers sold him into slavery—but God used it for good. (Genesis 50:20)
✅ People chose to crucify Jesus—but it was part of God’s redemption plan. (Acts 2:23)
🔥 God does not override free will, but He can use human choices to fulfill His divine purposes!

🔥 4. WHY DOES GOD ALLOW EVIL IF HE IS ALL-POWERFUL?
📖 2 Peter 3:9 – "The Lord is not slow to fulfill His promise as some count slowness, but is patient toward you, not wishing that any should perish, but that all should reach repentance."
🚨 If God stopped all evil, He would have to take away free will!

✅ God does not force people to do good—He gives them the choice.
✅ If God removed free will, we would be robots, not children of God.
✅ Evil exists because people CHOOSE to rebel against God.
🔥 But there’s good news—JUDGMENT IS COMING!
📖 Revelation 20:10 – "And the devil who had deceived them was thrown into the lake of fire."
🔥 God allows free will for now, but one day, evil will be DESTROYED forever!

🔥 5. FREE WILL AND SALVATION—YOUR CHOICE DETERMINES YOUR ETERNITY!
📖 John 3:16 – "For God so loved the world, that He gave His only Son, that whoever believes in Him should not perish but have eternal life."
🚨 Heaven or hell is YOUR CHOICE.

✅ God made a way for salvation—but you must CHOOSE Jesus.
✅ Rejecting Christ is a CHOICE that leads to eternal separation from God.
✅ No one will stand before God and say, "I had no choice!"
📖 Joshua 24:15 – "Choose this day whom you will serve!"
🔥 The most important choice in your life is what you do with JESUS!

🙏 POWERFUL PRAYER TO SURRENDER YOUR WILL TO GOD
"Lord Jesus, I choose You! I don’t want to live for myself anymore. I surrender my will, my desires, and my life to You. Forgive me for my sins and lead me on the path of righteousness. Fill me with Your Holy Spirit so that I may walk in obedience and truth. I CHOOSE LIFE! In Jesus’ name, AMEN!" 🙏🔥

title: "The LA Fire – A Terrifying Reminder of Eternal Realities" 🔥
paragraphs:
"The LA Fire – A Terrifying Reminder of Eternal Realities" 🔥
✝️ A Message from Brother John Domino "PiX" S. Asis – Follower of Jesus Christ and a Servant of God
🌍 The recent Los Angeles fire has left the world shaken.

Over 10 lives lost.
Nearly 10,000 structures destroyed.
Tens of thousands evacuated.
Billions of dollars in damage.
The images of flames engulfing homes, businesses, and entire communities have been overwhelming. As heartbreaking as this event is, it also reminds us of an even greater reality—a fire far worse than anything we’ve seen here on earth.
👉 What if this tragedy is a wake-up call for eternity?

🔥 The Reality of Judgment – A Fire That Never Dies
The devastation caused by the LA fires reminds us how fragile life can be. No one expected this disaster to strike, yet it came suddenly, consuming everything in its path.
📖 “For we must all appear before the judgment seat of Christ.” (2 Corinthians 5:10)

Hell is described as a place of eternal fire in the Bible:
📖 “And anyone not found written in the Book of Life was cast into the lake of fire.” (Revelation 20:15)
💡 The fire in LA will eventually burn out, but the fire of eternal separation from God never will.

🌍 What Are You Building Your Life On?
Many of the homes and businesses lost in the fire were once beautiful, expensive, and carefully built. Yet in an instant, they were reduced to ashes.
💡 The Bible warns us against building our lives on temporary things.

📖 “For no one can lay a foundation other than the one already laid, which is Jesus Christ… If anyone builds on this foundation using gold, silver, costly stones, wood, hay or straw, their work will be shown for what it is.” (1 Corinthians 3:11-13)
✅ Eternal life isn't about material success, but your relationship with Jesus Christ.

🔥 The Urgency of Salvation – Don’t Wait for Disaster to Repent
💡 The suddenness of the LA fire reminds us how quickly life can change.
📖 “It is appointed for men to die once, and after this comes judgment.” (Hebrews 9:27)

The question is not if we will face death, but when.
👉 Are you prepared to stand before God?

🌟 The Good News: Jesus Paid the Price for You!
You don’t have to fear eternal separation from God.
Why? Because Jesus already took the punishment for your sins.
📖 “But God demonstrates His own love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.” (Romans 5:8)

✅ Jesus died on the cross, absorbing the judgment you and I deserve.
✅ He rose again, conquering sin and death.
✅ Eternal life is now a free gift—not something you can earn.

❌ The Most Dangerous Lie: "I'll Do It Later"
The LA fire came without warning.
So does eternity.

Many think they have more time to get right with God.
But the Bible warns us:
📖 “Today, if you hear His voice, do not harden your hearts.” (Hebrews 3:15)

🌍 How to Be Saved Today (The Gospel Message)
The Bible makes it clear and simple:

✅ 1. Admit You’re a Sinner.
📖 “For all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God.” (Romans 3:23)

✅ 2. Believe Jesus Died for You and Rose Again.
📖 “Believe in the Lord Jesus Christ, and you will be saved.” (Acts 16:31)

✅ 3. Trust in Christ Alone.
📖 “Everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved.” (Romans 10:13)
👉 It’s not complicated. It’s Jesus alone.

📜 FAITH DECLARATION FOR JANUARY 11, 2025 📜
"Today, I choose Jesus Christ as my Savior. I reject the temporary things of this world and place my faith fully in His finished work on the cross. Jesus, You are my only hope for eternity."

🔥 THE "ETERNAL WAKE-UP CALL" CHALLENGE 🔥
✅ Step 1: Examine Your Faith. Are you truly trusting Jesus?
✅ Step 3: Tag 3 friends who need to hear this truth today.

🌌 DON’T WAIT – CHOOSE JESUS TODAY 🌌
📖 “How shall we escape if we neglect so great a salvation?” (Hebrews 2:3)

The fire in Los Angeles was sudden and devastating.
👉 But there’s a far greater danger than losing earthly possessions—losing your soul.

🔥 Don’t wait for a personal disaster to seek Jesus.
Today is the day of salvation. (2 Corinthians 6:2)

🙏 PRAYER FOR JANUARY 11, 2025 🙏
Heavenly Father,
Today, I acknowledge the reality of eternity and the gift of salvation through Jesus Christ. I place my full trust in His finished work on the cross, knowing that only His sacrifice can save me. Thank You for the free gift of eternal life. Keep my heart focused on what truly matters.
In Jesus’ name, Amen. ✝️
