title: "Your Silence Could Cost Someone Their Eternity – Speak Up!" 🔥
paragraphs:
"Your Silence Could Cost Someone Their Eternity – Speak Up!" 🔥
✝️ A Message from Brother John Domino "PiX" S. Asis – Follower of Jesus Christ and a Servant of God

🌍 [INTRODUCTION – URGENT WARNING]
⚠️ Every second, someone dies without Jesus.
❌ Hell is real—but many Christians act like it’s not.

📢 If you KNEW someone was walking toward destruction, wouldn’t you warn them?
🚨 Yet, many believers stay silent while people around them are heading toward eternity without Christ.

📖 Key Verse:
"How then will they call on Him in whom they have not believed? And how are they to believe in Him of whom they have never heard? And how are they to hear without someone preaching?" (Romans 10:14)
🔥 This is your wake-up call! It’s time to speak up before it’s too late.

🔥 [1. WHY YOUR SILENCE IS COSTING LIVES]
📖 “For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.” (Romans 6:23)

💡 Here’s the reality:
👀 Every person you meet is either going to HEAVEN or HELL.
💀 If they die without Jesus, there are no second chances.

🚨 But here’s the problem:
❌ Many Christians are too afraid to share the Gospel.
❌ Many think, “Someone else will do it.”
❌ Many don’t speak up because they fear rejection or looking “too extreme.”
🎯 But Jesus NEVER called us to be silent. He called us to GO and preach the Gospel!
📖 “Go therefore and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit.” (Matthew 28:19)
🔥 If we really love people, we won’t stay silent—we will WARN them.

🔥 [2. THE LIES THAT KEEP CHRISTIANS SILENT]
⚠️ The devil wants you to believe these lies so you’ll keep quiet:

1️⃣ "I don’t want to offend anyone."
🚨 Truth: The Gospel is offensive to sin, but it’s the TRUTH that saves!
📖 “For am I now seeking the approval of man, or of God? If I were still trying to please man, I would not be a servant of Christ.” (Galatians 1:10)

2️⃣ "I don’t know enough about the Bible to share."
🚨 Truth: You don’t need a theology degree—just share what JESUS did for YOU!
📖 “But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you, and you will be my witnesses.” (Acts 1:8)

3️⃣ "I’ll share my faith later."
🚨 Truth: You are NOT promised tomorrow. Someone’s eternity depends on you speaking TODAY!
📖 “You do not know what tomorrow will bring.” (James 4:14)
🔥 Which of these lies has kept you silent? It’s time to break free and SPEAK UP!

🔥 [3. HOW TO BOLDLY SHARE YOUR FAITH]
🙌 Here’s how to break free from fear and start leading people to Jesus:

✅ 1. PRAY FOR COURAGE – The Holy Spirit will give you boldness!
📖 “For God gave us a spirit not of fear but of power and love and self-control.” (2 Timothy 1:7)

✅ 2. SHARE YOUR TESTIMONY – Your story is powerful!
📖 “They overcame him by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of their testimony.” (Revelation 12:11)

✅ 3. LIVE WHAT YOU PREACH – People are watching how you live.
📖 “Let your light shine before others, so that they may see your good works and give glory to your Father who is in heaven.” (Matthew 5:16)

✅ 4. START SIMPLE – Just Open the Conversation
Ask: “Do you believe in God?” or “Can I pray for you?”
📖 “Always be prepared to make a defense to anyone who asks you for a reason for the hope that is in you.” (1 Peter 3:15)
🔥 No more excuses—start TODAY!

🔥 THE EVANGELISM CHALLENGE 🔥
✅ Step 1: Share the Gospel with ONE person today!
✅ Step 2: Tag 3 friends who need to be encouraged to share Jesus.

📢 🚨 WARNING: The enemy does NOT want you to share this.
🔥 That’s exactly why you SHOULD!
📖 “Whoever acknowledges me before men, I will also acknowledge before my Father in heaven. But whoever denies me before men, I will also deny before my Father in heaven.” (Matthew 10:32-33)

🧐 QUESTION FOR YOU:
Who is one person in your life that needs to hear about Jesus?

🙏 PRAYER FOR JANUARY 20, 2025 🙏
Heavenly Father, I pray for boldness to rise up in every believer reading this. Remove the fear of man and fill us with Holy Spirit fire to share Your truth. Give us divine appointments to lead people to You. Open the hearts of those who need salvation and use us as Your messengers. May we never be silent about Jesus. In His mighty name, AMEN! 🙏🔥

title: "Why Keeping Jesus to Yourself is Selfish" 🔥
paragraphs:
"Why Keeping Jesus to Yourself is Selfish" 🔥
✝️ A Message from Brother John Domino "PiX" S. Asis – Follower of Jesus Christ and a Servant of God
🌍 Imagine this:
You discover the cure for cancer—a single pill that can save anyone’s life instantly.

Would you:
✅ Share it with the world, saving millions?
❌ Keep it to yourself and let people die?
🚨 If you chose to share it, then why are you keeping Jesus a secret?
Sin is the deadliest disease in the world, and Jesus is the only cure!
📖 “Let your light shine before others, that they may see your good deeds and glorify your Father in heaven.” (Matthew 5:16)
💡 If you truly love people, you will share Jesus with them.

🔥 The Greatest Tragedy: Knowing Jesus But Staying Silent
Many Christians say:

“I don’t want to offend anyone.”
“It’s not my place to judge.”
“What if they reject me?”
But the truth is: keeping Jesus to yourself is one of the most selfish things you can do.
📖 “For God has not given us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-discipline.” (2 Timothy 1:7)
💡 Fear is from the enemy—boldness is from God!

🔥 Why Are So Many Christians Silent?
1️⃣ Fear of Rejection
Many people worry, “What if they laugh at me? What if they don’t listen?”
But Jesus said:
📖 “If the world hates you, keep in mind that it hated Me first.” (John 15:18)
💡 People’s opinions don’t matter—eternity does!

2️⃣ Afraid of Not Knowing Enough
Some think, “I don’t know the Bible well enough to share.”
But you don’t need a theology degree—just share your testimony!
📖 “We proclaim Him, admonishing and teaching everyone with all wisdom.” (Colossians 1:28)
💡 Your story is powerful—no one can argue with your testimony!

3️⃣ Thinking Someone Else Will Do It
Many Christians believe, “That’s the pastor’s job.”
But Jesus gave the Great Commission to ALL believers, not just pastors!
📖 “Go into all the world and preach the Gospel to all creation.” (Mark 16:15)
💡 If you don’t share Jesus, who will?

🔥 What Happens If You Stay Silent?
🚨 People will die without Jesus.
Imagine your best friend or family member standing before God on Judgment Day.

They look at you and ask:
“You knew about Jesus… but never told me? Why?”
📖 “How can they believe in the one of whom they have not heard?” (Romans 10:14)
💡 Your silence could cost someone their eternity.

🔥 What Happens When You Share Jesus?
✅ People’s lives change.
✅ The lost find hope.
✅ You fulfill God’s calling.
📖 “Whoever acknowledges Me before others, I will also acknowledge before My Father in heaven.” (Matthew 10:32)
💡 Sharing Jesus brings joy, freedom, and eternal impact.

🔥 How to Boldly Share Jesus (Even If You’re Scared)
1️⃣ Start with Your Testimony

Share what Jesus has done in your life—that’s your most powerful tool!
📖 “They triumphed over him by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of their testimony.” (Revelation 12:11)
2️⃣ Use Social Media for Christ

If you can post about movies, food, and opinions, you can post about Jesus!
📖 “Go and make disciples of all nations.” (Matthew 28:19)
3️⃣ Pray for Boldness

The early church prayed for boldness—and they changed the world.
📖 “They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and spoke the word of God boldly.” (Acts 4:31)
4️⃣ Tell One Person About Jesus Today

Start with a friend, coworker, or family member.
📖 “Let your light shine before others.” (Matthew 5:16)
🚀 The more you share, the bolder you become!

📜 FAITH DECLARATION FOR JANUARY 18, 2025 📜
"Today, I choose to break my silence. I will boldly share my faith and point others to Jesus Christ. I will not let fear stop me from obeying God’s call to be a witness for Him."

🔥 THE “SHARE JESUS” CHALLENGE 🔥
✅ Step 1: Share your testimony with one person today.
✅ Step 2: Post a Bible verse or Gospel message on social media.
✅ Step 3: Tag 3 friends and encourage them to share their faith boldly.

🌌 YOU HAVE THE CURE – DON’T KEEP IT TO YOURSELF 🌌
📖 “The harvest is plentiful, but the workers are few.” (Matthew 9:37)
👉 Don’t let fear hold you back. Your boldness could change someone’s eternity.

🙏 PRAYER FOR JANUARY 18, 2025 🙏
Heavenly Father,
Forgive me for the times I’ve stayed silent when I should have spoken up about You. Give me boldness to share my faith, to proclaim Jesus in every area of my life, and to stand firm in a world that rejects the truth. Fill me with Your Holy Spirit and use me to bring others into Your Kingdom.
In Jesus’ name, Amen. ✝️

title: 🔥 "MILLIONS WILL VANISH! WILL YOU BE LEFT BEHIND?" 🚀🔥
paragraphs: 🔥 "MILLIONS WILL VANISH! WILL YOU BE LEFT BEHIND?" 🚀🔥

📖 1 Thessalonians 4:16-17 – "For the Lord Himself will descend from heaven with a cry of command, with the voice of an archangel, and with the sound of the trumpet of God. And the dead in Christ will rise first. Then we who are alive, who are left, will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air, and so we will always be with the Lord."

🚨 One day, in the blink of an eye, your family, your friends—GONE.
🚨 The world will call it ‘The Greatest Mystery of All Time’—but the Bible calls it THE RAPTURE.
The question is… will YOU still be here?

🔥 1. THE RAPTURE—A BIBLICAL FACT OR FICTION?
📖 Greek Word for "Caught Up" – ἁρπάζω (harpazō)
✅ Definition: To seize, snatch away, or take up forcefully.
🔥 The word "Rapture" comes from the Latin translation of 1 Thessalonians 4:17—"rapiemur", meaning "caught up."
📖 1 Thessalonians 4:17 – "Then we who are alive, who are left, will be caught up (ἁρπάζω) together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air."
🚨 YES! The Bible clearly teaches the Rapture—it’s NOT a man-made idea!

🔥 2. JESUS WARNED US ABOUT THIS EVENT!
📖 John 14:2-3 – "I go to prepare a place for you... I will come again and take you to Myself, that where I am you may be also."

🔥 Jesus promised to RETURN and TAKE His people home!
🔥 This is NOT the Second Coming, where He returns to earth—this is when He takes believers to heaven.
🚨 The Rapture and the Second Coming are TWO SEPARATE EVENTS!

🔥 3. THE RAPTURE WILL HAPPEN IN A SPLIT SECOND!
📖 1 Corinthians 15:51-52 – "Behold! I tell you a mystery. We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be changed, in a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet."

✅ The Rapture will be instantaneous!
✅ Millions will disappear in an instant!
✅ Those who are NOT ready will be left behind in horror!
🚨 It will happen when the world least expects it!

🔥 4. THE WORLD IS ALREADY BEING CONDITIONED FOR THE RAPTURE!
📖 2 Timothy 3:1-5 – "But understand this, that in the last days there will come times of difficulty. For people will be lovers of self, lovers of money... disobedient to parents, unholy, heartless, unappeasable, slanderous, without self-control, brutal, not loving good."

🔥 Look at the world today—chaos, rebellion, and deception are everywhere!
🔥 AI, digital IDs, and global surveillance are setting the stage for total control!
🔥 People are being desensitized to reject God and accept a one-world system!
🚨 The warning signs are here—JESUS IS COMING SOON!

🔥 5. WILL THE RAPTURE HAPPEN BEFORE, DURING, OR AFTER THE TRIBULATION?
There are three main views on the timing of the Rapture:

1️⃣ Pre-Tribulation Rapture (Before the Tribulation)
✅ Believers are taken up before the 7-year Tribulation begins.
✅ Supported by:
📖 Revelation 3:10 – "Because you have kept My word about patient endurance, I will keep you from the hour of trial that is coming on the whole world."
🔥 This view says Christians WILL NOT go through God's wrath.

2️⃣ Mid-Tribulation Rapture (Halfway Through the Tribulation)
✅ Believers go through the first 3.5 years of Tribulation.
✅ The Rapture happens before the Great Tribulation (last 3.5 years).
📖 Daniel 9:27 – "And he shall make a strong covenant with many for one week, and for half of the week he shall put an end to sacrifice and offering."
🔥 This view says Christians will experience some suffering before being raptured.

3️⃣ Post-Tribulation Rapture (After the Tribulation)
✅ Believers go through the entire 7-year Tribulation.
✅ The Rapture and Second Coming happen at the same time.
📖 Matthew 24:29-31 – "Immediately after the tribulation of those days... He will send out His angels with a loud trumpet call, and they will gather His elect."
🚨 WHICH ONE IS CORRECT?

👉 The Pre-Tribulation Rapture makes the most biblical sense because:
✅ The Church is not appointed to wrath (1 Thessalonians 5:9).
✅ God rescued Noah before the flood and Lot before Sodom was destroyed.
✅ Jesus said He will keep believers from the hour of trial (Revelation 3:10).
🚨 Regardless of the timing, we must be READY at all times!

🙏 POWERFUL PRAYER FOR READINESS
"Lord Jesus, I believe You are coming soon! I REFUSE to be left behind! Cleanse me, transform me, and fill me with Your Holy Spirit. I choose to live for You, no matter what! Strengthen me for the days ahead. Keep me watchful and faithful until the very end. I AM YOURS FOREVER! In Jesus' name, AMEN!" 🙏🔥

title: 🔥 "WHEN ADAM AND EVE SINNED, OUR RELATIONSHIP WITH GOD WAS BROKEN—ONLY JESUS CAN RESTORE IT!" 🚀🔥
paragraphs: 🔥 "WHEN ADAM AND EVE SINNED, OUR RELATIONSHIP WITH GOD WAS BROKEN—ONLY JESUS CAN RESTORE IT!" 🚀🔥
📖 Acts 4:12 – "Salvation is found in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven given to mankind by which we must be saved."

🚨 From the moment sin entered the world, the relationship between God and man was shattered.
🚨 Religion cannot restore it. Church membership cannot restore it. Good works cannot restore it.
🚨 ONLY JESUS can bridge the gap between sinful humanity and a holy God!
🔥 Today, we uncover the truth about mankind’s broken condition—and how ONLY Jesus can restore what was lost!

🔥 1. IN THE BEGINNING, MAN WALKED IN PERFECT RELATIONSHIP WITH GOD!
📖 Genesis 3:8 – "Then the man and his wife heard the sound of the Lord God as He was walking in the garden in the cool of the day."

🚨 Before sin, Adam and Eve had direct, unhindered fellowship with God.
✅ They walked with Him.
✅ They talked with Him.
✅ There was NO separation between God and man.
🔥 But that all changed the moment sin entered the world.

🔥 2. SIN BROKE OUR RELATIONSHIP WITH GOD!
📖 Isaiah 59:2 – "But your iniquities have separated you from your God; your sins have hidden His face from you so that He will not hear."

🚨 SIN CREATES SEPARATION!
❌ Adam and Eve were cast out of Eden.
❌ They lost direct access to God.
❌ Death, suffering, and spiritual blindness entered the world.
📖 Romans 3:23 – "For all have sinned and fall short of the glory of God."
🔥 Every human being since Adam has inherited this separation—no one is righteous on their own!
✅ But God had a plan from the beginning—a plan to RESTORE what was lost!

🔥 3. RELIGION CANNOT RESTORE OUR BROKEN RELATIONSHIP WITH GOD!
📖 Titus 3:5 – "He saved us, not because of righteous things we had done, but because of His mercy."

🚨 People try to fix the separation with religion, but religion is NOT the answer!
❌ Following church traditions won’t save you.
❌ Keeping religious rituals won’t save you.
❌ Trying to "be a good person" won’t restore your relationship with God.
🔥 Religion is man's attempt to reach God—but salvation is GOD reaching down to man!
✅ This is why Jesus came—not to create another religion, but to RESTORE what sin destroyed!

🔥 4. JESUS CAME TO RESTORE OUR RELATIONSHIP WITH GOD!
📖 John 14:6 – "Jesus said, ‘I am the Way, the Truth, and the Life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.’"
🚨 Jesus did NOT come to build a religion—He came to bring RESTORATION!

✅ He is the bridge between God and man! (1 Timothy 2:5)
✅ He bore our sins so we could be reconciled! (2 Corinthians 5:18-19)
✅ He tore the veil that separated us from God! (Matthew 27:51)
🔥 ONLY JESUS has the authority to restore what sin has broken—NOT religion, NOT good works, NOT church traditions!

🔥 5. NO OTHER NAME CAN SAVE YOU—ONLY JESUS!
📖 Acts 4:12 – "Salvation is found in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven given to mankind by which we must be saved."

🚨 There is NO OTHER WAY!
❌ Not Muhammad.
❌ Not Buddha.
❌ Not Mary.
❌ Not the Pope.
❌ Not your pastor.
🔥 JESUS ALONE is the Savior—He is the ONLY One who has the authority to restore our relationship with God!
📖 1 Timothy 2:5 – "For there is one God, and there is one mediator between God and mankind, the man Christ Jesus."
🔥 Are you trusting in Jesus alone, or are you still relying on religion?

🔥 6. HOW TO BE RESTORED TO GOD TODAY!
📖 Romans 10:9 – "If you declare with your mouth, ‘Jesus is Lord,’ and believe in your heart that God raised Him from the dead, you will be saved."
🚨 FOLLOW THESE STEPS TO RESTORE YOUR RELATIONSHIP WITH GOD:

✅ REPENT – Turn away from sin and surrender to Jesus! (Acts 3:19)
✅ BELIEVE – Trust in Jesus alone for salvation! (John 3:16)
✅ FOLLOW HIM – Build a daily relationship with God through prayer, worship, and obedience! (John 10:27)
🔥 You were created for relationship with God—don’t settle for empty religion!

🙏 POWERFUL PRAYER TO BE RESTORED TO GOD!
"Lord Jesus, I know that sin has separated me from You. I reject religion and self-righteousness, and I put my full trust in You alone! Forgive me, cleanse me, and restore me to the Father. I surrender my life completely to You! From this day forward, I will follow You and live in relationship with You. In Jesus’ name, AMEN!" 🙏🔥

title: 🔥 "THE DANGER OF LUKEWARM CHRISTIANS – WHY STAYING NEUTRAL WILL SEND YOU TO HELL!" 🚀🔥
paragraphs: 🔥 "THE DANGER OF LUKEWARM CHRISTIANS – WHY STAYING NEUTRAL WILL SEND YOU TO HELL!" 🚀🔥
📖 Revelation 3:16 – "So, because you are lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold, I will spit you out of My mouth."

🚨 Too many so-called Christians think they can be “neutral” when it comes to Jesus.
🚨 They go to church, but they don’t live for Christ.
🚨 They claim to love God, but they don’t obey His Word.
🚨 They think they are saved, but they are on the path to destruction!
🔥 Today, we expose the truth about lukewarm Christianity—why God HATES it and how it leads straight to hell!

🔥 1. GOD HATES LUKEWARM CHRISTIANS!
📖 Revelation 3:15-16 – "I know your works: you are neither cold nor hot. Would that you were either cold or hot! So, because you are lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold, I will spit you out of My mouth."

🚨 Jesus did NOT say He would reject the cold.
🚨 Jesus did NOT say He would reject the hot.
🚨 But He DID say He will REJECT THE LUKEWARM!
🔥 Being lukewarm is the most dangerous spiritual condition—because you think you’re fine, but you’re really lost!

✅ The cold KNOW they are far from God.
✅ The hot LIVE fully for God.
❌ The lukewarm are DECEIVED—they think they are saved, but Jesus will reject them!

📖 Matthew 7:22-23 – "Many will say to Me on that day, ‘Lord, Lord, did we not prophesy in Your name, and cast out demons in Your name, and do many mighty works in Your name?’ And then I will declare to them, ‘I never knew you; depart from Me, you workers of lawlessness.’"
🔥 Lukewarm Christianity is SELF-DECEPTION—it makes you believe you're saved when you're not!

🔥 2. SIGNS THAT YOU ARE A LUKEWARM CHRISTIAN!
📖 2 Timothy 3:5 – "Having a form of godliness but denying its power. Avoid such people."
🚨 If these describe you, WAKE UP—before it’s too late!

❌ You go to church, but you don’t live holy.
❌ You call yourself a Christian, but you love the world.
❌ You say you love Jesus, but you don’t obey Him.
❌ You pray when you need something, but ignore God the rest of the time.
❌ You claim to follow Christ, but you stay silent when evil rises.
📖 James 4:4 – "Do you not know that friendship with the world is enmity with God? Therefore whoever wishes to be a friend of the world makes himself an enemy of God."
🔥 Lukewarm Christians love Jesus with their lips but deny Him with their lifestyle!

🔥 3. STAYING NEUTRAL MEANS YOU STAND WITH SATAN!
📖 Matthew 12:30 – "Whoever is not with Me is against Me, and whoever does not gather with Me scatters."
🚨 There is NO neutral ground in spiritual warfare!

❌ If you are not actively serving Jesus, you are against Him!
❌ If you are not fighting against sin, you are tolerating it!
❌ If you are not standing for truth, you are allowing lies to spread!
🔥 SATAN LOVES LUKEWARM CHRISTIANS BECAUSE THEY DON’T FIGHT BACK!
📖 John 8:44 – "You are of your father the devil, and your will is to do your father’s desires."
🚨 If Jesus is not your Lord, then Satan is ruling over you—whether you realize it or not!
🔥 You cannot be neutral in a war—if you don’t pick a side, the enemy will claim you!

🔥 4. HOW TO ESCAPE THE TRAP OF LUKEWARMNESS!
📖 Romans 12:11 – "Never be lacking in zeal, but keep your spiritual fervor, serving the Lord."
🚨 If you are lukewarm, you must act NOW before it’s too late!

✅ REPENT! – Confess your spiritual laziness and turn back to God! (Acts 3:19)
✅ GET SERIOUS ABOUT GOD! – Stop treating Christianity as a hobby—it’s life or death! (Luke 9:23)
✅ CUT OFF WORLDLINESS! – Stop compromising and letting sin rule your life! (Colossians 3:5)
✅ LIVE BOLDLY FOR CHRIST! – Preach the gospel, stand for truth, and live in obedience! (2 Timothy 1:7)
📖 Luke 9:62 – "No one who puts his hand to the plow and looks back is fit for the kingdom of God."
🔥 You must CHOOSE—will you live for Jesus 100%, or will you be rejected as lukewarm?

🙏 POWERFUL PRAYER TO ESCAPE LUKEWARMNESS!
"Lord Jesus, I refuse to be lukewarm! Forgive me for my compromise, my silence, and my worldly lifestyle. I repent and choose to serve You with ALL my heart! Set me on fire for You, and remove all spiritual laziness from my life! From this day forward, I will live for You completely—no more halfway commitment! In Jesus’ name, AMEN!" 🙏🔥

title: 🔥 "JUDGE NOT" – DOES THIS MEAN CHRISTIANS SHOULD NEVER CORRECT OTHERS? (MATTHEW 7:1) 🚀🔥
paragraphs: 🔥 "JUDGE NOT" – DOES THIS MEAN CHRISTIANS SHOULD NEVER CORRECT OTHERS? (MATTHEW 7:1) 🚀🔥
📖 Matthew 7:1 – "Judge not, that you be not judged."
One of the most misused verses in the Bible is Matthew 7:1. Many people—especially non-believers and lukewarm Christians—use this verse to say:

❌ "You can’t judge me!"
❌ "Only God can judge!"
❌ "Jesus said not to judge, so don’t correct my lifestyle!"
🚨 But is that really what Jesus meant? Does this verse mean Christians should NEVER correct others? Let’s dive into Scripture and find out!

🔥 1. WHAT DOES "JUDGE NOT" MEAN IN THE ORIGINAL GREEK?
To understand what Jesus really meant, let’s look at the original Greek word for "judge."
📖 Greek: κρίνω (krinó) – "to judge, condemn, or pass final judgment."

👉 The word "krinó" has two meanings in Scripture:
✅ Righteous judgment – Discerning right from wrong and holding people accountable.
❌ Condemning judgment – Acting as if you are God, declaring someone beyond hope or salvation.
🚨 Jesus was warning against hypocritical, condemning judgment—not righteous correction!

🔥 2. JESUS COMMANDS US TO JUDGE RIGHTEOUSLY!
📖 John 7:24 – "Do not judge by appearances, but judge with righteous judgment."

✅ Jesus didn’t say ‘Do not judge at all’—He said to judge righteously!
✅ We must judge actions, teachings, and behavior according to God’s Word.

📖 1 Corinthians 2:15 – "The spiritual person judges all things, but is himself to be judged by no one."
✅ A true believer uses discernment to judge what is right and wrong.

📖 Ephesians 5:11 – "Take no part in the unfruitful works of darkness, but rather expose them."
✅ We are commanded to expose sin and false teachings.
🚨 If we never judge, we cannot warn people about sin, deception, or the need for repentance!

🔥 3. JESUS REBUKED HYPOCRISY, NOT RIGHHTEOUS CORRECTION!
📖 Matthew 7:3-5 – "Why do you see the speck that is in your brother’s eye, but do not notice the log in your own eye? … First take the log out of your own eye, and then you will see clearly to take the speck out of your brother’s eye."

✅ Jesus is NOT saying "never judge." He is saying, "First fix your own sin before correcting others!"
✅ After we repent of our own sins, we CAN help others remove their "speck."
🚨 Jesus was rebuking hypocrisy, NOT righteous correction!

🔥 4. BIBLICAL EXAMPLES OF JUDGING RIGHTEOUSLY
✅ Paul judged and corrected the church.
📖 1 Corinthians 5:12 – "For what have I to do with judging outsiders? Is it not those inside the church whom you are to judge?"
👉 Paul says believers MUST judge those inside the church who are living in sin.

✅ Jesus judged and rebuked false teachers.
📖 Matthew 23:27 – "Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like whitewashed tombs."
👉 Jesus publicly exposed the hypocrisy of the religious leaders.

✅ The apostles judged false doctrine.
📖 Galatians 1:9 – "If anyone preaches a gospel contrary to the one you received, let him be accursed."
👉 Paul pronounced judgment on false teachers!
🚨 If we don’t judge false teachings, sin, or deception, we allow Satan to spread lies unchecked!

🔥 5. HOW SHOULD CHRISTIANS JUDGE? (BIBLICAL DISCERNMENT)
📖 Galatians 6:1 – "If anyone is caught in any transgression, you who are spiritual should restore him in a spirit of gentleness."

✅ We must judge with humility and love, not arrogance or pride.
✅ We must correct with the goal of restoring, not condemning.
✅ We must judge based on God’s Word, not personal opinions.
🚨 We should never judge hypocritically, but we MUST judge righteously!

🔥 FINAL CONCLUSION: CHRISTIANS MUST JUDGE RIGHTEOUSLY!
✅ Jesus did NOT say "never judge"—He said "judge righteously" (John 7:24).
✅ We must correct sin and expose false teaching with truth and love.
✅ Hypocritical judgment is wrong, but biblical discernment is necessary.
✅ If we never judge, we allow sin and deception to spread freely!
🚨 STOP USING "JUDGE NOT" TO JUSTIFY SIN! JESUS COMMANDS RIGHTEOUS JUDGMENT!

✅ 👍 CLICK LIKE if this teaching blessed you!
✅ ❤️ CLICK HEART if you believe in righteous judgment!
✅ 🚀 CLICK SHARE to expose the false use of "judge not" and spread biblical truth!
📢 🚨 WARNING: Many people twist Matthew 7:1 to silence Christians. SHARE THIS NOW to bring clarity and expose deception!

🙏 PRAYER FOR TODAY
Heavenly Father, give me discernment to judge righteously according to Your Word. Help me to correct others in love and truth, without hypocrisy or pride. Keep me from being deceived by false teachings that misuse Scripture. Let me stand boldly for righteousness. In Jesus’ name, AMEN! 🙏🔥

title: "The LA Fire Was Devastating – But What About the Eternal Fire?" 🔥
paragraphs:
"The LA Fire Was Devastating – But What About the Eternal Fire?" 🔥
✝️ A Message from Brother John Domino "PiX" S. Asis – Follower of Jesus Christ and a Servant of God
🌍 The world was shaken by the devastating Los Angeles fire this week.

Hundreds of homes destroyed.
Families displaced.
Lives tragically lost.
The flames were unstoppable, consuming everything in their path. It was a horrifying reminder of how fragile life can be. But as tragic as this disaster is, it serves as a wake-up call for something far worse—the fire of eternal separation from God.
👉 If the physical flames caused so much fear… imagine the eternal fire Jesus warned us about.
📖 “If anyone’s name was not found written in the Book of Life, he was thrown into the lake of fire.” (Revelation 20:15)

🔥 Earthly Fires vs. The Eternal Fire – What Does the Bible Say?
The LA fire destroyed property. But the eternal fire described in Scripture deals with souls.
Key Differences:

🌍 Earthly Fire (Temporary)
Lasts for a time, then burns out.
Destroys buildings, possessions, and bodies.
Can be extinguished by human efforts.
🔥 Eternal Fire (Forever)
Never stops burning.
A place of separation from God’s presence.
Reserved for those who reject Jesus Christ.
No human can extinguish it—only faith in Jesus saves.
📖 “Their worm does not die, and the fire is not quenched.” (Mark 9:48)

🔥 Why Does the Bible Speak About Eternal Fire?
Many avoid this topic because it feels uncomfortable—but truth can’t be sugarcoated.

🔥 Jesus Himself warned about hell more than anyone else in Scripture.
🔥 Why? Because He came to save us from it!
📖 “For God did not send His Son into the world to condemn the world, but to save the world through Him.” (John 3:17)
👉 Hell isn’t a place where God sends good people—it’s where unrepentant sinners choose to go by rejecting Jesus.

🔥 Who Will Face the Eternal Fire?
The Bible is clear:
Not just "bad people."
Not just criminals.
But ALL who reject Jesus Christ.
📖 “All have sinned and fall short of the glory of God.” (Romans 3:23)

🔥 The Good News: Jesus Paid the Price So You Don’t Have To!
Here’s the powerful truth:

✅ You don’t have to face this eternal fire.
✅ Jesus took your punishment on the cross.
✅ He paid the FULL PRICE for your sins.
📖 “But God demonstrates His own love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us.” (Romans 5:8)

✅ When you trust in Jesus, the punishment you deserve is removed.
✅ Your name is written in the Book of Life.
📖 “Therefore, there is now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus.” (Romans 8:1)

🔥 What Must You Do to Be Saved?
You cannot save yourself. Being a good person won’t erase your sin.

title: "The Devil Doesn’t Need You to Worship Him—He Just Needs You Distracted." 🔥
paragraphs: "The Devil Doesn’t Need You to Worship Him—He Just Needs You Distracted." 🔥

🔥 SATAN DOESN’T NEED YOU TO BOW TO HIM… HE JUST NEEDS YOU TO IGNORE GOD.
📱 He doesn’t need you to be a Satanist. He just needs you too busy for Jesus.
⏳ He doesn’t need you to curse God. He just needs you distracted.
🚨 How many people are heading to hell… not because they hated God, but because they IGNORED Him?
📖 "Be sober-minded; be watchful. Your adversary the devil prowls around like a roaring lion, seeking someone to devour." (1 Peter 5:8)

⚠️ Satan isn’t always a monster in the shadows—he’s the voice that says, ‘I’ll read my Bible later.’
🔥 He’s the distraction keeping you from prayer.
🔥 He’s the endless entertainment keeping you spiritually asleep.
🚨 WAKE UP! Before it’s too late.

🔥 1. SATAN’S STRATEGY: KEEP YOU DISTRACTED UNTIL IT’S TOO LATE
📖 "Awake, O sleeper, and arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you!" (Ephesians 5:14)
The devil doesn’t need to convince you to reject God—he just needs to keep you “too busy” for Him.
🚨 Here’s how distraction is leading MILLIONS away from God:

📱 ENDLESS ENTERTAINMENT – Netflix, social media, YouTube, video games… anything to keep you from opening your Bible.
💰 THE PURSUIT OF MONEY – Too busy chasing success to seek God.
💀 SIN THAT NUMBS YOUR CONSCIENCE – You keep saying “I’ll repent later,” but later never comes.
🛑 SPIRITUAL LAZINESS – You believe in Jesus, but you don’t truly follow Him.
🔥 Hell will be full of people who simply ‘never had time’ for God.
📖 "For what does it profit a man to gain the whole world and forfeit his soul?" (Mark 8:36)

🔥 2. THE LIES SATAN TELLS TO KEEP YOU DISTRACTED
📖 "And no wonder, for even Satan disguises himself as an angel of light." (2 Corinthians 11:14)
💀 SATAN’S LIES THAT KEEP PEOPLE FROM SALVATION:

1️⃣ "I have plenty of time."
🚨 Truth: You are NOT promised tomorrow. Death can come at ANY moment.
📖 "You do not know what tomorrow will bring." (James 4:14)

2️⃣ "It’s just entertainment—it’s not affecting me."
🚨 Truth: What you consume shapes your spirit.
📖 "Do not be deceived: ‘Bad company corrupts good morals.’" (1 Corinthians 15:33)

3️⃣ "As long as I believe in God, I’ll be fine."
🚨 Truth: Even demons believe in God—belief is not enough!
📖 "You believe that God is one; you do well. Even the demons believe—and shudder!" (James 2:19)

4️⃣ "I’ll get serious about God later."
🚨 Truth: Many who said this are in hell right now.
📖 "Seek the Lord while He may be found; call upon Him while He is near." (Isaiah 55:6)
🔥 WHICH OF THESE LIES HAVE YOU BELIEVED? IT’S TIME TO WAKE UP!

🔥 3. HOW TO BREAK FREE FROM DISTRACTION AND FOCUS ON GOD
📖 "But seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness." (Matthew 6:33)
🚀 It’s time to shut down distractions and return to Jesus. Here’s how:

✅ 1. Set a DAILY time for prayer and Bible reading.
📖 "Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path." (Psalm 119:105)

✅ 2. Remove or limit distractions that pull you away from God.
📖 "Lay aside every weight, and sin which clings so closely." (Hebrews 12:1)

✅ 3. Surround yourself with people who push you toward Christ.
📖 "Iron sharpens iron, and one man sharpens another." (Proverbs 27:17)

✅ 4. Share the Gospel boldly—don’t keep silent!
📖 "Go into all the world and proclaim the gospel." (Mark 16:15)
🔥 TODAY is the day to get serious about Jesus! Are you ready?

✅ 👍 CLICK LIKE if you refuse to be spiritually asleep!
✅ ❤️ CLICK HEART if you commit to seeking God first!
✅ 🚀 CLICK SHARE to wake others up before it’s too late!

🔥 THE SPIRITUAL WAKE-UP CHALLENGE 🔥
✅ Step 1: Examine your life—what distractions are keeping you from God? Remove them!
✅ Step 2: Tag 3 friends who need to hear this urgent wake-up call!

📢 🚨 WARNING: The enemy does NOT want you to share this.
🔥 That’s exactly why you SHOULD!

🙏 PRAYER FOR JANUARY 21, 2025 🙏
Heavenly Father, I ask You to open my eyes to the distractions keeping me from You. The enemy is working hard to steal my time, my focus, and my devotion, but today, I say NO MORE! I choose to seek You first. I choose to walk in holiness. I choose to make You my priority. Give me the strength to overcome temptation and stay focused on eternity. In Jesus’ name, AMEN! 🙏🔥

title: 🔥 "HELL IS REAL—WHY ARE MOST CHURCHES AFRAID TO PREACH IT?" 🚀🔥
paragraphs: 🔥 "HELL IS REAL—WHY ARE MOST CHURCHES AFRAID TO PREACH IT?" 🚀🔥
📖 Luke 16:23 – "In Hades, being in torment, he lifted up his eyes and saw Abraham far off and Lazarus at his side."

🚨 Hell is real. Jesus warned about it more than anyone else in the Bible.
🚨 So why are most churches silent about it?

🔥 Today, we expose the truth that many pastors won’t preach!
🔥 Are you ready to hear the hard truth?

🔥 1. JESUS PREACHED ABOUT HELL MORE THAN HEAVEN!
📖 Matthew 10:28 – "And do not fear those who kill the body but cannot kill the soul. Rather fear Him who can destroy both soul and body in hell."
🚨 FACT: Jesus spoke about hell more than heaven.

✅ He described it as a place of fire, torment, and eternal punishment.
✅ He warned people repeatedly to repent before it was too late.
✅ But today, many churches act like hell doesn’t exist!
🔥 If Jesus preached about hell, why is the modern church avoiding it?

🔥 2. MOST CHURCHES WON’T PREACH ABOUT HELL—HERE’S WHY!
🚨 REASON #1: It’s "Too Negative"
❌ Many pastors want to preach only love, blessings, and prosperity.
❌ They avoid messages that might offend people or make them uncomfortable.
📖 2 Timothy 4:3 – "For the time will come when people will not endure sound teaching, but having itching ears, they will accumulate for themselves teachers to suit their own passions."
🔥 But the gospel is NOT about making people comfortable—it’s about saving them!

🚨 REASON #2: Fear of Losing Members & Money
❌ Many churches operate like businesses—they don’t want to "scare people away."
❌ If they preach on hell, people might leave, and donations might drop.
📖 Galatians 1:10 – "For am I now seeking the approval of man, or of God? If I were still trying to please man, I would not be a servant of Christ."
🔥 A true pastor preaches the truth, even if it costs him everything!

🚨 REASON #3: False Doctrines Have Crept Into the Church
❌ Some churches now teach "Hell is not real" or "A loving God wouldn’t send people to hell."
❌ Others teach "Everyone goes to heaven" (Universalism)—a doctrine straight from Satan!
📖 2 Corinthians 11:14-15 – "And no wonder, for even Satan disguises himself as an angel of light. So it is no surprise if his servants, also, disguise themselves as servants of righteousness."
🔥 The greatest lie of the devil is convincing people that hell doesn’t exist!

🔥 3. WHAT DOES THE BIBLE SAY ABOUT HELL?
📖 Mark 9:43 – "And if your hand causes you to sin, cut it off. It is better for you to enter life crippled than with two hands to go to hell, to the unquenchable fire."

🚨 HELL IS:
🔥 A place of fire that never goes out (Mark 9:48)
🔥 A place of weeping and gnashing of teeth (Matthew 13:50)
🔥 A place of eternal separation from God (2 Thessalonians 1:9)
🔥 A place where there is no second chance (Hebrews 9:27)
🔥 Hell is NOT just a metaphor. It is a real, eternal place of suffering!

🔥 4. WHO GOES TO HELL?
📖 Revelation 21:8 – "But the cowardly, the unbelieving, the vile, the murderers, the sexually immoral, those who practice magic arts, the idolaters and all liars—they will be consigned to the fiery lake of burning sulfur. This is the second death."

🚨 HELL IS FOR:
❌ Those who reject Jesus Christ (John 3:18)
❌ Those who die in their sins without repentance (Luke 13:3)
❌ Those who practice wickedness and rebellion against God (Galatians 5:19-21)
🔥 Hell is not for "bad people"—it is for ALL who reject salvation through Jesus!

🔥 5. HOW TO ESCAPE HELL BEFORE IT’S TOO LATE!
📖 John 14:6 – "Jesus said, ‘I am the way, and the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.’"
🚨 The ONLY way to escape hell is through JESUS CHRIST!

✅ Repent of your sins! (Acts 3:19)
✅ Believe in Jesus as Lord and Savior! (Romans 10:9)
✅ Live a holy life, obeying God’s Word! (Hebrews 12:14)
🔥 Hell is forever—but Jesus offers eternal life!

🙏 POWERFUL PRAYER OF REPENTANCE & SALVATION
"Lord Jesus, I refuse to be deceived! I believe that hell is real, and I do not want to go there. I repent of my sins and surrender my life to You! Cleanse me, transform me, and make me Your child. From this moment, I will follow You completely! Thank You for saving me. In Jesus’ name, AMEN!" 🙏🔥

title: 🔥 SATAN DOESN’T NEED YOU TO DENY GOD—HE JUST NEEDS YOU TO COMPROMISE! 🚨🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 SATAN DOESN’T NEED YOU TO DENY GOD—HE JUST NEEDS YOU TO COMPROMISE! 🚨🔥
📖 Revelation 3:16 – "Because you are lukewarm—neither hot nor cold—I will spit you out of My mouth."
🚨 Satan doesn’t need you to say, "I reject God." He just needs you to say, "I believe in Jesus"—but still live like the world!

🔥 THE WORLD SAYS: "It’s okay to be Christian, just don’t be too extreme about it!"
🔥 THE BIBLE SAYS: "Do not conform to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind." (Romans 12:2)
👉 Are you truly surrendered to Christ, or are you living with one foot in the world and one foot in the church?

🔥 1. COMPROMISE IS SATAN’S SECRET WEAPON!
📖 James 4:4 – "Anyone who chooses to be a friend of the world becomes an enemy of God."

🔥 SATAN DOESN’T NEED YOU TO STOP BELIEVING—JUST TO START COMPROMISING!
❌ He doesn’t say, "Don’t read your Bible"—he says, "Read it later, you’re busy."
❌ He doesn’t say, "Don’t go to church"—he says, "Go, but don’t take it too seriously."
❌ He doesn’t say, "Sin is good"—he says, "It’s not that bad, everyone does it!"
🚨 IF THE DEVIL CAN GET YOU TO COMPROMISE, HE CAN GET YOU TO FALL!

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A man started watching shows filled with immorality, telling himself, "It’s just entertainment." Over time, he became numb to sin and started tolerating things he once stood against.
📖 Galatians 5:9 – "A little leaven leavens the whole lump."
👉 A LITTLE SIN CAN LEAD TO A BIG FALL!

🔥 2. SATAN WANTS "HALF-CHRISTIANS" WHO STILL LOVE THE WORLD!
📖 1 John 2:15 – "Do not love the world or the things in the world."

🔥 SATAN LOVES "CHRISTIANS" WHO:
❌ Watch movies that glorify sin but say, "It’s just entertainment."
❌ Date unbelievers but say, "I can change them!"
❌ Stay silent about Jesus but say, "Faith is personal."
🚨 PARTIAL OBEDIENCE IS STILL DISOBEDIENCE!

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A woman wanted to serve God but refused to give up an ungodly relationship. She said, "God understands." Eventually, she drifted away from Christ altogether.
📖 Matthew 6:24 – "No one can serve two masters."
👉 ARE YOU TRYING TO SERVE JESUS AND STILL LIVE LIKE THE WORLD? IT WON’T WORK!

🔥 3. COMPROMISE LEADS TO SPIRITUAL BLINDNESS!
📖 2 Timothy 3:5 – "Having a form of godliness but denying its power."

🔥 THE DANGER OF COMPROMISE:
❌ Your heart hardens to sin.
❌ You start making excuses for disobedience.
❌ You feel "comfortable" in lukewarm Christianity.
🚨 BEFORE YOU KNOW IT, YOU’RE A CHRISTIAN IN NAME ONLY!

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
Many churches today avoid preaching about sin because they don’t want to offend people. Instead, they preach a "comfortable gospel" that requires no repentance.
📖 Isaiah 30:10 – "Tell us pleasant things, prophesy illusions."
👉 DON’T SETTLE FOR A WATERED-DOWN FAITH THAT CANNOT SAVE YOU!

🔥 4. THE CHURCHES OF COMPROMISE—A SIGN OF THE END TIMES!
📖 2 Timothy 4:3 – "The time will come when people will not put up with sound doctrine."

🔥 TODAY’S CHURCHES ARE FILLED WITH COMPROMISE:
❌ Pastors afraid to preach against sin.
❌ Churches more focused on entertainment than discipleship.
❌ Believers choosing comfort over holiness.
🚨 A COMPROMISED CHURCH CANNOT STAND AGAINST A COMPROMISED WORLD!

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
Some churches now say "Jesus accepts everyone just as they are"—but they NEVER mention repentance!
📖 Luke 13:3 – "Unless you repent, you will all likewise perish."
👉 A CHURCH THAT REFUSES TO PREACH REPENTANCE IS LEADING PEOPLE TO HELL!

🔥 5. WHAT MUST YOU DO? BREAK FREE FROM COMPROMISE!
📖 Romans 12:1 – "Offer your bodies as a living sacrifice, holy and pleasing to God."

🔥 HOW TO ESCAPE SATAN’S TRAP:
✅ BE SET APART—Stop blending in with the world! (2 Corinthians 6:17)
✅ LIVE HOLY—Choose obedience over comfort! (1 Peter 1:16)
✅ BE BOLD—Speak the truth, even when it’s unpopular! (Ephesians 6:19)
✅ REPENT—Turn away from every area of compromise! (Acts 3:19)
🚨 JESUS IS COMING BACK FOR A HOLY BRIDE—NOT A COMPROMISED ONE!
📖 Revelation 19:7 – "For the marriage of the Lamb has come, and His bride has made herself ready."
🔥 MAKE SURE YOU’RE READY! NO MORE COMPROMISE!

🙏 POWERFUL PRAYER TO STAND FIRM IN HOLINESS!
"Lord Jesus, expose every area of compromise in my life. Give me the strength to stand firm and never trade my faith for the world’s approval. Set me apart, purify my heart, and fill me with boldness to live fully for You. In Jesus’ name, AMEN!" 🙏🔥

title: 🔥 "WHO HAS THE FINAL AUTHORITY: THE BIBLE, THE CHURCH, OR RELIGIOUS LEADERS?" 🚀🔥
paragraphs: 🔥 "WHO HAS THE FINAL AUTHORITY: THE BIBLE, THE CHURCH, OR RELIGIOUS LEADERS?" 🚀🔥

📖 2 Timothy 3:16-17 – "All Scripture is breathed out by God and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for training in righteousness, that the man of God may be complete, equipped for every good work."

🚨 Who has the FINAL authority over our faith?
🚨 Is it the Bible, the church, the priest, or the pastor?
🚨 Can religious leaders override God’s Word?
🔥 Today, we expose the truth about spiritual authority—what the Bible actually teaches!

🔥 1. ONLY GOD HAS ABSOLUTE AUTHORITY!
📖 Psalm 103:19 – "The Lord has established His throne in the heavens, and His kingdom rules over all."
🚨 No human institution, leader, or tradition has ultimate power—ONLY GOD!

✅ God is the Creator—He alone rules over everything! (Genesis 1:1)
✅ God’s Word is eternal—it will never change! (Matthew 24:35)
✅ God’s commands are final—no man can override them! (Isaiah 40:8)
🔥 If God alone is the supreme authority, then where do we find His commands?
✅ In the BIBLE—His written, infallible, unchangeable Word!

🔥 2. THE BIBLE IS THE FINAL AUTHORITY—NOT THE CHURCH!
📖 Sola Scriptura – "Scripture Alone"
📖 2 Timothy 3:16 – "All Scripture is breathed out by God."
🚨 The Bible is the ONLY infallible source of truth!

🔥 WHAT THE BIBLE SAYS ABOUT ITSELF:
✅ It is God-breathed. (2 Timothy 3:16)
✅ It is unchanging. (Isaiah 40:8)
✅ It is the ultimate standard for doctrine. (Acts 17:11)
🚨 Many churches claim THEY have final authority over believers—but is this biblical?

🔥 RELIGION CANNOT OVERRIDE GOD’S WORD!
❌ The Catholic Church claims authority over Scripture.
❌ Many cults claim new "revelations" that contradict the Bible.
❌ Some pastors twist Scripture to serve their own agenda.
📖 Mark 7:7-8 – "In vain do they worship Me, teaching as doctrines the commandments of men. You leave the commandment of God and hold to the tradition of men."
🔥 NO CHURCH has the right to change, add to, or replace God’s Word!
✅ The Bible ALONE is the ultimate authority for Christian faith and practice!

🔥 3. RELIGIOUS LEADERS MUST SUBMIT TO SCRIPTURE—NOT RULE OVER IT!
📖 Acts 17:11 – "Now these Jews were more noble than those in Thessalonica; they received the word with all eagerness, examining the Scriptures daily to see if these things were so."
🚨 Should we blindly follow pastors, priests, or religious leaders?
🔥 NO! The Bible COMMANDS us to test everything!

❌ Not all pastors preach the truth. (2 Timothy 4:3-4)
❌ False teachers exist even in the church. (2 Peter 2:1)
❌ Even the Apostle Paul told people to TEST HIS TEACHINGS against Scripture! (Acts 17:11)
🚨 WARNING! If a pastor, priest, or religious leader contradicts the Bible—THEY ARE WRONG!
📖 Galatians 1:8 – "Even if we or an angel from heaven should preach to you a gospel contrary to the one we preached to you, let him be accursed!"
🔥 Pastors are called to teach the Bible—not replace it!
✅ Spiritual leaders must SUBMIT to God’s Word, not rule over it!

🔥 4. FINAL AUTHORITY BELONGS TO SCRIPTURE ALONE!
📖 Isaiah 8:20 – "To the law and to the testimony! If they do not speak according to this word, it is because there is no light in them."

🚨 THE HIERARCHY OF AUTHORITY:
✅ GOD – The Supreme Ruler of all.
✅ THE BIBLE – The unchanging, God-breathed Word.
✅ THE CHURCH – Must be subject to the Bible.
✅ PASTORS & PRIESTS – Must teach only what is in the Bible.
🔥 If a church or religious leader contradicts Scripture—FOLLOW GOD, NOT MAN!
📖 Acts 5:29 – "We must obey God rather than men."

🔥 5. HOW TO STAY ROOTED IN GOD’S AUTHORITY!
📖 John 8:31-32 – "If you abide in My word, you are truly My disciples, and you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free."
🚨 FOLLOW THESE BIBLICAL COMMANDS TO STAY UNDER GOD’S AUTHORITY!

✅ READ THE BIBLE DAILY! (Psalm 119:105)
✅ TEST ALL TEACHINGS AGAINST SCRIPTURE! (1 John 4:1)
✅ NEVER FOLLOW MAN OVER GOD! (Acts 5:29)
✅ OBEY GOD’S WORD, NOT HUMAN TRADITIONS! (Mark 7:8)
🔥 YOUR FINAL AUTHORITY IS GOD’S WORD—DON’T LET ANYONE REPLACE IT!

🙏 POWERFUL PRAYER TO SUBMIT TO GOD’S WORD!
"Lord Jesus, I submit to Your Word alone! I reject false teachings, human traditions, and anything that contradicts Scripture. Give me wisdom to discern truth and the boldness to stand firm in Your Word. I will follow You alone, no matter what! In Jesus’ name, AMEN!" 🙏🔥

title: 🔥 "THE 5 SOLAS: THE UNBREAKABLE FOUNDATIONS OF TRUE CHRISTIANITY!" 🚀🔥
paragraphs: 🔥 "THE 5 SOLAS: THE UNBREAKABLE FOUNDATIONS OF TRUE CHRISTIANITY!" 🚀🔥
📖 Ephesians 2:8-9 – "For by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God, not of works, lest anyone should boast."

🚨 What separates TRUE Christianity from false religion?
🚨 Why did the Protestant Reformation fight for these five biblical truths?
🚨 Are you standing on the SOLID foundation of God’s Word—or sinking in human traditions?
🔥 Today, we will expose the power of the 5 SOLAS—the unshakable pillars of biblical Christianity!

🔥 1. SOLA SCRIPTURA (SCRIPTURE ALONE) – THE FINAL AUTHORITY!
📖 2 Timothy 3:16-17 – "All Scripture is breathed out by God and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for training in righteousness."
🚨 Truth: The Bible alone is the FINAL authority in all matters of faith and practice.

❌ NOT traditions.
❌ NOT church leaders.
❌ NOT human opinions.
🔥 God’s Word is ABOVE all man-made doctrines!
📖 Matthew 15:9 – "In vain do they worship Me, teaching as doctrines the commandments of men."
✅ If ANY teaching contradicts the Bible, it is FALSE!
🔥 God’s Word is the foundation of TRUTH—don’t trade it for man’s opinions!

🔥 2. SOLA FIDE (FAITH ALONE) – WE ARE JUSTIFIED BY FAITH, NOT WORKS!
📖 Romans 3:28 – "For we hold that one is justified by faith apart from works of the law."
🚨 Salvation is NOT earned by good deeds, sacraments, or religious rituals.

❌ No amount of church attendance can save you.
❌ No amount of good works can justify you.
❌ No priest or pastor can guarantee your salvation.
🔥 We are saved by FAITH in Christ alone—no human effort can add to it!
📖 Galatians 2:16 – "A person is not justified by works of the law but through faith in Jesus Christ."
✅ Salvation is a GIFT from God—receive it by FAITH!
🔥 Do you truly trust Jesus, or are you still trying to EARN your way into heaven?

🔥 3. SOLA GRATIA (GRACE ALONE) – SALVATION IS 100% GOD’S GIFT!
📖 Ephesians 2:8-9 – "For by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God, not of works, lest anyone should boast."
🚨 GRACE means unearned favor—salvation is not a reward, it’s a gift!
🔥 We don’t deserve heaven—BUT GOD!

❌ We were dead in sin, but God gave us LIFE! (Ephesians 2:1-5)
❌ We were enemies of God, but He made us His children! (Romans 5:10)
❌ We were headed for hell, but Jesus paid the price! (Colossians 2:14)
🔥 You CANNOT earn grace—it’s 100% God’s mercy!
✅ Every other religion says, "DO!"—but Christianity says, "DONE!"
🔥 Are you resting in God’s grace, or are you still trying to work for salvation?

🔥 4. SOLUS CHRISTUS (CHRIST ALONE) – JESUS IS THE ONLY WAY!
📖 John 14:6 – "Jesus said to him, ‘I am the Way, and the Truth, and the Life. No one comes to the Father except through Me.’"
🚨 There is NO other way to God except through Jesus!

❌ Not Mary.
❌ Not saints.
❌ Not religion.
❌ Not priests or pastors.
🔥 ONLY JESUS!
📖 Acts 4:12 – "And there is salvation in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven given among men by which we must be saved."
✅ Jesus is the ONE and ONLY mediator between God and man! (1 Timothy 2:5)
🔥 Are you trusting in Jesus alone—or are you adding human mediators?

🔥 5. SOLI DEO GLORIA (GLORY TO GOD ALONE) – ALL GLORY BELONGS TO GOD!
📖 1 Corinthians 10:31 – "So, whether you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God."
🚨 Our lives exist for ONE purpose—GOD’S GLORY!

🔥 Salvation is for God’s glory, not ours!
🔥 Good works are for God’s glory, not ours!
🔥 Our worship is for God’s glory, not religious leaders!
📖 Isaiah 42:8 – "I am the Lord; that is My name! My glory I give to no other."
✅ We are saved to glorify God—not to elevate ourselves!
🔥 Are you living for God’s glory, or are you still living for yourself?

🙏 POWERFUL PRAYER TO STAND ON GOD’S TRUTH
"Lord Jesus, I stand on YOUR Word alone! I reject human traditions, false doctrines, and self-righteousness. I believe that I am saved by grace alone, through faith alone, in Christ alone, for the glory of God alone! Strengthen my faith and help me live boldly for Your truth. In Jesus’ name, AMEN!" 🙏🔥

title: 🔥 "I AND THE FATHER ARE ONE" – DOES THIS MEAN JESUS IS THE FATHER? (JOHN 10:30) 🚀🔥
paragraphs: 🔥 "I AND THE FATHER ARE ONE" – DOES THIS MEAN JESUS IS THE FATHER? (JOHN 10:30) 🚀🔥
📖 John 10:30 – "I and the Father are one."

Many people, including some false teachers, misinterpret this verse and claim that Jesus and the Father are the same person. But is that what Jesus really meant? Let’s examine the original Greek, biblical context, and supporting Scriptures to find the truth!

🔥 1. THE ORIGINAL GREEK – WHAT DOES "ONE" REALLY MEAN?
The key word in John 10:30 is "one" in Greek, which is:
📖 Greek: ἕν (hen) – "one in essence, not one in person."

If Jesus meant that He and the Father were the same person, He would have used the Greek word "εἷς (heis)," which means a single individual. However, He used "hen," which refers to unity in nature or purpose.

🔥 Proof: The same Greek word (hen) is used in John 17:21 when Jesus prays that believers may be "one" (ἕν) just as He and the Father are one. This does not mean all believers become the same person—it means they are united in purpose and faith!
🚨 Conclusion: Jesus and the Father are NOT the same person, but they are ONE in divine essence, power, and nature!

🔥 2. JESUS AND THE FATHER ARE DISTINCT PERSONS
The Bible repeatedly shows that Jesus and the Father are separate persons who communicate with each other.

📖 John 17:5 – "Now, Father, glorify Me in Your presence with the glory I had with You before the world began."
👉 Jesus speaks TO the Father as someone distinct from Himself!

📖 Matthew 3:16-17 – "The heavens were opened, and He saw the Spirit of God descending like a dove and coming to rest on Him; and a voice from heaven said, ‘This is My beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased.’"
👉 All three persons of the Trinity are present:
✔️ Jesus (the Son) in the water.
✔️ The Father’s voice from heaven.
✔️ The Holy Spirit descending as a dove.
🔥 This proves Jesus is NOT the Father but is eternally united with Him!

🔥 3. JESUS CLAIMED EQUALITY WITH THE FATHER, NOT IDENTITY
📖 John 5:18 – "For this reason the Jews tried all the more to kill Him; not only was He breaking the Sabbath, but He was even calling God His own Father, making Himself equal with God."
🔥 The Jews understood Jesus’ claim—He was saying He was equal with God, NOT that He was the Father!

📖 Colossians 2:9 – "For in Christ all the fullness of Deity dwells in bodily form."
👉 Jesus possesses the FULL divine nature—the same as the Father.
🚨 Conclusion: Jesus did not claim to be the Father but to be one in divine essence with Him!

🔥 4. THE TRINITY: ONE GOD, THREE PERSONS
The Bible teaches that God is one in being but three in persons: the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit.

📖 Deuteronomy 6:4 – "Hear, O Israel: The LORD our God, the LORD is one." (Hebrew: אֶחָד "echad" – meaning a composite unity, not singularity!)
📖 Matthew 28:19 – "Baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit."
🔥 The Trinity is biblical! The Father is God, the Son is God, and the Holy Spirit is God—but they are distinct persons!

🔥 FINAL CONCLUSION: IS JESUS THE FATHER?
✅ No, Jesus is NOT the Father, but He is ONE in divine essence with the Father!
✅ The Greek proves it: "One" (ἕν) means unity in nature, not the same person.
✅ Jesus and the Father interact as distinct persons throughout Scripture.
✅ The Trinity explains it: One God in three persons—Father, Son, and Holy Spirit.
🚨 FALSE DOCTRINES ALERT! If anyone teaches that Jesus and the Father are the SAME person, they are promoting a false, unbiblical doctrine that denies the Trinity.

Heavenly Father, thank You for revealing the truth of who You are. I believe in Jesus as my Lord and Savior, and I trust in Your Word. Protect me from false teachings and help me to stand firm in the truth of Your divine nature. In Jesus’ mighty name, AMEN! 🙏🔥

title: 🔥 "ARE YOU A REAL CHRISTIAN, OR JUST A SUNDAY CHURCHGOER?" 🚀🔥
paragraphs: 🔥 "ARE YOU A REAL CHRISTIAN, OR JUST A SUNDAY CHURCHGOER?" 🚀🔥

📖 2 Corinthians 13:5 – "Examine yourselves, to see whether you are in the faith. Test yourselves. Or do you not realize this about yourselves, that Jesus Christ is in you—unless indeed you fail to meet the test?"
🚨 Just because you go to church doesn’t mean you’re saved!
Millions of people sit in church pews every Sunday, sing worship songs, and listen to sermons—but that doesn’t mean they truly follow Jesus.

🔥 Are you just a CHURCHGOER, or are you truly BORN AGAIN?
🔥 Does your life PROVE your faith, or is it just a weekend routine?
Today, we are exposing the difference between REAL Christianity and fake religion.

🔥 1. BEING RELIGIOUS DOESN’T MEAN YOU’RE SAVED!
📖 Matthew 7:21-23 – "Not everyone who says to Me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter the kingdom of heaven, but only the one who does the will of My Father… And then I will declare to them, ‘I never knew you; depart from Me, you workers of lawlessness!’"
🚨 Jesus is talking to "Christians" here—people who thought they were saved!

✅ They called Him "Lord."
✅ They did religious things.
✅ But they NEVER truly knew Him!
🔥 Christianity is NOT just about attending church—it’s about a life-transforming relationship with Jesus Christ!

🔥 2. SIGNS YOU ARE JUST A SUNDAY CHURCHGOER
🚨 If these describe you, it’s time to wake up!

❌ You only read your Bible at church, not daily.
📖 Psalm 1:2 – "But his delight is in the law of the Lord, and on His law he meditates day and night."

❌ You pray only when you need something, not to build a relationship with God.
📖 1 Thessalonians 5:17 – "Pray without ceasing."

❌ You blend in with the world—your life looks no different than non-believers.
📖 Romans 12:2 – "Do not be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewal of your mind."

❌ You feel no conviction over sin—you excuse it instead.
📖 Hebrews 10:26 – "For if we deliberately go on sinning after receiving the knowledge of the truth, no sacrifice for sins remains."
🔥 If your "Christianity" is just a routine, then you may be spiritually dead!

🔥 3. SIGNS YOU ARE A REAL CHRISTIAN
✅ You hunger for God’s Word DAILY, not just on Sundays.
📖 Matthew 4:4 – "Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that comes from the mouth of God."

✅ You hate sin and fight against it, instead of justifying it.
📖 Psalm 97:10 – "O you who love the Lord, hate evil!"

✅ You boldly share your faith and are not ashamed of Jesus.
📖 Romans 1:16 – "For I am not ashamed of the gospel, for it is the power of God for salvation."

✅ You love Jesus more than ANYTHING—including yourself!
📖 Luke 14:26 – "If anyone comes to Me and does not hate his own father and mother, wife and children, brothers and sisters—yes, even his own life—he cannot be My disciple."
🔥 TRUE Christianity is a surrendered life, not a casual hobby!

🔥 4. THE MOST DANGEROUS LIE: ‘I’M A GOOD PERSON, SO I’M GOING TO HEAVEN’
📖 Isaiah 64:6 – "All our righteous acts are like filthy rags."
🚨 Being a "good person" is NOT enough to be saved!

❌ Church attendance won’t save you.
❌ Baptism won’t save you.
❌ Giving to charity won’t save you.
❌ Trying to "be a good person" won’t save you.
📖 John 3:3 – "Unless one is born again, he cannot see the kingdom of God."
🔥 Only surrendering your life to Jesus and being born again will save you!

🔥 5. IT’S TIME TO STOP PLAYING CHURCH—GET SERIOUS ABOUT JESUS!
📖 Luke 9:23 – "If anyone would come after Me, let him deny himself and take up his cross daily and follow Me."

🚨 Being a real Christian means: ✔️ Giving up your own way.
✔️ Denying your sinful desires.
✔️ Living a life of obedience.
✔️ Following Jesus no matter the cost.
🔥 Christianity isn’t about convenience—it’s about TOTAL COMMITMENT!

🙏 POWERFUL PRAYER OF REPENTANCE & COMMITMENT
"Lord Jesus, I refuse to be just a Sunday Christian! I don’t want a dead religion—I want a real, life-changing relationship with You! Forgive me for my lukewarmness. I surrender my whole life to You. Fill me with Your Holy Spirit, transform my heart, and make me a true disciple. From this day forward, I will follow You completely. In Jesus’ name, AMEN!" 🙏🔥

title: 🔥 "DOES GOD HEAR THE PRAYERS OF UNBELIEVERS?" 🚀🔥
paragraphs: 🔥 "DOES GOD HEAR THE PRAYERS OF UNBELIEVERS?" 🚀🔥
📖 John 9:31 – "We know that God does not listen to sinners, but if anyone is a worshiper of God and does His will, God listens to him."

🚨 Millions believe that "God hears all prayers"—but is that what the Bible teaches?
🚨 If someone rejects Jesus, does God still answer their prayers?
🚨 What about desperate prayers from non-believers—does God respond?
🔥 Today, we expose the truth about whether God listens to unbelievers and what the Bible actually says!

🔥 1. THE BIBLE CLEARLY SAYS GOD DOES NOT HEAR SINNERS!
📖 Psalm 66:18 – "If I had cherished sin in my heart, the Lord would not have listened."
🚨 God does NOT listen to prayers that come from a heart full of sin and rebellion!

🔥 EXAMPLES FROM SCRIPTURE:
❌ Proverbs 28:9 – "If one turns away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer is an abomination."
❌ Isaiah 59:2 – "Your iniquities have made a separation between you and your God… so that He does not hear."
❌ Micah 3:4 – "Then they will cry to the Lord, but He will not answer them; He will hide His face from them because of their evil deeds."
🔥 God is HOLY—He does not listen to those who live in open rebellion!
✅ The only prayer God will hear from an unbeliever is a prayer of REPENTANCE!

🔥 2. WHEN DOES GOD LISTEN TO AN UNBELIEVER’S PRAYER?
📖 Romans 10:13 – "For everyone who calls on the name of the Lord will be saved."
🚨 God DOES hear the prayers of sinners—WHEN THEY REPENT!

🔥 EXAMPLES FROM SCRIPTURE:
✅ Luke 18:13 – The tax collector prayed, "God, be merciful to me, a sinner!" and was justified.
✅ Jonah 3:10 – The people of Nineveh repented, and God spared them.
✅ Acts 10:1-4 – Cornelius, a Gentile, feared God and sought Him in prayer, and God responded.
🔥 If an unbeliever genuinely seeks God, God WILL hear and respond!
✅ God will not ignore a humble, repentant heart!

🔥 3. WHY DO SOME UNBELIEVERS GET THEIR PRAYERS "ANSWERED"?
📖 Matthew 5:45 – "For He makes His sun rise on the evil and on the good, and sends rain on the just and on the unjust."
🚨 Just because someone’s prayer is "answered" doesn’t mean God approved of them!

🔥 REASONS WHY SOME UNBELIEVERS SEEM TO HAVE THEIR PRAYERS ANSWERED:
❌ God allows blessings as part of His general mercy on all people. (Matthew 5:45)
❌ Satan can deceive people with false miracles. (2 Thessalonians 2:9-10)
❌ Sometimes, people’s "prayers" are just coincidences, not divine intervention.
🔥 But God does NOT have a personal, covenant relationship with them!
✅ Only those who are in Christ have direct access to the Father! (John 14:6)

🔥 4. WHO DOES GOD HEAR?
📖 1 John 5:14 – "And this is the confidence that we have toward Him, that if we ask anything according to His will, He hears us."
🚨 God listens to those who belong to Him!

🔥 WHO GOD HEARS:
✅ The Righteous – "The prayer of a righteous person is powerful and effective." (James 5:16)
✅ The Humble – "God resists the proud but gives grace to the humble." (James 4:6)
✅ Those Who Obey – "Whatever we ask we receive from Him, because we keep His commandments." (1 John 3:22)
✅ Those Who Pray in Jesus’ Name – "If you ask Me anything in My name, I will do it." (John 14:14)
🔥 If you are a follower of Christ, your prayers are HEARD and ANSWERED!

🔥 5. HOW TO MAKE SURE GOD HEARS YOUR PRAYERS!
📖 Isaiah 55:6 – "Seek the Lord while He may be found; call upon Him while He is near."
🚨 Follow these biblical steps to ensure your prayers reach God!

✅ REPENT from sin! (Proverbs 28:13)
✅ PRAY in faith! (Mark 11:24)
✅ ASK according to God’s will! (1 John 5:14)
✅ FORGIVE others! (Mark 11:25)
✅ PRAY in Jesus’ name! (John 14:14)
🔥 God desires to hear your prayers—but you must approach Him in righteousness!

🙏 POWERFUL PRAYER TO MAKE SURE GOD HEARS YOU!
"Lord Jesus, I don’t want my prayers to be ignored! Forgive me for my sins, cleanse me, and make me right with You. I repent and surrender to You fully! Teach me to pray according to Your will. I desire to be heard by You and walk in Your presence forever. In Jesus’ name, AMEN!" 🙏🔥

title: "Living for the World Will Cost You Eternity – Choose Wisely" 🔥
paragraphs: "Living for the World Will Cost You Eternity – Choose Wisely" 🔥

title: "Stop Saying ‘God Knows My Heart’ to Excuse Sin" 🔥
paragraphs:
"Stop Saying ‘God Knows My Heart’ to Excuse Sin" 🔥
✝️ A Message from Brother John Domino "PiX" S. Asis – Follower of Jesus Christ and a Servant of God

🌍 [INTRODUCTION – URGENT WARNING]
⚠️ "God knows my heart!"

This is one of the most misused and dangerous phrases in Christianity today.
❌ Many say it to justify sin instead of repenting from it.
❌ Many use it as a free pass to disobey God.

🚨 Here’s the truth: Yes, God knows your heart… and that should TERRIFY you.
📖 "The heart is deceitful above all things, and desperately sick; who can understand it?" (Jeremiah 17:9)
🔥 This is your wake-up call. You cannot fool God—He sees EVERYTHING.

🔥 [1. THE DANGEROUS LIE: "As Long as My Heart is Right, I Can Do What I Want"]
📖 "There is a way that seems right to a man, but its end is the way to death." (Proverbs 14:12)

💡 Many Christians today believe this lie:
🔴 "It doesn’t matter how I live, God knows my heart."
🔴 "I may sin, but God understands."
🔴 "I’m a good person, so I’ll be fine."

🚨 This is a trap from the enemy! The Bible says:
⚠️ Your heart is NOT naturally good—it is sinful and deceitful.
⚠️ God doesn’t judge by your intentions—He judges by your actions.
⚠️ Partial obedience is still disobedience.
📖 "For the Lord sees not as man sees: man looks on the outward appearance, but the Lord looks on the heart." (1 Samuel 16:7)
🔥 If your heart is truly for God, it will show in the way you LIVE.

🔥 [2. THE EXCUSES PEOPLE USE TO JUSTIFY SIN]
Many people say "God knows my heart" to continue in sin without guilt.
Here are 4 of the most common excuses Christians use:

1️⃣ "I know it’s wrong, but God understands."
🚨 Truth: God calls you to REPENT, not make excuses.
📖 "Repent therefore, and turn back, that your sins may be blotted out." (Acts 3:19)

2️⃣ "I’m not perfect, nobody is."
🚨 Truth: God doesn’t expect perfection, but He expects OBEDIENCE.
📖 "Be holy, for I am holy." (1 Peter 1:16)

3️⃣ "At least I’m not as bad as other people."
🚨 Truth: You are judged by GOD’S standard, not by comparing yourself to others.
📖 "Each of us will give an account of himself to God." (Romans 14:12)

4️⃣ "God knows I love Him, even if I sin."
🚨 Truth: If you love Him, you will OBEY Him.
📖 "If you love me, you will keep my commandments." (John 14:15)
🔥 Which of these excuses have you used? It’s time to stop justifying sin and start walking in true repentance!

🔥 [3. HOW TO TRULY HAVE A HEART FOR GOD]
🙌 A heart for God is shown by a LIFE that follows Him.

✅ 1. REPENT FROM SIN – Stop excusing it, turn away from it!
📖 "Let the wicked forsake his way and the unrighteous man his thoughts; let him return to the Lord." (Isaiah 55:7)

✅ 2. SEEK GOD DAILY – Spend time in prayer and His Word.
📖 "Your word I have hidden in my heart, that I might not sin against You." (Psalm 119:11)

✅ 3. OBEY GOD COMPLETELY – Not just in words, but in actions.
📖 "But be doers of the word, and not hearers only, deceiving yourselves." (James 1:22)

✅ 4. ALLOW GOD TO CHANGE YOUR HEART – Ask Him to purify you.
📖 "Create in me a clean heart, O God, and renew a right spirit within me." (Psalm 51:10)
🔥 Today is the day to stop making excuses and fully surrender to Jesus!

🔥 THE REPENTANCE CHALLENGE 🔥
✅ Step 1: Examine your life—what sins have you been excusing? Repent today.
✅ Step 2: Tag 3 friends who need to hear this truth!

📢 🚨 WARNING: The enemy does NOT want you to share this.
🔥 That’s exactly why you SHOULD!
📖 "For God will bring every deed into judgment, with every secret thing, whether good or evil." (Ecclesiastes 12:14)

🧐 QUESTION FOR YOU:
Have you ever used "God knows my heart" to excuse sin?

🙏 PRAYER FOR JANUARY 21, 2025 🙏
Heavenly Father, I ask for Your mercy and forgiveness. Help me stop making excuses for sin and truly surrender to You. Cleanse my heart and lead me in Your righteousness. Give me the strength to walk in obedience and help others do the same. In Jesus’ mighty name, AMEN! 🙏🔥

title: 🔥 "THE WORLD HATES YOU? GOOD! THAT MEANS YOU BELONG TO JESUS!" 🚀🔥
paragraphs: 🔥 "THE WORLD HATES YOU? GOOD! THAT MEANS YOU BELONG TO JESUS!" 🚀🔥

📖 John 15:18 – "If the world hates you, know that it has hated Me before it hated you."
📖 John 15:23 – "Whoever hates Me hates My Father also."
Many Christians today desperately want to be liked by the world. They want to be accepted, fit in, and avoid conflict. But Jesus made it clear—if you truly follow Him, the world WILL hate you!

🚨 WHY? Because the world HATED JESUS FIRST!
If the world never criticizes you, mocks you, or opposes you—are you really standing for Christ?

🔥 1. IF THE WORLD LOVES YOU, YOU’RE DOING SOMETHING WRONG!
📖 John 15:19 – "If you were of the world, the world would love you as its own; but because you are not of the world, but I chose you out of the world, therefore the world hates you."

🔥 Jesus says the world LOVES those who belong to it.
🔥 If the world loves you, celebrates you, and never convicts you—you may be living like the world instead of like Christ!
🚨 If you never face persecution, are you truly standing for righteousness?

🔥 2. THE WORLD HATES YOU BECAUSE YOU EXPOSE ITS EVIL!
📖 John 3:19-20 – "People loved the darkness rather than the light because their deeds were evil. Everyone who does wicked things hates the light and does not come to the light, lest his deeds should be exposed."

🔥 The moment you start living for Jesus, you become a light—and the world hates the light!
🔥 When you expose sin, call for repentance, and preach the truth, the world will attack you.
🚨 If the world hates you, it’s because the light of Christ in you exposes their darkness!

🔥 3. FALSE CHRISTIANS WANT THE WORLD’S APPROVAL!
📖 James 4:4 – "Do you not know that friendship with the world is enmity with God? Therefore, whoever wishes to be a friend of the world makes himself an enemy of God."

❌ Many so-called Christians compromise their faith to avoid persecution.
❌ They water down the gospel to make it more "acceptable" to the world.
❌ They refuse to preach against sin so they won’t be labeled as "judgmental."
🚨 But Jesus says that if you try to be "friends" with the world, you become an ENEMY of God!

🔥 4. JESUS WARNED US: PERSECUTION IS PROOF OF TRUE FAITH!
📖 Matthew 5:10-11 – "Blessed are those who are persecuted for righteousness' sake, for theirs is the kingdom of heaven. Blessed are you when others revile you and persecute you and utter all kinds of evil against you falsely on My account."

✅ If you stand for Jesus, expect persecution!
✅ If you live by the truth, expect rejection!
✅ If you preach repentance, expect mockery!
🚨 Don’t be afraid when the world hates you—REJOICE! It means you are standing for the truth!

🔥 5. WHO REALLY HATES JESUS? LOOK AROUND!
📖 John 15:23 – "Whoever hates Me hates My Father also."
🚨 Pay attention! Who are the ones who HATE Jesus today?

❌ The entertainment industry mocks Him.
❌ Schools ban His name.
❌ Governments persecute His people.
❌ False churches twist His words.
❌ The world celebrates every false god—EXCEPT Jesus!
🔥 Why? Because Jesus is the ONLY truth, and Satan wants Him silenced!

🔥 FINAL CONCLUSION: STOP TRYING TO PLEASE THE WORLD!
✅ If the world hates you, GOOD! That means you belong to Jesus!
✅ If you face rejection, mockery, and persecution, REJOICE! That means you are walking in truth!
✅ Never water down the gospel, never compromise for acceptance, and never trade Christ for popularity!
🚨 THE WORLD HATES JESUS. IF YOU FOLLOW HIM, THE WORLD WILL HATE YOU TOO!

✅ 👍 CLICK LIKE if you stand boldly for Christ!
✅ ❤️ CLICK HEART if you refuse to bow to the world’s system!
✅ 🚀 CLICK SHARE to expose this truth—many Christians need to hear this!
📢 🚨 WARNING: The world is pressuring Christians to compromise. SHARE THIS NOW to wake up the sleeping church!

🙏 PRAYER FOR TODAY
Heavenly Father, I thank You that I am set apart for Your kingdom. Give me boldness to stand for truth, even when the world hates me. Strengthen my faith so I will never compromise or seek the approval of man. Let me live only for You and Your glory. In Jesus’ name, AMEN! 🙏🔥

title: "Not Everyone Who Says ‘Lord, Lord’ Will Enter Heaven" 🔥
paragraphs: "Not Everyone Who Says ‘Lord, Lord’ Will Enter Heaven" 🔥

🔥 IMAGINE STANDING BEFORE JESUS… THINKING YOU’RE SAVED… BUT HE LOOKS AT YOU AND SAYS:
🚪 "DEPART FROM ME—I NEVER KNEW YOU."

💀 This is the reality for MANY who call themselves Christians today.
❌ They went to church.
❌ They knew Bible verses.
❌ They called Jesus ‘Lord’… but they NEVER truly followed Him.

title: "The Silent Christian is a Disobedient Christian – Speak Up!" 🔥
paragraphs:

title: 🔥 "WHAT IS TRUE REPENTANCE? IT’S MORE THAN JUST SAYING ‘SORRY’!" 🚀🔥
paragraphs:
🔥 "WHAT IS TRUE REPENTANCE? IT’S MORE THAN JUST SAYING ‘SORRY’!" 🚀🔥
📖 Acts 3:19 – "Repent, then, and turn to God, so that your sins may be wiped out, that times of refreshing may come from the Lord."

🚨 Millions say "sorry" to God—but is that real repentance?
🚨 Many confess their sins, but never change—does that mean they’re forgiven?
🚨 TRUE REPENTANCE IS NOT JUST WORDS—IT'S A RADICAL TRANSFORMATION!
🔥 Today, we expose what REAL repentance is—and why without it, there is NO salvation!

🔥 1. FAKE REPENTANCE WILL LEAD YOU TO HELL!
📖 2 Corinthians 7:10 – "For godly sorrow produces repentance leading to salvation, but worldly sorrow brings death."
🚨 Many people think feeling bad about sin is enough—BUT IT’S NOT!

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
Imagine a man who cheats on his wife. She catches him, and he breaks down crying, begging for forgiveness. But a few weeks later, he does it again. Then again. And again.

❌ He feels guilty, but he never changes.
❌ He apologizes, but he keeps doing the same thing.
❌ His words mean NOTHING if his actions don’t change!
📖 Matthew 7:21 – "Not everyone who says to Me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter the kingdom of heaven, but only the one who does the will of My Father who is in heaven."
🚨 If there is NO CHANGE, there is NO REPENTANCE—AND NO SALVATION!

🔥 2. TRUE REPENTANCE MEANS TOTAL SURRENDER!
📖 Luke 13:3 – "Unless you repent, you will all likewise perish."
🚨 Repentance is NOT just feeling sorry—it’s CHANGING DIRECTION!

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
A drug addict finally hits rock bottom. He realizes his addiction is destroying his life. Instead of just saying "I’ll try to stop," he throws away all his drugs, cuts off toxic friends, checks into rehab, and dedicates his life to God.

✅ He didn’t just feel bad—he took ACTION!
✅ He didn’t just SAY he wanted change—he PROVED IT with his life!
✅ That’s TRUE REPENTANCE!
📖 Luke 3:8 – "Produce fruit in keeping with repentance."
🔥 IF THERE IS NO EVIDENCE OF CHANGE, YOU ARE STILL IN BONDAGE TO SIN!

🔥 3. REPENTANCE IS NOT A ONE-TIME EVENT—IT’S A LIFESTYLE!
📖 Luke 9:23 – "Whoever wants to be My disciple must deny themselves and take up their cross DAILY and follow Me."
🚨 Too many people repent once and think they are done—but repentance is DAILY!

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
Imagine someone who joins a gym to lose weight. He works out for ONE day, but then never returns. Does he expect to see results? NO!

✅ Repentance is the same—it’s a daily commitment!
✅ You can’t repent once and go back to sin—you have to keep fighting!
📖 Galatians 5:24 – "Those who belong to Christ Jesus have crucified the flesh with its passions and desires."
🔥 REPENTANCE IS NOT A RELIGIOUS RITUAL—IT IS TOTAL TRANSFORMATION!

🔥 4. WITHOUT REPENTANCE, YOU WILL NOT BE SAVED!
📖 Luke 13:5 – "Unless you repent, you too will all perish."
🚨 The modern church preaches grace but forgets repentance—but without repentance, NO ONE will see the Kingdom of God!

🔥 REAL-LIFE EXAMPLE:
If a murderer stands before a judge and says, "I’m sorry, please forgive me," should the judge just let him go? Of course not! There must be JUSTICE!
✅ God is a righteous Judge—He forgives those who truly repent, not those who only pretend!
📖 Acts 17:30 – "God commands ALL people everywhere to repent."
🔥 REPENTANCE IS NOT OPTIONAL—IT IS A COMMAND!

🔥 5. HOW TO TRULY REPENT AND BE FORGIVEN!
📖 1 John 1:9 – "If we confess our sins, He is faithful and just to forgive us our sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness."

✅ FORSAKE YOUR OLD WAYS! (Isaiah 55:7)
✅ ASK GOD TO TRANSFORM YOUR HEART! (Ezekiel 36:26)
✅ WALK IN OBEDIENCE TO HIS WORD! (John 14:15)
✅ REJECT THE WORLD AND FOLLOW JESUS! (Luke 9:62)
🔥 IF YOU ARE TRULY REPENTANT, YOUR LIFE WILL NEVER BE THE SAME!

"Lord Jesus, I refuse to live in fake repentance! I turn away from my sin completely. Cleanse me, change me, and make me new! Give me a heart that loves righteousness and hates sin. I surrender everything to You today! In Jesus’ name, AMEN!" 🙏🔥

🔥 It’s not about what you SAY—it’s about how you LIVE!
